cs-fuuka-yamagishi.1079.title: [CS] Fuuka Yamagishi
cs-fuuka-yamagishi.1079.author: takebafan
cs-fuuka-yamagishi.1079.description: Your favorite navigator from the "Persona" franchise is ready for a new adventure! Play as Fuuka and jump, punch, even fly your way to get 120 power stars and save The Mushroom Kingdom! This mod was the collective effort and journey of a lot of different people - and i'd like to take the time to properly thank EVERYONE who helped contribute into the creation of the mod. So thank you to: @takebafan on twitter (me!) - for reaching out to everyone and bringing this project to reality - as well as do all the coding for the character select menu, and all the voice line stuff! TrixieBun on BlueSky - who did all the really really hard stuff that I was too stupid to figure out! You laid a fantastic foundation for this mod and NONE of this would have happened without you. Thank you for giving me this opportunity (and permission) to refine this mod and bring it out to the public for all to use and have fun with! @AccurstMaiden on twitter - Who contacted me and gave me an earlier build of the mod, as well as pointing me into the correct direction to the original creator of the foundation. You laid the stepping stones to the end path, and were super fun to talk to as well! @Xeeoh on twitter - Who made the custom life icon sprite and lemon health bar for Fuuka - as well as just help playtest the multiplayer functionality - and just being one of my best friends in the whole wide world! Always supportive of my endeavors. I truly don't deserve you @SuzieYeung the official VA for Fuuka - who (legally) is not at all tied to this project, but I did sample the voice of to use for her! And finally @__Smokin_joe__ on twitter - For creating the box fan art utilized on the mod page, as well as just being an incredible friend all around! You truly are so kind for going out of your way to do that If you plan on showing this mod to others on other websites or utilizing it for content - I would greatly appreciate if you credited me @takebafan on twitter, as well as included a link to the mod page so all these other wonderful people can be thanked for their hard work! Thanks and enjoy!

super-smash-bros-co-op.253.title: Super Smash Bros. Co-op
super-smash-bros-co-op.253.author: Keeberghrh
super-smash-bros-co-op.253.description: Super Smash Bros. Co-op v0.1​ After two months, this mod is being released! As a quick warning: Larger player counts may break the game. It is recommended you stick to smaller groups, between 2 and 5 players. The mod works with more players, but game breaking bugs seem more common with higher player counts. Features​ 10 fighters! 5 Additional Characters Mario - Basic fighter, closest to vanilla movement. Luigi - Similar to Mario, but with different aerials. Toad - Fast and powerful attacks. Waluigi - Has attacks that can combo fairly well. Wario - Heavy hitter, but slow on the ground. New Characters Bowser - Powerful attacks, fire breath and heavier than most fighters. (Model by @wibblus , thank you )Kirby - Has Inhale as a Special to copy your opponent's Special. King Bob-omb - Can throw Bob-ombs which deal a lot of damage. Very heavy and large hurtbox. Sonic - Fastest fighter, but slightly weaker. Emerl - Can copy all characters! By pressing DPAD UP, Emerl enters a menu where any individual attack can be chosen and swapped out. Saves to mod storage. Three Gamemodes! Smash Mode - Regular Smash, dealing damage increases your opponent's %! Stamina Mode - Instead of %, damage simply lowers your opponent's HP. Boss Mode - The Host selects one player to be the Boss. The Boss has heavy armour, takes reduced knockback, a health bar, and can be resized to be larger or smaller. Non-Boss Players have to work to defeat the boss! Code: Grounded + B + Idle = Jab Grounded + B + Running = Dash Attack Grounded + B + Crouch = Special Aerial + B = Aerial Ground Pound + A = Recovery Ground Pound + B = Ground Pound Dive Enjoy!

updates.title: Super Smash Bros. Co-op API Update
updates.changelog: Hey all! First update, hopefully fully implementing the API alongside a few other changes! Smaller changes, Bowser and Emerl have two new palettes, and I've rewritten the Stock Render functions to be more streamlined, also using the new functions so there shouldn't be any warning spam in console anymore. There is a new built-in stage, Sunshine Isle! It takes place on an island in the middle of the ocean with an elevated area for fighting. You can stay in the water for 3 seconds before you drown. It should now be possible to add custom fighters and stages, using the templates attached! However they only work with v0.2 onwards due to a mistake on my end. Each template has a version number that will prevent them from being loaded on incompatible version in the future.

cs-moonwalker.1169.title: [CS] Moonwalker
cs-moonwalker.1169.author: frobissuck
cs-moonwalker.1169.description: The stylish dancer with cosmical power. Moonwalker from YOMIH Mod by InklessBrush is now available in sm64coopdx with his own moveset. Moonwalker don't have time to stay still. He'll be always moving even with no input. While he's in moonwalk, he can do higher jumps, double jumps, twirls, kicks and dives. And also he can dance with his very own song. No input - Moonwalking. You can control his direction by moving camera. A Button while Moonwalking - Moonjump. Very high jump with stylish animation. A Button while Moonjumping - Midjump. Very low jump, but can be useful for air control. Z Trigger while Moonjumping - Twirl. Works like a regular Twirl, but you can also Midjump in it. Z Trigger while Midjumping - Dive. Faces away the camera and dives forward with some vertical speed applied. L Trigger - Dance. Makes a looping dance with some music turned on. Can't be used while in air. Credits: Your Only Move Is Hustle creator - Ivy Sly Moonwalker mod creator - InklessBrush Graphics and some coding - frobissuck Idea author and coding - CrazyDany

nsmb-wii-twirl.1222.title: NSMB Wii Twirl
nsmb-wii-twirl.1222.author: aquathedestroyer
nsmb-wii-twirl.1222.description:
Mario twirls in the air, just like in NSMBWii, but with a few modifications for adjusting to the 3D plane. Press A to twirl for a moment, and you can even switch around your direction with the joystick mid-twirl!

The twirl is a move that has been, in Super Mario 64's spirit, given plenty of technical versatility. Runners and casuals alike, enjoy the ability to combo long jumps into jump combos with a twirl that also carries your forward momentum over. 

That's not all, either. Suddenly regretting a jump? Twirl back into safety. Need to negate fall damage? Just twirl! Many Kaizo platforming challenges, and jumps that look 
juuuuust
 doable become a little easier on you with this simple tool in your moveset.

easy-custom-moveset.485.title: Easy Custom Moveset
easy-custom-moveset.485.author: srGSR
easy-custom-moveset.485.description: Easy Custom Movesets This mod allows anyone to add unique movesets to any character, no coding required. Just fill out the forms at ECM Form Website , and in less than 5 minutes, your character with new moves. Also, it comes pre-configured with over 100 modded characters , so you can start playing immediately without any manual setup! * the character and custom animation are from other mods, check " Mods Integrated " section to see who made then. Adding/Editing Moveset Access ECM Form Website Fill the name field, it should be the same as in Chracter Select menu Configure the rest of the options for your character Download the generated Lua config file without renaming the file Place the file in mods/Easy-Custom-Movesets/moveset_configs folder Enable Chracter Select, Easy Custom Moveset and your Character mod in-game Select your character and play! Integrating your mod Inside your main.lua, after _G.charSelect.character_add , execute _G.customMoves.character_add to change the character stats. Code: -- Default Character Select Code _G.charSelect.character_add( "Custom Model", {"Custom Model Description", "Custom Model Description"}, "Custom Model Creator", {r = 255, g = 200, b = 200}, E_MODEL_CUSTOM_MODEL, CT_MARIO, get_texture_info("custom-icon") ) -- Modify character stats if customMoves exists if _G.customMovesExists then _G.customMoves.character_add({ name = "Custom Model", swimming_speed = 500 }) end For example, to add support to the Iono character mod, I added line 61-63 to the Iono main.lua Here . Example Stats Name Explanation Default gravity How much gravity affects the character (percentage). 100 jump_strength How much higher all jumps are (percentage). 100 walking_speed How much faster the character can walk (percentage). 100 in_air_speed How much faster the character can move horizontally in the air (percentage). 100 mr_l_jump_on Enables the character to perform a super jump after holding a crouch. false triple_jump_twirling_on The character start twirling after triple jump. false water_damage_multiplier How much damage the character takes when holding breath under water (percentage). 100 burning_damage_multiplier How much damage the character takes when burning (percentage). 100 ground_pound_dive_on Allows the character to perform a dive while ground pound. false waft_fart_on Allows the character to perform an super fart jump while ground pound with Z button. This jump has an limited number of uses per level. false ground_pound_jump_on Allows the character to perform an special jump after ground pound. false super_side_flip_on Allows the character to perform an special side flip after long jump. false wall_slide_on Allows the character to perform wall slide. ( created by djoslin0) false in_air_jump How many jumps in the air the character can do 0 glide_dive_on The character glide when diving. false kill_toad The character can kill toad false yoshi_flutter_on The character can yoshi flutter after jumping false You can look all the stats at Here . updates.title: v1.8 (Jumpfinity Update)
updates.changelog: This update adds the ability to do jumps in the air, allowing for the recreation of the classic double jump. However, it goes beyond that—it's highly customizable. You can define how many air jumps a character can perform and tweak each one individually, including its strength, animation, sound, and forward velocity slowdown. Moves that alter the timing of hitting the ground while requiring an A pres ( such as Peach’s hover, Luigi’s slow descent, or in air jumps) can make double and triple jumps feel awkward. So,with disable_double_jump and long_jump_triple_jump enabled, you can still do triple jumps while not having to perform the tricky timing of double jump. The kick_dive setting resolves what I consider the most awkward aspect of Mario 64’s movement: the kick and dive being mapped to the same button. Many times, I intended to perform one but accidentally did the other instead. With kick_dive, pressing B always performs a kick first, and pressing it again performs a dive. This makes character movement much more intuitive. Additionally, thanks to djoslin0, wall sliding has been added to the mod! Added stats:​ wall_slide_on : Allows the character to perform wall slide. ( Thanks to djoslin0 ) wall_slide_gravity : Gravity effect when wall sliding wall_slide_max_gravity : Max downward velocity when applying gravity of wall slide wall_slide_jump_forward_vel : Forward velocity added when jumping from wall slide wall_slide_jump_strength : Increases the height of jump after wall slide wall_slide_jump_type : Type of the jump after wall slide in_air_jump : How many jumps in the air the character can do in_air_jump_strength : Jump strength of in air jumps in_air_jump_animations : Animation of in air jumps in_air_jump_sound : Sound of in air jumps in_air_jump_forward_vel_multiplier : How much forward velocity is converted to in air jumps in_air_jump_forward_vel_slowdown : How much forward velocity is lost each time the character do an air jumps kick_dive_on : When pressing B, instead of performing a dive or kick depending on speed, the character will always execute a kick first. If B is pressed again, a dive will follow disable_double_jump : Disable double jump Add support to mods:​ Connie Donald Duck Ebimasu Ganbare Goemon Gnarpy Goemon Ninji PaRappa the Rappe Penelope Pussycat Saul PFP Wapeach Yae Yumpi Fix​ disable_damage was not working correctly

Note : You need to install Credits Jumping Animation for this to work. long_jump_triple_jump_on : Allows the character to perform a triple jump after a long jump. long_jump_triple_jump_strength : Increases the height of the triple jump after a long jump (percentage). long_jump_triple_jump_forward_vel : Sets the horizontal velocity of a long jump triple jump (units). long_jump_triple_jump_add_forward_vel : Added horizontal velocity of a long jump triple jump (units). super_side_flip_on : Allows the character to perform an special side flip after long jump. super_side_flip_strength : Height of super side flip. super_side_flip_convert_forward_vel : Conversion from forward velocity of the long jump into the side flip (percentage). super_side_flip_add_forward_vel : Horizontal velocity added when performing a super side flip (units). super_side_flip_kick_strength : Height of the kick when performing a super side flip (percentage of a normal kick). super_side_flip_kick_forward_vel : Forward velocity of the kick when performing a super side flip (units). super_side_flip_gravity : Gravity effect when performing a super side flip (percentage). super_side_flip_max_gravity : Max downward velocity when applying gravity during a super side flip (percentage). super_side_flip_min_velocity : Minimum forward velocity of the long jump required to execute a super side flip (units). Add support to mods:​ Asterix Patrick Starfish QP Saul & Friends

updates.title: v1.6 (Poundest update)
updates.changelog: This update aims to make ground pound feel more dynamic and be an move that does not kill all your momentum. The changes can be summarized in two parts: introduce ways to customize the default ground pound ( speed up animation, increase velocity, add shake effects) add ways to move out from ground pound (dive, waft fart, ground pound jump) Added the stats:​ ground_pound_dive_on : Allows the character to perform a dive after a ground pound. ground_pound_dive_y_vel : Adds vertical velocity when diving after a ground pound. ground_pound_dive_forward_vel : Forward velocity added when diving after a ground pound. ground_pound_jump_on : Allows the character to perform a special jump after a ground pound. ground_pound_jump_strength : Height of ground pound jump. ground_pound_forward_vel : Horizontal velocity of ground pound jump . ground_pound_jump_dive_on : Allows the character to dive while performing a ground pound jump. waft_fart_on : Allows the character to perform a super fart jump while ground pounding with the Z button. This jump has a limited number of uses per level. waft_fart_velocity : Horizontal velocity of waft fart jump . waft_fart_strength : Height of waft fart jump. waft_fart_per_level : Number of times the character can use the waft fart jump per level. ground_pound_antecipation_speed_up : Increases the speed of the spinning animation before performing a ground pound. "small": Increases speed by 20%. "medium": Increases speed by 25%. "fast": Increases speed by 80%. "immediately": Skips animation. ground_pound_gravity : Gravity effect when ground pounding . ground_pound_max_y_vel : Increases max Y velocity when ground pounding. ground_pound_shake : Increases camera shake when ground pounding. Add support to mods:​ Croc Kitsufae Lego Mario Marty the Thwomp Marvin the martian Mips Slippy Toad Talking Red Turkey Wario

updates.title: v1.5 (Hurtful update)
updates.changelog:
This update introduces multipliers for lava, burn, water, and bad gas damage. This allows for adding drawbacks to characters without completely crippling one of their jumps.

Added the stats:​

water_damage_multiplier : How much damage the character takes when holding breath under water

hangout-mcdonalds.43.title: Hangout - McDonald's
hangout-mcdonalds.43.author: Chilly
hangout-mcdonalds.43.description:
Welcome to McDonald's!
 
(yes, really.)

This is a hangout map themed around an iconic (for better or worse) restaurant you've probably eaten at before. This is the 1.0 release, so it's just the restaurant and a basic surrounding area.

This map was mostly just a pet project to learn more about Blender and is actually my first map made for Co-op.

A very simple implementation is provided to allow people to access the map through the 
/mcd
 command. Feel free to change the method of warping there to better fit your server!

updates.title: Small palette update!
updates.changelog:
Hi! A few days after the last update of this mod turned 1 year old, i decided to post a small update for this mod adding and improving some details here and there, with the main addition of new palettes for Jumpman and Stanley!

This version added 17 palettes for Jumpman and Stanley, which means the mod now has a total of 27 palettes (Specifically, Jumpman has 13 new palettes, with a total of 17 palettes and Stanley has 4 new palettes, with a total of 10), mostly being based on the many ports of the first Donkey Kong game from the arcades, this required some code optimization (and with that, i mean changing the way the palettes were added to be a lot easier and less annoying) in order to make this possible.

Also, character categorys and full support for 4:3 was added as well, so that's cool, i guess.

I hope everyone enjoys this small update!

updates.title: The Christmas Update!
updates.changelog: Merry Christmas everyone! To celebrate it, i decided to release a new version of the DK Arcade Pack, with improved features and models, and new little stuff! Changelog: Jumpman's main model got mutiples changes and fixes, such as: Eyebrows & sideburns are now recoloreable thanks to TheGreatMario64! Jumpman's metal state also got fixed, now it works as intended The new, revamped alt system from Character Select version 1.11 got added as well, remplacing the old alt system. Updated Credits from Character Select version 1.10 were added as well! (the other 2 Jumpman models made by ThatGurlTilly will get changes and fixes in the future, if you were asking about that) (the other 2 models made by ThatGurlTilly will get changes and fixes in the future as well!) Not only that, both Jumpman and Stanley got new preset palettes thanks to Character's Select most recent version! 4 for Jumpman and 6 for Stanley, giving a total of 10 total preset palettes! let's see if you get the references for them, more coming in the future! Credits: AlexXRGames, ThatGurlTilly, BlueKazoo, TheGreatMario64, Squishy6094, ER1CK, and Brob2nd I hope y'all enjoy this new update, Merry christmas!

cs-the-wastelanders.892.description: [THE NEWEST VERSION OF CHARACTER SELECT IS NEEDED FOR THE FULL EXPERIENCE, USE IT AT YOUR OWN RISK] This is a custom character mod pack for the main three protagonists of Disney's Epic Mickey , Mickey Mouse, Oswald the Lucky Rabbit, and Gremlin Gus. After beating the blot, the three heroes who saved wasteland are now saving a princess from a reptilian-looking monster. This is the big update to my last mod, Wastelander Mickey, which now adds Wastelander Oswald and Wastelander Gus, and maybe some more things will come soon too. Thank you everyone who helped me along the way making this mod. [OLD] Here's the release trailer. Ghosty and Salt helped me with .luaing, while I did everything else. And thank you to MrScaryHalloween for playtesting my mod. I of course do not own these characters. Everything in this mod, besides the graffiti art, are from Disney, Disney Interactive, and Junction Point Studios.

updates.title: MISCELLANEOUS LAST UPDATE!!!
updates.changelog: Made the Wastelanders smaller to be better proportion to the base cast, and added support to the So Retro! mod by making sprites of the Wastelander cast, and I think they turned out well. I also threw in a [WIP] build of my mod version of the Epic Mickey: Texture Pack, this pack will swap every texture in the game with ones from Epic Mickey 1, and some of my own if needed. Once I finish the texture pack, whenever that'll be, it'll come out with two versions, mod pack and a dynos pack, the dynos pack will have higher quality textures compared to the mod version, since mods have a limit of 30mb and Epic Mickey is a Wii game from 2010 so I'll have to downscale the texture to the original sm64 size to fit with the 30mb limit. I don't have an exact release yet for the texture pack or if I'll ever release it bc I've been kinda burnt out making this mod and theres just so many textures to change, but I'll let you guys know. This is now the last update for the Wastelander cast, for a long while at least, I know there's some issues like with Oswald's missing hands when jumping out of a painting, but I'm happy with the current state of it, I did want to add in Horace Horsecollar to the cast, but sadly I was having trouble with his long neck, so for now he's retired, I hope you guys enjoy this update, I had fun making this mod and learned so much of modding and coopdx when making this, since this is my first mod ever and it shows, and I'm grateful to be apart of this great community. See ya later suckers!

updates.title: EYES BE MOVIN'!!!
updates.changelog:
This new update is mainly just some minor updates.

-Changes the recolorables to be costumes of the base models, instead of their own separate character.

-Adds a whole bunch of color palettes for the recolorables because who doesn't like options.

-Adds blinking heads to the base characters, along with a left and right looking animations for both the base characters and recolorables.

This will probably be the last big update to the cast, except for bug fixes, more color palettes and what not. I am satisfied with how my custom characters are and won't be making any changes to them anytime soon, probably will update them when I get better at modding and 3D modeling, but here's hopin'. Thank you again to everyone who has helped me with this mod of mine and everyone else who gave me ideas along with you guys who checked out the mod. I am very happy you all are enjoying it so far and don't worry about telling me what should added, fixed, or tweaked because I want to make this mod as good as I can make it. And don't worry, there is still more to come so stay tuned!

characters-physics-explosive-flavour.125.title: Characters Physics (Explosive Flavour)
characters-physics-explosive-flavour.125.author: ExploxionMach64
characters-physics-explosive-flavour.125.description: By the name of the mod, you probably already know what it does: it adds different physics (or stats, if you prefer) to Luigi, Toad, Wario and Waluigi! The mod also changes how maximum speed, acceleration and slopes interact compared to vanilla SM64 physics. Let´s start talking about the diferrent PHYSICS/STATS the cast can have: Maxium Speed: Determines the maximum speed your character can reach through normal acceleration. NOTE: Is affected by slopes. Acceleration: Determines how quickly your character gains speed. NOTE: Is affected by slopes. Deceleration: Determines how quickly your character slows down while braking or turning around. Characters with high deceleration starts running more faster after turning around. Jump Height: Determines how high your character jumps. Lower jump heights provide more horizontal speed during Wall Kicks, while higher jump heights trade some horizontal speed for extra height. Swim Speed: Determines how fast your character swims. NOTE: This does not affects how fast your character turns while swimming. Weight: Affects gravity while falling. Determines how strongly your character is launched by knockbacks. Now you know what each stat do! Let´s see the stats each of the CHARACTERS have : Mario : Max Speed: Medium | Accel: Medium | Decel: Medium | Jump Height: Medium | Swim Speed: Medium | Weight: Medium Luigi : Max Speed: Low | Accel: Medium | Decel: Very Low | Jump Height: Very High | Swim Speed: High | Weight: Very Low Toad : Max Speed: Very High | Accel: Very High | Decel: Low | Jump Height: Very Low | Swim Speed: Very High | Weight: Low Wario : Max Speed: Medium | Accel: Very Low | Decel: Very High | Jump Height: Low | Swim Speed: High | Weight: Very High Waluigi : Max Speed: High | Accel: High | Decel: High | Jump Height: High | Swim Speed: Low | Weight: Low Also, this mod comes with a Mod Menu Want to check what each stat do or disable the unique physics? Check the mod´s menu! ( Pause → Press R → Mod Menu → Characters Physics (Explosive Flavour) ) character movesets, unique stuff for Mario and even more stuff are planned for future updates, see ya!

updates.title: More Polishing

Changes
​

"(Explosive Flavour)" is now gray in the mods list.

Maximum Speed and Acceleration now affect the Hold Walking action.

Deceleration now actually affects the Decelerating and Hold Decelerating actions.

Jump Height now affects the Riding Shell Jump action.

Refined the Long Jump and Dive speed calculations.

Swim Speed now affects the Water Punch and Water Shell Swimming actions.

Changed the amount of time Weight affects knockback while out of water.

Stat descriptions are now cyan in the Stats Info.

Acceleration and Weight´s descriptions were shorten to be one line long.

Fixes
​

Fixed a typo in the mod's description.

updates.title: Quality Life Update
updates.changelog: Superstar Saga Moveset v3.0 - Quality Life Update Category: Moveset Hey!, it's been 4 months since 2.1! and I think it's time to update this mod, here are the additions and changes of v3.0: - Mario - Reworked Ball The height of the mini boost that gives you the spin has been changed [New] Mini Mario: Press D_JPAD to become smaller and faster, losing several of the actions (to return to normal press U_JPAD) [New] Mid Spin: Hold U_JPAD to stay in the air while doing the spin [New] Spin Cancel: Press B during the spin to go straight down (Made by Jabelrpo ) - Luigi - Reworked Hight [New] Mole Luigi: Press D_JPAD to become invisible and little more faster, losing several of the actions (to return to normal press U_JPAD) Luigi's Cyclone has been removed (it will be added in the future or replaced with some other move) - Brothers - - [New] Two Player Movement: Swing Bros! Player 1 must hit player 2 and player 2 will be launched forward at high speed. - [New] Superstar Saga Water: Now water works like in Superstar Saga (Press B to swim) - [New] Fourth Jump: (Referring to the fact that when you press at the exact moment you make a more powerful jump, and to the second jump that you can do in the same way as the above) After doing a triple jump, press a and you will do a fourth jump! - Other Things - The command to activate or deactivate the moveset has been renamed to Ssm Added a command to view the respective controls of the mod's actions (Hammers for the next Update) Attention: Mini Mario and Mole Luigi have a synchronization error in which the other player cannot see you in the state of the aforementioned actions. rideable-yoshi.288.title: Rideable Yoshi
rideable-yoshi.288.author: steven3004
rideable-yoshi.288.description: This mod adds rideable Yoshies to the game in some levels. When you ride a Yoshi, you can travel a little faster and flutter jump across gaps. You can also get inifinite flutter jumping with a wing cap. Unfortunately, right now, Yoshies can't eat enemies, and neither can you ride one underwater. Yoshies will also use the color palette of whoever rides them, and can share the rider's Metal Cap. Though they can't have the Vanish Cap yet. This mod also comes with two commands: /YOSHI_DEBUG [on|off|host-only] Toggles a debug mode where ya can spawn stuff from the mod with a D-Pad: D-Pad Up: Yoshi Egg D-Pad Right: Yoshi Nest D-Pad Down: Yoshi /yoshi-model [on|off] Toggle between the models in the mod, and the in-game vanilla model. This mod also has a mini API that can place spawn nests around levels in ROM hacks (and only in ROM hacks for now). (Example will be uploaded later.)

livesplit64.382.title: LiveSplit64
livesplit64.382.author: Isaac0-dev
livesplit64.382.description:
This is a simple coop mod that I made in an attempt to make a LiveSplit clone. For those who don't know: "LiveSplit is a timer program for speedrunners that is both easy to use and full of features." - 
LiveSplit
 I made this because I had the idea to be able to see each other's splits on the same LiveSplit window. This coop mod syncs with each player, so you can see when someone splits in real time. It comes built in with an autosplitter, so hopefully no need to split manually at the moment. To open a simple menu, press D-pad up and C-up at the same time. On this menu, you can move the timer around to where you want. There are a few buttons, allowing you to start/stop and reset the timer, and edit splits. Splits are saved thanks to mod storage on the host's machine only, but splits are synced when players join. I'd love some feedback on this mod! This was just something I decided to make as a fun challenge, so it's not exactly overflowing with features at the moment. I hope this mod is useful!

mh-control-hunters.900.title: (MH) Control Hunters
mh-control-hunters.900.author: ProfeJavix
mh-control-hunters.900.description:
Important: MarioHunt must be loaded to use this mod

In this MH extension, runners will have a menu from which they can select and control a player from the opposing team. After selecting a hunter, the runner will control them for a period of time while the hunter spectates helplessly. When the time is up, the runner will return to their original position. But beware, if the controlled hunter dies, the runner will also die!

Mod Menu Options:

Control Seconds (5-60 seconds):
 set the period of time in which the runner can control the hunter.

Cooldown Seconds (0-30 seconds):
 set the cooldown in which the runner will have to wait to control a hunter again

Original mod idea by Drenchy. Check out his video:

geoguessr-scavenger-hunt.188.title: GeoGuessr / Scavenger Hunt
geoguessr-scavenger-hunt.188.author: EmilyEmmi
geoguessr-scavenger-hunt.188.description: GeoGuessr implemented into Super Mario 64! This game mode is somewhat similar to Hide and Seek, with a much greater emphasis on the "Hide". One player hides anywhere in the game, and the other players have to find them using picture/word clues. This mod was originally made for BizzareScape's video. This version is more robust, and includes: A built-in screenshot system Hint Mode, if you prefer words instead Multiple options for automatic hider selection Variety of settings Automatic 100% file OMM Rebirth support Automatic hiding mode, featuring everyone's favorite blue Bob-Omb Supports most, if not all rom hacks

updates.title: v2.3: Major bugfix update
updates.changelog:
Fixes some major bugs with having "Seekers OOB" on, among other things:

Fixed being able to press "L" on non-numeric options in the menu to turn them into numeric options

Fixed entering a warp door or painting in the castle being considered "OOB" and thus killing you

The host no longer dies at the start if Seeker OOB is on and Bob is selected

Fixed it being impossible for Bob to hide in Castle Main Floor or Castle Basement

Viewing a screenshot or canceling spectate while underwater no longer snaps you to the surface

updates.title: v2.2: Tiny fix
updates.changelog:
Sorry for the hotfix, I was playing Star Road with this and getting frustrated.

Bob can no longer hide on painting warps

The music track hint will no longer appear in rom hacks

An area is now "hot" if it either has lava bubbles or is a sandy area (previously, it was hot if it had lava bubbles or used the "Hot" music track).

For vanilla, this means that the pyramid in Shifting Sand Land is no longer considered hot.

For rom hacks, this means that desert areas should be properly detected now (as well as warm beaches being included).

updates.title: v2.1: Small update
updates.changelog:
Small update to fix some things and add more customizability to Bob:

Added "Auto Hide Settings" to the bottom of the settings menu, which features some old settings related to the auto hide feature, along with these new ones:

Bob Screenshot Count: How many screenshots Bob sends in Screenshot mode. Defaults to Max (sends as many as time allows)

Bob Hint Count: Same as above, but with hints in Hint mode.

Bob Starting Hints: How many hints Bob sends at the start of Hint mode. Defaults to 1.

Fixed Bob giving only 2 hints if the seeking time was set to Infinite.

Fixed auto-hints erroneously labeling Bowser In The Fire Sea as not containing Goombas.

The spawn point hint now refers to the "start point" to make it more clear that it considers the closest floor.

The start point for Dire, Dire Docks is now at the surface of the water instead of in the whirlpool.

This hint won't appear in Wet-Dry World since the start point varies.

instant
 quicksand". This is just a wording change- the hint always referred specifically to instant quicksand.

updates.title: v2.0: Much-needed update
updates.changelog:

Improved stability: Many changes to make games more stable. It should now be more viable to play this with a full lobby.

New settings: Turn off the skybox, force vanilla cam, and more.

Hints Only mode: Now the "/ Scavenger Hunt" actually makes sense. Provide hints to your fellow players instead.

Auto-Hide: Want to play solo, or sick of players taking pictures of the skybox for the millionth time? Have everyone's favorite blue Bob-Omb, Bob, hide in a random location.

Many other QoL features

classic-doom-weapons.848.title: Classic Doom Weapons
classic-doom-weapons.848.author: Pseudonym929
classic-doom-weapons.848.description: 12 Weapons from Doom, Doom II, and Doom 64 Includes randomized weapon and ammo spawns, custom hitboxes for handing attacks, HUD for ammo and powerups, and improved first person camera X and Y to switch between weapons ​ Weapons: Fist incl. Berserk powerup Chainsaw Pistol Shotgun Super Shotgun Chaingun Rocket Launcher Plasma Gun BFG9000 Unmaker incl. Demon Key upgrades must be enabled via chat command Incinerator must be enabled via chat command Calamity Blade must be enabled via chat command Items: Pickups of all weapons excl. fist and pistol, which are available at start Clip (+10 bullets) Shotgun Shells (+4 shells) Rocket (+1 rocket) Plasma Cell (+20 plasma) Fuel Can (+10 fuel) Berserk provides full heal remains active until player exits area (red haze is just a visual effect) Backpack (+10 bullets, +4 shells, + 1 rocket, +20 plasma, +10 fuel) doubles ammo capacity (1 time only) +1 Secret item per area Commands: /unmaker (true/false): Toggles Unmaker and Demon Key spawns (server owner only) /lor (on/off/mix): Toggles Incinerator, Calamity Blade, and fuel spawns. "on" causes them to replace the plasma weapons (plasma cells will remain if Unmaker is enabled), "mix" enables spawning of all weapons and ammo types (server owner only) /vertspread (true/false): Toggles vertical spread for the shotgun and chaingun (server owner only) /msglimit (0 - 99): Maximum number of pickup messages /msgtime (0-600): # of Seconds a pickup message will remain on screen /altitemnames (true/false): changes the names of certain items to be more technically accurate (in case that kind of thing bothers you) /maxitems (any nonnegative integer): changes the maximum number of items that can appear in an area, useful if you're playing a romhack with big levels (server owner only) /spawns base ( any nonnegative integer ): changes the number of weapons that spawn in an area at 0 stars (server owner only) /spawns starbonus (any positive integer): changes how many stars the player(s) need to have for an extra weapon spawn, to disable, set to an unreachably high number (server owner only) /spawns secret (any nonnegative integer): changes the number of secrets that spawns in an area (server owner only) /intermission (doom, doom2, doom64, off): changes or disables the intermission screen /pistolstart (true/false): Toggles Pistol Start. Players will start every level with just a pistol and fists (server owner only) +4 cheats from the original games (server owner only) Note: This has not been extensively tested in multiplayer. Bugs are likely to occur.

updates.title: 1.3 Update: Legacy of Rust & Various Fixes
updates.changelog:
Changes:

Added the Incinerator and Calamity Blade from 
Legacy of Rust
, along with the fuel ammo type. Like the Unmaker, these must be enabled with a command before they will spawn.

Added the /lor command to enable the above. "on" will have them replace the Plasma Gun and BFG9k, "mix" will allow all four weapons to spawn. (Plasma cells will still spawn if the Unmaker is enabled)

Added the /pistolstart command. Enabling will cause any weapons picked up by players to be removed upon leaving the level.

Sprites now use the G_TF_POINT filter.

Fixes:

Fixed interactions with Pokeys

Fixed the ACT_FIRE_SHOTGUN_AIRBORNE action

updates.title: 1.21 Update: Intermission fixes and New Commands
updates.changelog:
Changes:

Added the /maxitems and /spawns commands, which server owners can use to spawn more or fewer items.

Fixes:

Fixed a softlock caused by intermission screens in levels with no enemies/items/secrets.

Intermission screens should now display the correct total value.

updates.title: 1.2 Update: Intermissions, Strafing, and miscellaneous fixes.
updates.changelog:
Changes:

Added Intermissions:

Exiting a stage via a star or key triggers an Intermission Screen. These work roughly the same way that Doom 1+2's does, minus the Par times.

The /intermission command can be used to choose between the intermissions for Doom (default), Doom II, or Doom 64. Intermissions can also be disabled with the command.

Significantly improved the standing firing states, allowing for strafing and seamless transitions between standing and walking while firing.

The messages that appear the first time you enter BOB, WF, CCM, and BITDW have been changed to provide advice for new players (will not appear in romhacks).

Made the chainsaw slightly less useless.

Bugfixes:

Fixed interactions with Bob-omb Buddies

Fixed King Bob-omb and Chuckyas ignoring certain projectiles

Issues caused by MIPS have been dealt with...

updates.title: 1.05 Update: Backpacks & Spawning Fixes
updates.changelog:
Changes:

Added Backpacks as a rare ammo pickup (1 in 4 chance 1 will spawn after collecting 24 Stars)

Items will spawn in most areas again

updates.title: 1.01 Update: Multiplayer fixes
updates.changelog:
Changes:

Items are no longer synced, so it should be easier for individual players to find weapons and ammo.

Fixed a bug that affected firing actions in multiplayer.

updates.changelog:
Some minor fixes, with some relating to custom characters.

Adding a missing Koopa Paratroopa to D-1 that prevented the level from being possible in single player

Fixed a script error if all players died in a level while bubbles were enabled

Made the modfs create itself immediately upon loading the mod if it doesn't exist

updates.title: v2.0: One-Year (late) Anniversary! MASSIVE UPDATE!
updates.changelog:
In case you missed it last year (since I presented it as a shoddy rom hack), this is a port of Super Mario Bros. to sm64coopdx, with the goal of being a decently-accurate port. This HUGE update brings tons of new features, including widescreen support, new server options, and even a new port of Lost Levels! Here are the biggest new features:

Lost Levels: Super Mario Bros. 2 (JPN), the notoriously difficult sequel, is now playable! Thank goodness I added an infinite lives option.

Custom character support: Supports Character Select integration, as well as including its own character system. You can even load characters from modFs, allowing you to use characters in any lobby! Check out so_retro_example_char.zip for more.

Editor + API overhaul: The editor has been reworked to be much more useable, and a highly robust API has been added. As much as I would have liked to have a bunch of example mods ready to go, I've been working on this for far too long, so they will have to wait.

MarioHunt support!?: Yes, really. Unfortunately, there may be some minor quirks until the next version of MarioHunt releases.

(NOTE: Main mod is so_retro.zip)

gore-frogger.252.title: Gore/Frogger!
gore-frogger.252.author: TheIncredibleHolc
gore-frogger.252.description:
A meteor has ruined your home, and now you must clear your way through dangerous random obstacles to find a new pond! There are a total of 7 different spawn-able obstacles, 5 of which will be randomly picked and spawned each round. This is a spin-off of our upcoming Gore/Hardmode mod, so expect blood and splats. PvP IS ENABLED, so knock each other around to ensure your own survival!

KNOWN BUGS: 
Due to extreme time constraints, some of these bugs were unable to be fixed in time. These will be updated and fixed in the near future!

-CoopNet jank will sometimes think players are crushed by Thwomps when they aren't. This can break rounds. If needed, type /Reset to force the round to end.

-Waluigi's hat will show up when he's on fire.

-Some objects (like blood particles) will double and triple as more players join.

Credits:

@TheIncredibleHolc
  (me!) - Started the project, programmed most of the mod and game-mode concepts. Made all the models and environments in blender, though Birdekek is a much better 3D artists and touched up the texture work.

@Cooliokid 956
  - Coolio did a lot of heavy lifting on some of the crazier functions, like raycasts with the hunter obstacle, custom camera work, and some other secret stuff. Frankly, this mod would not have been possible without his expertise! He's one of the smartest here, if not the best.

@birdekek
  - After I initially modeled all the obstacles, Birdekek did a full map cleanup with new textures and got everything looking 100x better.

@frijoles.z64
 
- Modeled the original Frog Mario custume, and did an absolutely amazing job at it! It also served as a template for the other frog characters.

@birdekek
  and 
Tilly
- For creating the other frog costume models of the remaining 4 selectable characters. Tilly has been especially helpful in her blender knowledge and has saved us on quite a few occasions!

@Warioplier
  - For creating a very nice 3D model of a pickup truck for the traffic obstacle. He also added Toad as the truck driver. Nice touch! 

And lastly, shoutout to the rest of the Gore team for keeping Gore projects tight-lipped and for providing valuable feedback, ideas, and testing: 
@Blocky
 , 
Saniky
, 
I'myourcat
, 
@Keeberghrh
 .. (You will see more from these guys in Gore/Hardmode, coming soon!)

Or sleeping in.

One of the two.

Martlet from Undertale Yellow is now playable in SM64 COOPDX!
​
This character mod includes:
​

Recolorability!

Custom voice lines by Ciozio!

Custom Cap in the form of the Royal Guard Guidebook!

Custom Lives and Stars icons, Power Meter, and Celebration Star!

Custom animations!

Custom moveset!

The odd feeling that she fits into this game a little TOO well!

Think about it!

And maybe more to come...?

Moveset Details
​

The power of flight! Martlet can fly without the need of a Wing Cap by pressing A in midair during a Triple Jump (or, of course, by using a cannon), but watch your Stamina Meter!

She gets five seconds of flight time without the Cap, and afterwards she starts falling like a... well, if you know, you know. Touching the ground, splashing into deep water, or using a cannon will fully restore Stamina, grabbing onto a pole in midair restores one second, and grabbing a coin restores half a second!

Pitching down won't speed you up much, and pitching up is... not recommended.

If you have some Stamina left, dive during a midair Ground Pound by pressing B. At the cost of one second, you can trigger flight again! Use this to get extra height or reach, or to easily change directions! Also, press A during 
any
 dive to trigger flight as well!

Press A during a midair Ground Pound to Long Jump instead! This risky move costs two seconds and is technically against safety protocol, but with good timing, you can use it to Wall Kick! Just remember: you can't Ground Pound during a Long Jump! Make sure it's worth the risk!

If you bonk into a wall while flying, hold A to flutter and slow your descent just like you would with the Wing Cap! This won't work if you're Long Jumping, though!

Triple Jump out of Ground Pounds by pressing A upon landing!

Martlet can fly 
ANYWHERE
 with the Wing Cap! Forget about air traffic control, no-fly zones, and Stamina Meters, the sky is 
YOURS! 
Pitch up as high as you want! Pitch down to go as fast as you want! This bird's gotta fly!

Be sure to follow safety protocol by pressing A to brake when necessary!

You'll keep flying if the Wing Cap wears off, but you'll have only three seconds of Stamina left. Get to a safe place to land!

Rumor has it that someone who shares vague similarities to Martlet may grant her something a bit better this time.

Additional Credits:
​

Team UTY (Character)

Emmalume (Design)

Ciozio 
(Voice Acting)

ZenderTroop
 (Additional Assistance, Humoring Me)

Kody
 (Bob-Omb Protocol)

Make sure you have Character Select Version 1.12 in order to use this mod!​

toetagger.1206.title: ToeTagger
toetagger.1206.author: codeflex
toetagger.1206.description:
ToeTagger is a simple, customizable utility mod that adds a HUD panel which tracks and displays useful live information about all players in the session, and adds floating health bars over other players!

FEATURES:

Colored health bars and HUD elements that match character select colors

Mod menu options that customize the displayed info, health bar scaling type, and more

Health bars display damaged (yellow) and critical (red) health levels

Displays the name of the current romhack, and what caps have been unlocked

Live tracking of players coin tallies, lives counter, current speed, personal star counter, course number, course name, and current star selected

Perfect for PVP DEATHMATCH mod

Displays current NUZLOCKer pool icons (coming soon!)

Compatibility with AFKer (coming soon!)

NEW 2.0 FEATURES:

- RED COINS & 'SECRETS' TRACKER: added an option to independently display both red coins and secrets found in the current level on the ToeTagger panel

- LOWER SIDEBAR: an option to manually lower the ToeTagger sidebar, just in case of custom HUDs. The panel will also automatically lower to accommodate MMX character's custom HUDs.

- POWER-UP MARKER !: Displays a cap-color matched '!' next to the player's health bar on the panel, and next to their in-world character tag

- NAV MARKING Z + DPAD UP: Allows you to place a nav marking that all other players in that level can see and navigate towards. If a star is marked, a star icon will instead appear.

- PLAYER NAV LINES: Adds UI lines that direct you towards other players, with a few different settings:

OFF = Lines are always off

ON = Lines are always on

FAR ONLY = Lines only appear for players who are farther away

DPAD DOWN = Only displays lines when DPAD DOWN is pressed

AFK = Only appears when AFK mode is activated with AFKer ( CURRENTLY DOESNT NOT FUNCTION)

BUBBLE ONLY = Only displays lines when your character is bubbled

- Another option 'ALWAYS SHOW NAV LINES WHEN BUBBLED' will always display lines when bubbled independent of the above setting

- MARK LEARNED ENTRANCES: When a player enters a level, it adds a visible nav point to that entrance. This is learned on a savefile basis, and per romhack basis; if the romhack is changed, or other errors occur you should make sure to use the RESET LEARNED NAV DATA option.

SHOW PLAYERS IN LEVEL: Adds a nav marker to level markers showing if another player is currently in there

(testing thanks: Jxsh, TheDemonChara, Swagmaster, ZenoTheBlueberry and Dukurow)

cs-gabys-modding-frenzy.1109.title: [CS] Gaby's Modding Frenzy
cs-gabys-modding-frenzy.1109.author: Gabrimer
cs-gabys-modding-frenzy.1109.description: Welcome aboard, to my Modding Frenzy! ​ This mod project involves the idea I had at the beginning of the year, which was to make a year-long inspired project, adding multiple different sets of characters into SM64COOPDX! The character selection that I'm making is mostly either OCs I've made, or other characters from my friend's games/projects. That being said, I understand this modpack might not interest most people, but I figured I'd share my work here, as I am happy with what I've made! (and it'd be nice seeing other people play with these characters) I'm releasing each modpack on a monthly basis, with each pack having a certain theme to it, either being characters from a certain game, or characters from a similar origin/story. I'll be posting whenever I release a month's pack on my socials, then updating this mod page to include that pack! It's worth noting that some packs won't be included in this mod page, for reasons such as an OC's author not wanting public access to these character mods, or anything related to the sort. With that out of the way, let me introduce you to our character selection! ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- February - Aria Skies Character Pack​ This month's pack is none other than the fighters from Aria Skies ! As a way to celebrate the game's first anniversary, I decided to dedicate this month to the character pack. Includes:​ 7 new characters (with custom Character Select graffiti and music track) Red Erika Feng Starre Khaed Wolske Bilksem Unique costumes for each character based on their different color palettes from the original game! March - Jam Character Pack​ For March, we have a selection of characters that originated from game jams! This volume includes characters from H.A.R. VEST , Moon Munchies , and Date Summons . Includes:​ 5 new characters (with custom Character Select graffiti and music track) Jason Mipp Lola May Manat April - WiddlePets Pack​ For April, we got something a little different than the previous packs. This time around, I decided to work on some pets that can follow you around the game! These pets specifically are: Eunice (from Aria Skies ) Heaven's Lawbook (from Wrong Sentence ) Crescent (from Eiffel Axis ) Red Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Green Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Blue Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Pink Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Orange Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) May - So Retro! Support​ And for May, I added So Retro! compatibility. Currently, compatibility has been added to just a few characters, but I already planned out some updates to include the rest of the cast! Added So Retro! support for Gaby Added So Retro! support for Ollie Added So Retro! support for Poko Added So Retro! support for Mipp Added So Retro! support for Jason ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- So far, this project includes the February, March, April, and May modpacks (January was a private release between my friends and me), but as I mentioned previously, I'll be adding new characters each month, so be on the lookout for that! Link to Gaby's SM64COOP Modding Frenzy Playlist! Credits:​ Gabrimer: Mod Creator, Character Modeller, CS Music Track Composer, Coder Pokopish: Aria Skies Creator, Original Hat Modeller & Graffiti/Life Icon Artist Squishy6094: Character Select Creator VioletSM64: Additional support for So Retro! compatibility Remember that this mod requires Character Select for it to work!​ ---------- ---------- ---------- ---------- ----------

updates.title: APRIL & MAY PACK RELEASE - WiddlePets & So Retro!
updates.changelog: Hi folks! So yeah, kinda had some things going on lately, which made me miss not one, but two months altogether, oops. Better late than never, though, right? APRIL PACK RELEASE - WiddlePets Gaby Pack​ For April, we got something a little different than the previous packs. This time around, I decided to work on some pets that can follow you around the game! These pets specifically are: Eunice (from Aria Skies ) Heaven's Lawbook (from Wrong Sentence ) Crescent (from Eiffel Axis ) Red Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Green Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Blue Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Pink Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Orange Bobberman (from Bobbermen ) Have fun playing around with them! MAY PACK RELEASE - So Retro! Compatibility​ And for May, I worked on something VERY different. Ever since So Retro! v2.0 came out, I've kept an eye on the project, and I eventually decided it was too good of an idea not to include in our modding frenzy. The idea is for future packs to already release with compatibility for this game mode, although depending on how well the coming months go, that may be hit or miss. We'll see! Currently, compatibility has been added to just a few characters, but I already planned out some updates to include the rest of the cast! Added So Retro! support for Gaby Added So Retro! support for Ollie Added So Retro! support for Poko Added So Retro! support for Mipp Added So Retro! support for Jason In the end, these two updates releasing together wasn't such a terrible thing, as both are kind of "gimmick packs" rather than actual playable characters, compared to the previous months. Here's to future packs! (and hopefully releasing them on the correct deadline too, haha)

updates.title: Version 2.0 - Custom Games
updates.changelog:
This is a complete overhaul of Hide and Seek DX, so several changes were made. This update adds in a custom pause menu used for Customizable Games, as well as two new modes: Region and Elimination.

REGION MODE:

- Region Mode is a set of courses played within a segment of the game. Example: Basement Region starts you in the castle basement, and players can go in all basement courses; you cannot go upstairs.

ELIMINATION MODE:

- Inspired by the contest videos on YouTube. Tagged hiders are out of the game, and seekers can still be assigned by the host. Best paired with the "Last Hider Wins" option.

CUSTOMIZABLE OPTIONS:

Autohost for 24/7 Capabilities.

Elimination & Last Hider Wins.

Split Up Time, Round Time, and Hider Exits.

Player List and Course List for Full-Game/Region rounds.

Wing Caps, Shells, Cannons, and BLJs.

updates.title: Version 1.1
updates.changelog:
The v1.1 update for Hide and Seek DX does the following:

FULL-GAME

Player List can now be used in Full-Game Mode if the host enables it; Use /playerlist to toggle.

Infinite Lives to disable the "Game Over" warp in Full-Game Mode.

Course List has improved presentation.

GENERAL

PVP has been reworked for greater stability, pacing, and balance.

Hiders have more time to disperse.

Camera Collision is now forced on to prevent X-Raying.

Tweaked time increments to be more balanced with less players.

Tweaked the HUD to take up less space on the screen.

Removed desync fix attempt, which was causing problems rather than helping.

COURSES

Castle Grounds is now the initial course, fixing Full-Game spawn-in when connecting.

Whomp's Fortress is reduced to a 90-second start time.

duels.9.title: Duels
duels.9.author: EmilyEmmi
duels.9.description:
This add-on mod lets players engage with 1v1 battles with each other at any time! Simply type /duel [player name] to request a duel! Other commands include:

/forceduel [NAME|ID,NAME|ID] - As a host or moderator, force two players to battle.

/bestof [NUM] - Set the amount of wins needed for a match.

/sky [0-2] - Set the background and music for a match.

/time [SEC] - Set the time until Sudden Death.

/forfeit - Leave a duel.

/spectate-duel [NAME|ID] - Spectate another duel.

You can also enter "random" for /duel and /forceduel to pick a random player. 
Do NOT use with game modes.

arena-facing-castles.652.title: Arena - Facing Castles
arena-facing-castles.652.author: BuckleyTim
arena-facing-castles.652.description:
I've had this map idea for a long time and thankfully I finally got the time set aside to make it reality.

Facing Castles is an Arena map made specifically for CTF (you can try the other modes on this map but they won't play well, if arena ever gives me the ability to lock off game modes per level i'll probably do that to save me a headache or two). As many can tell, it's inspired by UT's Facing Worlds, but it's not a 1:1 recreation. Instead, this map tries to emulate the vibe level design wise (and music wise, as the music included is Splash Canyon from Sonic Riders - breakbeats 4 lyfe <3)

The result is a ctf level design that some might hate but others will love. Either way, I hope y'all get some kind of enjoyment out of this remix of the most iconic location from the n64!

despair-marios-gambit.103.title: Despair Mario’s Gambit
despair-marios-gambit.103.author: Ex Coop Mods Archive
despair-marios-gambit.103.description:
Original Post: July 12, 2022

Author: Sunk

Romhack by GMD.

There are 120 stars in this large romhack.

Slight warning that the credits course will be very laggy.

Known issues/inconsistencies:

Courses 9 and 12 are a bit fuzzy since there’s an issue with fog.

There are no actors since for some reason they didn’t want to work.

The first bowser fight has a starting textbox, which isn’t in the original hack.

Course 15 has a star select screen, which isn’t in the original hack.

There is no gate preventing Bowser 2 from being killed without going through the whole stage.

The hack has aglab camera; this port doesn’t.

Despair Mario's Gambit Update 
Romhack created by GMD Category: Romhack Overall improved experience: Now uses custom skyboxes Changed camera mode from 8 directional to romhack Stars now spawn in precisely the correct place (ignoring off-by-1 error)Added preview blue coins Course 15 no longer has an act selector Loading times should overall improve

Despair Mario's Gambit 
Quick update...literally (made loading a bit faster by not having unnecessary files)Also small changes Category: Romhack Making this update now because I've seen more people host this hack.

Despair Mario's Gambit
 update

Bowser 1 fight no longer shows the cutscene

Bowser fight entry cutscenes are disabled in this hack normally, but disabling it also removes the textbox. The bowser 1 fight was not supposed to have a textbox, so this is fine, but the bowser 2 fight does.

Fixed bowser 2 fight script errors

Bowser no longer moves in the bowser 2 fight

This is in the original romhack

In bowser 2 fight, there is now a metal box that blocks bowser's tail. This box can only be removed by usage of the switch at the top of the level. Before this, you could skip that entire climb since the gate couldn't block the throw.

The floor below the bomb in the bowser 2 fight now exists.

kings-devtools.339.title: King's Devtools
kings-devtools.339.author: king the memer
kings-devtools.339.description: While developing King I realized it was often a pain in the ass to test certain things, so I thought id compile some neat tools together that anyone can use with ease to test their mods CONTROLS: D-Pad Up - Toggle Debug Movement D-Pad Down - Toggle Stats Display D-Pad Left - Open Level Select D-Pad Right - Open Cap/Power Select DEBUG MOVEMENT: Use the debug movement to quickly travel through any level without taking damage It can also open doors A - Go Up Z - Go Down B - Move Faster STATS DISPLAY: Use these stats to test custom actions, determine exact positions to place objects, and more SPD - m.forwardVel VEL - m.vel POS - m.pos ANG - m.faceAngle ACT - m.action LEVEL SELECT: D-Pad Up/Down - Switch Level D-Pad Left/Right - Switch Star/Act A - Confirm B - Exit CAP/POWER SELECT: The Klepto option sends Mario's cap to Klepto in Shifting Sand Land (to test capless models) D-Pad Left/Right - Switch Cap A - Confirm B - Exit L MODE: When enabled, the tools are only active when holding L If not holding L the D-Pad will do nothing and the Devtools icons will be fully hidden

marios-body-states.1252.description:
CLICK HERE FOR GAMEBANANA PAGE

Giving Mario more eye and hands states because why not? 

Eye states are incompatible with Render96 player model pack due to Render96 not having the unused Mario eye states! Animations with unused eye states with Render96 player models would just have the eyes closed instead (unless if you are using the v4.0 models).

Render96 player model users should disable eye states in the mod menu!

This is just a small project with 420 lines of code because I was bored and I wanna try doing something new. I also play SM64 CoopDX a lot and I plan on making more mods for it

cs-carl-wheezer-64.507.description: Carl Wheezer , the biggest fan of Jimmy Neutron's mom in the entire universe and gobbler of unfinished croissants the world over, now infesting your copy of Mario 64 with friends and making terrible noises just like in the show. Nobody else seems to have done it yet, and I've always been a fan of bringing horrible things to life via blender, so here you go. Comes with: Custom voicelines of highly-variable compression and quality from 5 different Jimmy Neutron shovelware games Palette support on his skin and hair under appropriate palette categories, facial decal is not amazing but I did my best Llama life count icon for proper theming, Carl does love his llamas after all Hat model is himself, to represent finally acquiring his long absent self-confidence and using it to rise above the challenges before him (and definitely not because I still have yet to find a fix for that, promise) Carefully-named internal files to minimize the risk that you'll miss out on hearing Carl's beautiful voice because another CS mod shares filenames in its voice system No script errors that I could find anywhere, after way too much trial-and-error figuring out why it was calling in the lua file for a custom health HUD that this mod doesn't have Credits: Garrulous64 - This excellent tutorial video I used to make this from scratch by following it, along with the "Fast64 GART" plugin for blender and multiple different template resources linked in the video description. If you want to make your own CS mod, I strongly recommend taking a look at it and the linked resources, they help immensely. TheVGResource , specifically Models Resource and Sounds Resource - Model + Sounds daneeklu on OpenGameArt - Pixel art llama sprite used for the lives icon Emerald and Squishy , on the coop mod discussion channel of the discord server - Tons of help with understanding and fixing bugs with the mod while I worked on it My pal Steveski - Testing, troubleshooting and moral support

sonics-ultimate-genesis-music-pack.631.title: Sonic's Ultimate Genesis Music Pack!
sonics-ultimate-genesis-music-pack.631.author: FlyerMations
sonics-ultimate-genesis-music-pack.631.description:
Sonic's Ultimate Genesis Music Pack!

This music pack replaces the following songs in-game to songs from across many genesis titles!

Note: I wanted to get this out as soon as possible (it's a bit incomplete), and also tried to refrain from mainly using Sonic the Hedgehog songs (i tried my hardest). It was extremely rushed so it's a bit scuffed.

List of songs and their replacements:

Castle = Main Menu (Sega Genesis Mini)

Bob Omb Battlefield = Shooting Ristar (Ristar)

Whomp's Fortress = Bonanza Elegy (Bonanza Bros.)

Cool, Cool Mountain = Ring Rink (Ristar)

Jolly Roger Bay = Splash Down!! (Ristar)

Princess' Secret Slide = Ready.. Go!! (Ristar)

Tower of the Wing Cap = Du! Di! Da! (Ristar)

Bowser in the Dark World = Bonanza Suspense Theatre (Bonanza Bros.)

Bowser in the Dark World (Fight) = Battle (Ristar)

Lethal Lava Land = Busy Flare (Ristar)

Shifting Sand Land = Sandopolis Zone (Act 1) (Sonic 3 & Knuckles)

Hazy Maze Cave = Mystic Cave Zone (2-Player) (Sonic the Hedgehog 2)

Dire, Dire Docks = Seascape (Knuckles' Chaotix)

Bowser in the Fire Sea = Castle (Alex Kidd in the Enchanted Castle)

Bowser in the Fire Sea (Fight) = Boss (Streets of Rage)

Tall, Tall Mountain = Mushroom Hill Zone (Act 1) (Sonic 3 & Knuckles)

Wet Dry World = Labyrinth Zone (Sonic the Hedgehog)

Snowman's Land = Ice Scream (Ristar)

Tick Tock Clock = Ready.. Go!! (Ristar)

Bowser in the Sky = Stage 7 (Streets of Rage)

Bowser in the Sky (Fight) = Stage 13 (Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine)

Credits = Credits (Ristar)

if you have any suggestions for the mod please let me know i am out of ideas

cs-doki-doki-literature-club-characters..title: [CS] Doki Doki Literature Club Characters!
cs-doki-doki-literature-club-characters..author: GalacticalXenon
cs-doki-doki-literature-club-characters..description: I'll get Natsuki done eventually, I promise. If you find the voices too loud, download "QuieterVoices.zip" and drag its "sound" folder into "char-select-ddlc," replacing the mod's sounds with quieter versions. Adds 3 characters, Sayori, Monika, and Yuri, all voiced! Sayori uses the voice of Nepgear from Hyperdimension Neptunia, Monika uses the voice of Kaede Akamatsu from Danaganronpa V3, and Yuri uses the voice of Tifa Lockhart from FF7 remake. Made using the blender character template found on the coop-deluxe github page, plus the Character Select custom character template.

updates.title: Version 2!!!
updates.changelog:
-Added Yuri!! She uses the voice of Tifa from the FF7 remake, I feel it suits her decently well, and has plenty of voice lines to use.

-Heavily increased quality of all textures. If you prefer the more pixel art look of the older version, sorry about that...

- Added new voice lines to Monika. Her voice kinda sucked since Kaede had no attack noises or anything like that, so I added some lines from Ann from Persona 5, as she has the same voice actor. They mesh well together, and now she has lines that actually make sense for jumping and attacking.

-Added custom healthbar, I plan to make different per-doki ones later on (at least changing the color of the heart) Also, the health heart is like half a pixel misaligned?? Its using the same resolution as the original texture so i have no idea why its like that. I'll try to fix it later.

arena-twin-castle-siege.404.title: Arena - Twin Castle Siege
arena-twin-castle-siege.404.author: BuckleyTim
arena-twin-castle-siege.404.description:
So this is an experimental-ish Arena map. It's primarily centered around CTF gameplay (though you can play other modes on it- maybe not king of the hill though as of this writing). It also has large bodies of water as it's major gimmick. Maybe you might want to enable faster swimming with this? I wouldn't know the first thing about balancing for water as a gimmick.

...Which is why I'm uploading this map in an unfinished state (omitting stuff like custom music and a skybox) as I hope to garner a bit of player feedback for this map. Let me know what you guys think of it so I can fine-tune it.

Have a fun time fragging!

----

Known bugs so far:

- One of the springs causes script errors despite working perfectly fine. I am unsure why.

-Animations for the arena weapons bugs out hard while in a swimming state. Nothing unplayable though visually it doesn't work right.

-KOTH hill doesn't spawn sometimes

asterix.534.title: Asterix
asterix.534.author: Aso-Designer
asterix.534.description:
"Asterix est là!"

The famous gaul warrior hero created by french comic artists Rene Goscinny and Albert Uderzo is now available in Mario 64! Assets are all from Mario 64, with custom textures and custom elements (like the belt and the helmet's top) done by me. 

Voice clips are straight from few of the Asterix animated movies, in the original french dub (voiced by the late Roger Carel who did Asterix during 4 decades)

Enjoy the mod as I enjoyed working on it!

Asterix (c) Rene Goscinny and Albert Uderzo

cs-grey-man.546.title: [CS] Grey Man
cs-grey-man.546.author: CornObjects
cs-grey-man.546.description: In the year 1998, a strange and unique little game named LSD: Dream Emulator came out on the PS1 only in Japan, based on a dream journal and the bizarre experiences chronicled within. Despite how locally-restricted its release was and how niche its focus, as well as frankly being clunky as all hell mechanically, it still ended up becoming a cult classic of sorts, including one particular rare entity found within gaining notoriety of its own; The Grey Man, one of the few truly-dangerous things you could come across on your dream journeys. One which ignored all obstacles to make its way forward slowly and menacingly, ending your dream instantly if you make contact. A total enigma, beyond the fact that it was as strange as it was scary. Anyways, that's enough gaming history and mysteries, now you get to watch this spooky entity do sick jumps and fly around with wings on his hat while making funny noises. Plus, he's finally in a game with decent FPS and controls by default. Features: Complete custom palette recolorability, including a bonus when hat is removed Full custom hat model set (including hat removal for vulture/monkey/OMM/etc.) Custom lives icon, as is tradition An entire set of sounds cut from SFX and audio snippets used in LSD itself, mainly the base audio clips that the strange randomized music in-game is built out of, so GM's "voice" is basically the music of the game in a sense Integration with the "Character Movesets" mod, GM uses the Waluigi moveset and can double-jump, swim in the air by diving mid-air multiple times and takes extra damage from hits (can be changed easily with one simple edit in the main.lua file, the zip includes a readme with info on how) Maybe some slight jank here and there (did my best to avoid it though)​ Credits: TheVGResource - Models, Textures and Audio "LSD Dreamy Texture Pack" by BTL Games on itch.io - The image used for the lives icon, specifically "8.png" from the "faces" folder, downscaled to 64x from 1024x original I'mYourCat on the CoopDX discord server - Helping me fix yet another annoying metal material bug that was preventing export in blender, by taking a look at my blend file and telling me what workaround I needed to do to fix it

cs-deltarune-ch4-secret-boss-moveset.758.title: [CS] Deltarune Ch4 Secret boss (+ Moveset!)
cs-deltarune-ch4-secret-boss-moveset.758.author: SwagSkeleton95
cs-deltarune-ch4-secret-boss-moveset.758.description: Your browser is not able to display this video. The secret boss from chapter 4 busts his way into Mario 64! Originally just a model swap mod, coding help from Baconator2558 ( Youtube ) and @Kaktus64 ( Bluesky ) with voice acting from Starwarrior64 ( Twitter , Youtube ) it's become something a bit more than t hat . THIS MOD FEATURES: Full recolorability Custom UI graphics Bowser moveset compatibility (Shell slide) Voice acting (Toggle between voice acted lines and game sounds!) A brand new moveset integrating the TP bar mechanic from the original game A tough-as-nails challenge mode that forces you to use your moveset against Bowser in a deadly game of tennis Optional alternate skyboxes for the bowser levels A small example mod to show how you can use the moveset's TP bar or rude buster in your own mod (Lancer approved!) Be sure to check the mod menu to toggle most of these options! MOVESET While Gerson uses the standard moveset, using the Hammer Of Justice costume will give you access to a special moveset consisting of 4 new moves. Hammer Spin: Press Z + A mid-air to bounce yourself into a powerful hammer spin! Great for movement, good for crushing enemies. Costs 6 TP to use. Shell Groundpound: Performing a ground pound with enough TP will send two koopa shells from your sides! Good for taking out small groups of enemies. Costs 1 TP to use. Dive Roll: Holding Z after a dive lets Gerson roll to keep his momentum and extend the slide. Justice Buster: Press Z + B to unleash your most powerful attack: the mighty Justice Buster! This attack costs 33 TP to use, but is very powerful against most enemies. The projectile will home in on any nearby targets and swiftly strike them down. This move is necessary against Bowser in the challenge mode! REQUIRES WIBBLUS' BOWSER MOVESET - Shell slide: Shell slide from the Bowser Moveset. Replaces the slide kick. TP BAR The moveset's main feature is the new TP bar, which is used to perform Gerson's special moves. TP is spent by using moveset moves, but can be regained by collecting coins, defeating enemies, collecting stars, swinging Bowser by the tail or entering new levels. Or, if you would prefer, the mod provides a (host-exclusive) option to regenerate TP automatically at a quick rate, allowing you to use your moves as much as you please. LANCER Huh- Lancer? The mod comes with a small example mod featuring Lancer. Open it up to get an example of how to use this mod's TP bar and rude buster for your own characters! This will require the Gerson Boom mod as a dependency.

Be sure to check the mod menu to toggle most of these options! MOVESET While Gerson uses the standard moveset, using the Hammer Of Justice costume will give you access to a special moveset consisting of 4 new moves. Hammer Spin: Press Z + A mid-air to bounce yourself into a powerful hammer spin! Great for movement, good for crushing enemies. Costs 6 TP to use. Shell Groundpound: Performing a ground pound with enough TP will send two koopa shells from your sides! Good for taking out small groups of enemies. Costs 1 TP to use. Dive Roll: Holding Z after a dive lets Gerson roll to keep his momentum and extend the slide. Justice Buster: Press Z + B to unleash your most powerful attack: the mighty Justice Buster! This attack costs 33 TP to use, but is very powerful against most enemies. The projectile will home in on any nearby targets and swiftly strike them down. This move is necessary against Bowser in the challenge mode! REQUIRES WIBBLUS' BOWSER MOVESET - Shell slide: Shell slide from the Bowser Moveset. Replaces the slide kick. TP BAR The moveset's main feature is the new TP bar, which is used to perform Gerson's special moves. TP is spent by using moveset moves, but can be regained by collecting coins, defeating enemies, collecting stars, swinging Bowser by the tail or entering new levels. Or, if you would prefer, the mod provides a (host-exclusive) option to regenerate TP automatically at a quick rate, allowing you to use your moves as much as you please. LANCER Huh- Lancer? The mod comes with a small example mod featuring Lancer. Open it up to get an example of how to use this mod's TP bar and rude buster for your own characters! This will require the Gerson Boom mod as a dependency.

super-mario-128.619.title: Super Mario 128
super-mario-128.619.author: jonathanoflebones
super-mario-128.619.description: We both thought the same, but nope, it's not the gamecube tech demo! This is an old piece of romhacking history. Super Mario 128 is a ROM hack created by RJWaters2, and released in 2008. It is one of the oldest SM64 ROM hacks which uses modified levels from the original game, and was highly known for its extreme puzzle-platforming difficulty level. The hack was sadly discontinued, only leaving this 16 Star demo, however, there's extra levels that were modified which you can access, bringing up the total to 52 possible stars.

minecraft-music-mod.324.title: Minecraft Music Mod
minecraft-music-mod.324.author: iZePlayz
minecraft-music-mod.324.description: # Minecraft Music Mod v3.0 Category: Audio ### What's New in v3.0: Enhanced Randomization: The randomization of track selection has been significantly improved for a more varied and enjoyable listening experience. Code Overhaul: A substantial amount of code has been rewritten, leading to better performance and stability. Bug Fixes: Various bugs have been resolved to ensure smoother operation. New Commands: Added /songlist to list all tracks and /skipto to skip to a specific track by its ID. ### Mod Description: This mod brings the original 41 tracks from C418's Minecraft soundtrack into your gameplay. The default in-game music is disabled, and the mod plays the Minecraft tracks in a random order. After each track, there is a brief pause of 10 to 20 seconds, mimicking the music transitions found in Minecraft, but with shorter delays. Features: Original Soundtrack: Plays all 41 tracks from C418's Minecraft soundtrack randomly. Random Intervals: Pauses of 10-20 seconds between tracks for a more authentic Minecraft experience. Default Music Disabled: The game's default background music is turned off. Commands: /skip - Skip the current track and play the next one. /song - Display the current track and show the time remaining until the next track starts. /songlist - Lists all songs with their ID, name, and filename. /skipto - Skip to the specified track by its ID. ### Important Installation Information: To ensure the mod functions correctly, all 4 parts of the mod must be loaded and enabled . You can do this in one of two ways: 1. Extract Method: Extract all 4 folders from the zip file into your game’s mods folder. 2. Drag and Drop Method: Drag and drop the minecraft-music_v3-0_all-parts.zip file into the game. This will automatically load all 4 parts at once. Note for Game Hosts: If you are hosting a game, make sure that all 4 parts of the mod are enabled on your server to ensure the Minecraft music plays correctly for everyone.

team-hud.365.title: Team Hud
team-hud.365.author: ProfeJavix
team-hud.365.description:
This simple mod lets you create groups to see the icon, name, health and location of the other group members in your own HUD.​
Commands:
​

join-group [number] - Join to a group in the specified range.

leave-group - Leave the current group.

Mod Menu Options:
​

HUD Alpha - The transparency of the Team HUD.

Players per page - The amount of players displaying at the same time in the HUD (change the page with D-PAD UP and DOWN)

If you are using my other mod Super Chained Bros. the commands won't be enabled, as this mod works automatically with the group system of SCB (a crown will be displayed in the group leader). Also compatible with CS icons.
​

cs-kirby-deluxe.1126.description:
DISCLAIMER
​
This mod will only work if you have the 
Character Select
