the current version of SM64 Co-op DX
 (v1.4 onwards, preferably v1.4.1)
.

Character Select [Squishy6094]

	

		

	

Play as the pink puffball warrior in SM64 Co-op DX with a moveset directly inspired by 
Kirby and the Forgotten Land (2022)
, made to fit within Kirby's N64 era!​

This mod features:

Copy abilities in the form of the base game's power-ups, with Copy Ability Essences replacing the cap models!

Custom objects for the Air and Star bullets!

"Normal" and "Classic" costumes!

A host-only configuration that allows Kirby to puff up infinitely, perfect for ROM-hacks!

An API that allows modders to add objects for Kirby to inhale through LUA functions!

 
Enjoy my work? Follow my socials! — 
Bluesky
 | 
YouTube
 | 
Bluesky (Gamedev)
 | 
YouTube (Gamedev) 
​
CONTROLS
​

BUTTON
ACTION
[ A ] 
(MIDAIR)
Hover 
(Lasts temporarily, but can be configured by the host to last forever, suited for ROM-hacks)
[ B ]
Inhale
[ Z ] + [ B ]
Slide Kick
[ Z ] + [ CONTROL STICK ]
Dodge
[ L ]
Wave Hello

INHALE API
​
To hook a custom object for Kirby to inhale, or if you want to edit an existing object, you first need to have its behavior ID, once you've obtained it, you can proceed with adding these functions:

_G.kirbyInhaleHookBehavior
​
Allows the modder to hook a custom behavior for Kirby to inhale.

 

FIELD
TYPE
NOTES
id
integer (BehaviorID)
Behavior ID of the object to inhale.
canRotate
bool / function
Check to see if an object can rotate as its being inhaled, default is 
true
.
canEat
bool / function
Check to see if an object can be removed once it reaches Kirby's mouth, default is 
true
.
allowSuckFunc
bool / function
Special checks for special objects
 (I.E. Koopa the Quick)
, set 
false
 to stop the inhale, default is 
true
.
deleteOnDetect
bool
Deletes an object if it's within Kirby's inhale range, default is 
false
, set 
true
 to activate.
onEatFunc
function?
Special function that activates once the object's been deleted 
(I.E. add to Big Bully #2's condition once a bully has been eaten)
, default is 
nil
.

_G.kirbyInhaleEditBehavior
​
Allows the modder to edit an existing behavior for Kirby to inhale.

 

FIELD
TYPE
NOTES
id
integer (BehaviorID)
Behavior ID of the object to inhale.
canRotate
bool? / function?
Check to see if an object can rotate as its being inhaled, can be ignored.
canEat
bool? / function?
Check to see if an object can be removed once it reaches Kirby's mouth, can be ignored.
allowSuckFunc
bool? / function?
Special checks for special objects 
(I.E. Koopa the Quick)
, can be ignored.
deleteOnDetect
bool?
Deletes an object if it's within Kirby's inhale range, can be ignored.
onEatFunc
function?
Special function that activates once the object's been deleted 
(I.E. add to Big Bully #2's condition once a bully has been eaten)
, can be ignored.

updates.title: [CS] Kirby Deluxe v1.1
updates.changelog:
FIXED BUGS/ADDITIONS​

Kirby has been sped up by 20%.

Wall bonking has been removed.

Shocked animation received their respective expressions.

You can now dodge during the Crouch Slide action.

You can now return to a hover after launching an Air Bullet.

Kirby sounds no longer play while paused or on [CS] screen.

Kirby can puff out when landing on the ground after getting tired of hovering.

Inhale sound is now a sample instead of a stream.

Star Bullets no longer stop on ledges, a failsafe has been implemented just in case.

Inhale action no longer makes you invulnerable.

KNOWN ISSUES TO SOLVE​

Crashes occurring, suspected to be related to the hover action, not sure exactly.

Actions not working, for whatever reason. 
(For now, make sure that your SM64 Co-op DX/Character Select versions are v1.4.1 and v1.16.3 respectively, or above)

bingo-coop.930.title: Bingo Coop
bingo-coop.930.author: ProfeJavix
bingo-coop.930.description:
In this mod, a 5x5 table will be generated when the match starts. Each cell will contain a different task, which can be from collecting a star in a specific level to kill a certain boss or player. When a player completes a cell, it becomes failed for the rivals.  Every player must try to make a row (horizontal,  vertical or diagonal) or, if not possible, get the highest amount of completed cells to win the match.
​

Gamemodes
​

Free For All - Every player completes his own tasks.

Teams Mode - The tasks progress is shared for the whole team.

MarioHunt (only if MH is loaded) - The match starts and ends with the MH match, and Runners complete tasks while Hunters try to get in their way.

Chat Commands​

/bingo-team [red | blue]
 select the team you wanna join.

/bingo-start
 start a Bingo match (host only)

/bingo-stop
 stops the current Bingo match if any (host only)

/bingo-mode [ffa | team]
 set the Bingo gamemode (host only)

This commands are only available if MH is NOT loaded.
​

Mod Menu Options​

Show Table Controls
 toggle on-screen Bingo table controls.

Give Buffs On Cell Completion
 toggle if certain cells give buffs. This cells will have a tiny red star on the corner (host only and if MH not loaded)

Buff Seconds [10s-90s]
 the duration in seconds of the cell buffs (host only and if MH not loaded)

Original mod idea by Drenchy. Check out his video:

bowling.1123.title: Bowling
bowling.1123.author: djoslin0
bowling.1123.description:
Bowl with up to 16 people (
4-6 recommended
) for a fun social hangout or turn it into a competitive event. Finish the match with over 100 points for a chance to permanently unlock a new bowling ball skin, or score a strike for an immediate chance to unlock a skin! This mod is both a tech demo of coops capabilities and is also tons of fun! 

Features:

Traditional bowling rules, 2 rolls per frame, 10 frames per game, potential extra bowl in frame 10.

Celebration system for players that score consecutive Strikes.

24 total bowling balls that can be unlocked by chance after a Strike.

Fully translated localization for Spanish and Portuguese languages.

For modders interested, here are technical features used in this mod:

Realtime physics engine through Lua

New lighting engine capabilities

New BmFont library with functions to animate custom fonts

Other neat demonstrations like scrolling textures, custom camera movements, DoF, etc..

Created by 
djoslin0
 and 
The Incredible Holc

character-select-nuzlocke.792.title: Character Select Nuzlocke
character-select-nuzlocke.792.author: wereyoshi
character-select-nuzlocke.792.description:
This mod is a character select nuzlocke mod. when you die the character you are using is eliminated. So if you die as mario then no one can use mario.

It also features an api _G.charselectnuzlockeapi -which has options like addteamcheck which adds a team check for gamemodes.

get_deadcharactertable for getting eliminated characters. reset_nuzlocketable for resetting the nuzlocke table for everyone

	

		
Spoiler: 
_G.charselectnuzlockeapi 

	

	

		

			
--function for other mods to add a team check for gamemodes 

    addteamcheck ,

--function that lets other mods get a table of only the current dead characters

    get_deadcharactertable,

 ---this function lets other mods see if a player has no characters

    get_hascharacterstatus,

--function that lets other mods get a table of only the current living characters

    get_livingcharactertable,

--- function to allow other mods to get the current resetnuzlocksavefunction function

    get_resetnuzlocksavefunction,

--resets the nuzlocke table for everyone

    reset_nuzlocketable,

--function to for other mods to set if this mod will reset the save with nuzlocke table reset

    reset_save_on_reset,

--- function to allow other mods to run code when the local player's nuzlocke table is reset

    on_nuzlockereset,

--- function to allow other mods to run code whenever the local player's nuzlocke table changes

    on_nuzlocketableupdate,

--function used by the host to revive a character for a player

    server_revive_character_for_player,

--this function resets the nuzlocke table of a single player

    reset_nuzlocketableofspecificplayer,

---this function allows other mods to set the current nuzlocke character

    set_nuzlockecharacter,

--- function to allow other mods to replace the function character select nuzlocke uses to reset the current save. 

    set_resetnuzlocksavefunction,

--- function to allow other mods to run code when the local player runs out of characters

    on_nocharactersleftfunction,

--this function returns the current version of the mod

    get_version,

updates.title: Really small update.
Another Moveset Update!
updates.changelog:
Hello! I've been working on this update for a while, and i was also planning on adding more stuff, but i couldn't for many reasons, that will come in version 1.5 though.

Anyways, this update adds many new stuff for Boshi's moveset! some of these additions include a Ground Pound Cancel and a Ground Pound Jump, buffs to Boshi's character stats (like speed or jump height, everything going to 0.95 now), and also being able to flutter jump after pretty much every jump action as possible now! that includes stuff like Wall Jumping, Jumping out of water or jumping while burning, etc!

I worked a lot on this update, so, enjoy it!

updates.title: The Moveset Update!
updates.changelog:
Hi, this new (and really big update) adds a new moveset to Boshi!

This moveset is the same moveset that Yoshi has in the Extra Characters mod, except Boshi has some changes compared to Yoshi and Mario's moveset!

Boshi has a slighty lower jump and he's slightly slower than Mario, but he has a also 6 frame longer flutter jump with a little more height than what Yoshi has, since well, Yoshi and Boshi are kind of a Mario/Wario situation, other changes were also made but the mentioned ones are the most revelant

Outside of that, credits were added to the mod!

Thanks to 
@xLuigiGamerx
 for the moveset!

komodo-joe.517.title: Komodo Joe
komodo-joe.517.author: Aso-Designer
komodo-joe.517.description:
One of the second bosses of Crash Bandicoot 2 : Cortex Strikes Back. 

Joe is part of the Komodo Brothers , a duo of komodo dragons known for their sword fighting skills.

Joe is highly intelligent, and consider the mammals inferior to him. 

No scimitar here, but Joe can still punch his adversaries with sneak and fierce! 

Assets used are elements from the original PS1 model and Mario 64. Voices clips are from Crash Bandicoot N Sane Trilogy and Crash Team Racing Nitro Fueled.  

Minor issues is the model "sinking", and invisibility cap acting weird on this character, but it doesn't ruin the gameplay (imo). I'll fix it in a later update.

Komodo Joe (c) Activision/Microsoft

updates.title: v2.0: Big Bad Boss Update
updates.changelog:
I had to hurry up and make this update because one of the bosses became inaccessible. There's also been many adjustments to existing bosses, as well as some additional content:

Mod now yells at you if you use v1.16.3 of Character Select or lower. To use the mod with Character Select, you will need the in-dev v1.16.4 version on 
the GitHub
 (Code -> Download Zip).

All shockwaves now move at double speed, but also won't hit you during invulnerability frames.

A large metal enemy was changed to have new behavior.

King Bob-Omb: Bomb attack now looks nicer, changed some hitboxes, fixed some problems with grabbing and some syncing issues

Bowser: Various changes. Fixed the teleport attack being undodgeable in some scenarios.

Big Bully: Now recovers properly in situations where it falls far below its home.

Eyerok: Completely reworked. Should be less aggravating now.

Wiggler: Completely reworked. Should be 
more
 aggravating now.

Rainbow Ride: Surprise new content added!

A thief character was made easier to dodge and now loudly announces what he stole (A questionable strategy...)

A "bigoted" character has gotten better contacts and should recognize his species better, even if Character Select is enabled.

A fight with a chatty character was reworked, and should be a little more difficult now.

Characters in a certain quest now have some new things they can say.

A bird character no longer leaves fire permanently in the level.

A bird character now remembers your sins and can be refought without redoing some favors.

A green character now activates properly.

A dark enemy had many changes. Its wind attack was replaced with a fire attack.

A superpowered version of the dark enemy was added as late-game content. After finding some other secrets, look around the Grounds for something new...

komodo-moe.558.author: Aso-Designer
komodo-moe.558.description:
One of the second bosses of Crash Bandicoot 2 : Cortex Strikes Back. 

Moe is part of the Komodo Brothers , a duo of komodo dragons known for their sword fighting skills. Moe is more into brawling than into thinking, but that doesn't stop him to be boastful and strong.

64-king-the-memer.891.title: 64 King the Memer
64-king-the-memer.891.author: king the memer
64-king-the-memer.891.description: Peach's letter somehow made it all the way to King who, being bored and having nothing better to do, happily went to the castle ... little did he know he'd spend hours scrambling for stars, all to find a complete fucking random ​ INFO: After four long years of development (and two and a half lacking releases) King is finally complete - quicker and bouncier than ever before He can run and roll down hills to gain real momentum, manouver through tough obstacles with ease, fly across the map with good timing, and so much more With cool new moves like the Rolldash [Z + B], Bubble Bounce [Z + B] and Airjump [Z + A], King is a fun, simple to learn character with incredible potential when mastered NOTES: - This mod is split into two parts: the campaign, 64 King the Memer , and the character, King - King the character does NOT require or support Character Select - if detected, all functionality will be disabled to avoid the game becoming completely unplayable (hopefully support can be added in the future but as of now the two clash too harshly) - Included with King are two kSkins , Sonic the Hedgehog and Bootleg Metal Sonic - You can change your kSkin or switch back to Mario through the pause menu - All major previous builds are located here aight enough yap im admitedly fucking horrible at releasing anything stable, theres prolly a ton of bugs i js didnt find through my own testing so at least for now try report anything weird directly to me rather than telling me through lowered reviews (i seen that happen to alot of people it does NOT help) - id keep searching for things to iron out but thatd take me like five more years and by then i woulda burned my ass out and hit another shadow drop like i did with the first remake back in 23, and id bet alot that nobody even heard about that build but ye apart from that i do hope yall enjoy this, its def nothing crazy but i put in alot of hours to make sure everything is smooth and fits w the original - its gonna be real weird not being on the grind after so long

updates.title: Globals update
updates.changelog: This update fixes issues with global gMarioIsKing[] and adds a new one, gKSkinInfo[] gKingExists and g64kExists - These simply check if each mod is active which is necessary to use anything below gMarioIsKing[] This can be used in mods as a simple check for whether the given Mario is King gKSkinInfo[] This is useful for grabbing things like King's current icon, set of models, display name, assigned sound effect, and even whether his smaller hitbox is being used Spoiler: Updates regarding a secret feature Additionally, three global functions regarding Star King have been added SAVE_FLAG_UNLOCKED_STAR_KING This is save flag 64 King the Memer uses to store whether Star King is unlocked star_king_is_enabled(m) This simply checks whether the given Mario is King and has Star King enabled star_king_enable(m) Enables Star King if the given Mario is King and Star King hasn't been recently enabled star_king_disable(m) Similar to the last, disabled Star King if the given Mario is King Luckily for the people who are obviously still gonna click the spoiler I will not reveal how to unlock Star King Additional Notes: The unused second name feature in kSkins was removed gKingStates is no longer global and the first update wasnt about mario ill be damned

map-yume-nikki-levelpack.1247.author: Kristall
map-yume-nikki-levelpack.1247.description: This mod requires MAPi Hangout Menu to work​ This mod adds both Madotsuki's room and Poniko's house from Yume Nikki to the game as hangout maps, with music, skyboxes and even functional events from the original game! Madotsuki's Room​ The starting area of Yume Nikki! The skybox is randomized whenever you enter the map, when you groundpound the red console near the tv, something will happen depending on the current skybox. Poniko's House​ One of the many places you can find in Yume Nikki, iconic for its rare event when meddling with the lights, which is implemented here! Kick the lightswitch to toggle the lights, there's a chance for the event to happen each time the lights are turned off.

mh-secret-helpers.898.title: (MH) Secret Helpers
mh-secret-helpers.898.author: ProfeJavix
mh-secret-helpers.898.description:
In this MarioHunt extension, you can give some players the role of "Helper," which makes them invisible and gives them the purpose of trolling the opposing team.

Important: 
You must load MarioHunt with this mod!

Use:

To make a player a Helper, the host must type the corresponding command and select the desired player. This player will then become a helper for their current team until the host removes that role (or, in the case of Runners, until all non-helpers are eliminated and the Hunters win). It is recommended that this assignment take place before the match begins. Helpers can't collect stars, coins, keys nor grab things, so go melee!

Chat command:

/sh-toggle : toggles the Helper Selector menu (only for host)

Mod Menu Options:

Rival helpers can see each other: Allow helpers from a team see the helpers of the other one and viceversa

Runner helpers can exit level anytime: Remove the level exit restriction from MH on Helpers

Original mod idea by Drenchy. Check out his video:

Sequel • Casual • Openworld " Mario on Indigo Island is a major romhack made by usernamesarespiders features over 13 levels and a total of 111 Stars Compared to The Mushroom Cup, this hack is set in the openworld and has got a gameplay style focused in exploration over platforming . cs-ssb-pikachu.1022.title: [CS] SSB Pikachu
cs-ssb-pikachu.1022.author: ProfeJavix
cs-ssb-pikachu.1022.description:
IMPORTANT: this mod needs Character Select to work

MOVESET
​

Normal Smash:
 press B to throw bouncing Thunderball. Can shock other players.

Up Smash:
 press Y to perform a Quick Dash to the stick direction. Press A to go up or Z to go down. Can be repeated instantly one time if the stick or the buttons are still held.

Down Smash:
 press X to cast a Thunder. Can be performed in air and shock-throws other players on hit.

Side Smash:
 hold B while ground pounding to charge a Skull Bash to the stick direction. The more charge, the more speed. Shock-throws other players on hit.

Moveset can be disabled via CharSelect options.

Original mod idea by Drenchy. Check out his video:

	

		

	

Check out Kog's showcase:

King Dedede's Dream Friends now has 16 playable characters! New to this update we have, Daroach (Kirby Squeak Squad), Escargoon (Kirby Right Back At Ya), Knuckle Joe, Magolor (Kirby's Return to Dream Land), Bonkers, Tac, and Rocky!

More character specific Voice Clips have been added as well to characters like Chef Kawasaki (Who now has his anime voice, like King Dedede and Escargoon).

updates.title: Taranza & Chef Kawasaki!
updates.changelog: Two new friends are here! Someone requested Taranza and Magolor (Still working on Magolor), and I realized I could edit this Chef Kawasaki model to fit the game a bit better. More Dream Friends on the way soon!

updates.title: King Dedede's Dream Friends!
updates.changelog:
King Dedede called in backup! New to the mod, play as Kirby, Bandana Waddle Dee, Meta Knight, Adeleine, Susie Haltmann, and Marx! All come with a sound pack, custom caps, recolorability, and most have blinking/death eye textures!

(I've also left the original stand-alone Dedede mod up for download alongside the new pack)

updates.title: Masked Dedede & Recolor Support!
updates.changelog: Masked Dedede replaces the Metal Cap, and the King is now recolorable!

Rex Skin (Custom Model by 
PeachesCastle
, Proportion edits by me)

Custom Life Icon

Metal Rex Model & Texture Color

Sound Pack (Super Mario World Sound Effects)

Custom Caps (Models by 
PeachesCastle
)

Blinking Animation & Death Animation!

v3.1 Recolor Support!

Skin - Stomach/Face/Wings

Hair - Main Color

Shoes - Shoes

Morishiko 
for fixing up my LUA files! No More Script Errors, and I know why they were erroring now.

arena-hangout-bitforts.7.title: Arena (& Hangout) - Bitforts
arena-hangout-bitforts.7.author: Chilly
arena-hangout-bitforts.7.description:
This is 
Bitforts
, an Arena & Hangout map for your preferred version of sm64coop. (it works on both)

Be mindful of which version you download
, as one is specifically for Arena (included with your game) and the other is for Hangout (which isn't a real gamemode, but something you can add onto your game).

The Arena version automatically adds itself to the map pool through its api, but for those using the Hangout version, a very simple implementation is provided to allow people to access the map through the 
/retrowarp
 command. Feel free to change the Hangout version's way of warping there to better fit your server!

I made the map, but special thanks goes out to 
flipflopbell
 for their 3D Skybox Template, which I used for this.

breaking-bad-death-cutscene.197.description:
Breaking Bad Death Cutscene

This mod replaces the normal death sequence with the final shot of Breaking Bad where the camera pans away from Walter White's body. Bubbling is automatically disabled and the sequence is only triggered by dying standing, on your back, on your stomach, suffocating, being electrocuted or drowning.

When a player dies, the music will play and get louder the closer you are to the body and quieter the farther away. The vanilla music also fades out the closer you are to the body.

Press 
[A]
 or 
[B]
 to skip the cutscene.

base-character-stats.254.title: Base Character Stats!
base-character-stats.254.author: zcrudehydro
base-character-stats.254.description:
This mod edits the base 4 playable characters in the game to have their very own stats and abilities! They are as follows:

Mario: Bonks are simply less strong to him.

Luigi: Higher jump, lower running speed. His third jump is a twirl.

Toad: Lower jump, higher running speed.

Waluigi: Takes less damage, lower jump.

Wario: Dies in a singular hit, hold the punch button in the air to hover for a limited time.

This also adds some quality-of-life improvements:

Hold the punch button while twirling to descend much faster.

Landing from a twirl no longer stops you from moving for a bit.

The text on the top left will soon be removed in favor of a much more graceful method of informing the player of the mod.

drench-game.760.title: Drench Game
drench-game.760.author: EmilyEmmi
drench-game.760.description: Inspired by Dani's Crab Game, which is based off of the Netflix series Squid Game, is... Drench Game! Commissioned by Drenchy, this mod lets you compete in 8 different minigames to earn the most points and win the prize of [insert high amount here] coins! FEATURING: High quality custom maps by biobak and Woissil, and one low quality map by me. Original soundtrack by murioz (one track by Awesome Seal Guy on YouTube). Voice acting!? Featuring Espi as Toad, Trashcam as Waluigi, and Squeex as Mingle Callout (also Waluigi). Totally legit ads made by Squeex's YouTube community! TEAM MODE: Pick your own teams or select at random. Features auto-balancing for uneven teams. ELIMINATION MODE: You lose a minigame, you lose it all. For either hardcore players or very short games. And most important of all: the beds are bouncy. Note: If you downloaded this mod in Drenchy's server prior to 6/28 at 8 PM EST, or the mod's name does not have a version number, you have an older version and should download this one. It fixes a major bug with the Duel minigame.

updates.title: v1.2 (BETA)

Go to

Select "Code", then "Download Zip"

Install the zip you download like you would any other mod

The download link on this page will be updated when this version is fully complete.

Original Post: November 15, 2022

Author: BlackJoyStick

If you enjoy romhacks that abuse game mechanics such as quicksand, lava, fire spitters or chuckyas, then say no more! This is the second romhack of the Star Revenge Series, now ported to sm64ex-coop. You really should not play this but it’ll be fun to see you try.

cs-mother-64-pack.271.title: [CS] Mother 64 Pack
cs-mother-64-pack.271.author: MlopsFunny
cs-mother-64-pack.271.description: [WARNING: THE PACK IS STILL IN BETA, REPORT ANY ISSUES TO ME!] ​ Welcome to the Mother 64 Pack! as of now, the pack's aim is to add all the main playable characters of the Mother Series (As of now, Ninten, Pippi Ness and Lucas), along with their variations to SM64 Co-Op Deluxe! In the future, more characters of the series will be added. CURRENT ROSTER: ​ Ninten: This Psychic 12 year old is the grandson of the allusive George and Maria. He begins his adventure in Podunk, when a poltergeist happens at his house. the protagonist of the original Mother (design from Mother Encore)​ Alternate variations: Ken (Mother Novelization) and Douglas Halloway (Mother: Invasion from the unkown)​ Pippi: This girl who lives in podunk is always getting herself into a mess! She also has a thing for eating grass, so it seems? Legend has it she's based off a famous book's character! Ness: An average 12 year-old with psychic powers, who left his hometown, Onett, after meeting a hero from a ruined future. the first out of the chosen four from Mother 2​ Lucas: A timid and nervous teen, who lost his mother and brother, Claus, at a young age. Protagonist of Mother 3.​ Alternate variations: Lucas (EarthBound 64 Design)​ This pack also incules:​ Unique Preset Palletes for every character and their variations!​ Custom Caps for each and every character!​ Custom Life Icons, Made by myself!​ ​ Custom Power Meters, Also made by myself!​ No voices, currently, but they will soon be made!​ Fully Functional Invisibility cap and Metal Cap!​ NOTE: YOU MUST HAVE THE LATEST VERSION OF CHARACTER SELECT BY SQUISHY TO RUN THIS. IF IN DOUBT, REINSTALL IT FROM THE MOD PAGE. ​

updates.title: The "STILL WORKING ON IT!" update
updates.changelog: Hey! after a lot of thinking, and a fellow modder releasing their own Ness, I decided to let out a small update to show that yes, im still working on this. The update is very indeed limited to:​ - SuperPhanto's Ness compatibility! Yes, this means you can use both Ness models togheter MOSTLY as god intended. Only thing I wasn't able to figure out was the health icon, so if SuperPhanto wants to tag in to try and help figure out how its done, feel free.​ - Power Meters! Currently only for Ness and Ninten (Including his ALTs). Yes, I know they look crappy, but its what I got rn. I plan on seeing if I can get someone who is better experienced w em to help later. - Mod Credits! This has been long warranted so now that CS has a update to support it, I've set up the basework for mod credits. They'll be updated along w the mod.​ And the most noteworthy addition... THATS RIGHT! ​ Pippi is now the 1st newcomer of the mod! Not the most memorable, but the FIRST parthner of the series, you know my girl Pippi had to get in! This is probably gonna be the rare only case I release a standalone character, cuz I wanna have all the series characters out in one release. but I was starting to burn out so I decided to release her just to show I havent forgot. Might be a small update but I still hope you guys like what I had to serve. Now go out there and live that life to the fullest!​

cs-cream-the-rabbit.282.title: [CS] Cream the Rabbit
cs-cream-the-rabbit.282.author: Gamebun
cs-cream-the-rabbit.282.description: Note: If voicelines are not playing, you must be on Character Select v1.16.1 or above! Cream's birthday is all over but she still wants to have fun! Escaped from her own mod, she explores the vast worlds of CoopDX! I know there's been a few ports by others of this model (and I appreciate it) though I figure I get an official version from me, with some extra bits. Comes with a customizable palette, new animations replacing the idle, sleep and running anims, custom sounds, health hud, life and star icon and new star model. As of v2.0, she now regains the ability to fly as well as bringing along several of her outfits from Cream 64! As of v3.0, Vanilla has joined the pack as a replacement for Peach! This also includes replacing the two Toads at the end with their chao, Cheese & Chocola! Simply press (A) to fly out of any of the jumps, the side flips and wall kicks. You need to press (B) to fly out of a long jump and then press (A) to keep flying. This is built to allow players to still be able to do the BLJ if needed. A companion mod, Cheese the Chao , is also available! Cream's outfits are also separated into four packs to not overwhelm players when there's suddenly 80+ outfits on her single slot. Simply place the main folder (char-select-cream) alongside any of the other pack folders in the mods folder to install the mod correctly. If you simply just wanna play as Cream, you only need to worry about the main pack and can ignore the rest. The packs are: Main: The Rabbit Herself Contains her default design, remade to allow custom palettes! Pack 1: Canon Outfits + a Few Extras Spoiler: Pack 1 Riders (Sonic Riders) Winter (Sonic Channel) Spring (Sonic Forces Speed Battle) Unicorn (Sonic Forces Speed Battle) Yukata (Mario & Sonic 2020 Tokyo Olympics) Swimsuit (Sonic X) Halloween (Sonic Channel) Junihotoe (Sonic Channel) Princess (Sonic IDW Issue 22 RI Cover) Detective (Sonic Channel) Drummer (Sonic Forces Speed Battle) Lunar New Year ( design by Jennifer Hernandez ) Squishy (character by Squishy6094) Pack 2: Sonic & Friends Spoiler: Pack 2 Young Vanilla (Sonic Advance 2, design by Zack113 ) Amy Rose (Sonic Adventure) Blaze the Cat (Sonic Rush) Marine the Raccoon (Sonic Rush Adventure) Shadow the Hedgehog (Sonic Adventure 2) Silver the Hedgehog (Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)) Miles 'Tails' Power (Sonic the Hedgehog 2) Charmy Bee (Sonic Heroes) Tikal the Echidna (Sonic Adventure) Cosmo the Seedrian (Sonic X) Dr. Eggman (Sonic Adventure, Design by TheNovika ) Cheese the Chao (Sonic Adventure 2) NiGHTS (NiGHTS into Dreams) Pack 3: Cream Cosplay Vol 1 Spoiler: Pack 3 Super Mario (Super Mario 64) Princess Daisy (Mario Tennis) Klonoa (Klonoa: Door to Phantomile) Engineer (Team Fortress 2) Ichiban Kasuga (Yakuza 7: Like a Dragon) Travis Touchdown (No More Heroes) Jack Garland (Stranger of Paradise: Final Fantasy Origins) Sakura Kasugano (Street Fighter Alpha 2) Dudley (Street Fighter 3) Luke Sullivan (Street Fighter 6) Roll (Megaman 8) Megaman X (Megaman X) Lan Hikari (Megaman Battle Network) Vergil (Devil May Cry 3/Ultimate Marvel vs Capcom 3) Terry Bogard (Fatal Fury/King of Fighters) Maria Renard (Castlevania: Rondo of Blood) Richter Belmont (Castlevania: Rondo of Blood) Charlotte Aulin (Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin) Goemon (Mystical Ninja Starring Goemon) Mimi (Pop'n Music 15 Adventure) Ryuta Ippongi (Osu! updates.title: New Cream outfit, various texture changes and menu music
updates.changelog:
Added new outfit: Squishy Cream, based on Squishy6094's avatar, as a huge thank you for helping us get the Cream API and then some updated for v1.16 of CS! She's available through pack 1 if you wish to select her!

Replaced the placeholder graffiti texture with a new custom one by Funkys0da! 

Custom letters and signature textures should now be working in latest Character Select version as of this update (v1.16.2) though they were already in previous update. 

Added CS menu music to go alongside the default, song is 
System Screen: Menu
 from Sonic Heroes.

updates.title: v1.16 compatability and then some
updates.changelog:
Now supported on latest builds of Character Select (huge thanks to Squishy6094 for the overhaul!)

If voicelines are not playing, make sure you're on v1.16.1!

This means all the packs are now under a single Cream icon, so you may want to enable fast select to find the outfit ya like.

This ALSO means that when you save your outfit, it'll remember which one ya picked last.

Added temporary graffiti image to CS Menu, will be updated later with a custom one

Added pose for CS Menu, based on her Advance 2 art as close as I could get it.

Added custom Peach and End Toad models (Princess Vanilla for Peach, Cheese and Chocola for the two Toads respectively)

Added custom textures for peach letter and signature (currently not working in CS v1.16.1, should be fixed in later version)

There will be a smaller update coming later to add a few new things. Just waiting till someone gets back from their trip.

updates.title: Various bugfixes, toggles, etc
updates.changelog:
Huge thank you once again to AloXado320 for the various code fixes and code additions. 

Fixed where you would die if you ever flew over quicksand

Fixed an issue where grabbing a ledge when flying would make Cream appear flying but in the ledge grab state

Fixed where flying after jumping out of water would cause camera issues when using the default cam (if it's still a little awkward, please let me know)

Fixed the models in Packs 2 through 4 in regards to the capless head model being visible when used with other mods such as OMM. The capless function has been removed for all the alts. 

- Default Cream model has also been updated to remove the unlit pupils and update the various textures to appear less blurry.

Added a toggle to locally disable flying for those who wish to not use it or to avoid conflict with other mods.

Per request, added a toggle to locally disable the new custom star model and revert back to the default star model. Note, this only changes the model, not the hud icon. 

- Both toggles can be found in the mod menu

updates.title: Fixed CS Bug with Debugging Info Enabled
updates.changelog: Title says it all.

updates.title: Flying, Outfits, the works!
updates.changelog:
Flying has been added from Super Cream 64! Should work basically the same as it did there. Controls will be listed in the main mod description.

Mod has been updated to support most of her outfits from Super Cream 64. The ones omitted were created specifically for friends, mutuals and streamers and don't wanna include them unless permitted. Full list will be posted in the description.

In addition, the outfits are also separated into packs to not clog up player's CS screens. The main folder will just contain normal Cream while the other four packs will contain the various outfits.

Updated all sound files to not be as loud as before.

Made the custom palette model a separate selection since it would break whenever the player would fly.

Added more unique animations for the star dance, exit painting and sleeping.

cs-kakkoi-elbertson.770.author: The Memelord
cs-kakkoi-elbertson.770.description:
HEY, PAISANOS!
 

Ever wanted to play as that one mafia gal from 
Gensokyo Odyssey
 in Super Mario 64?

No?

Then I guess this isn't the mod for you then... BUT, if you are, then look no further than the 
Kakkoi Elbertson mod!

(You will need the character select mod in order for this work, chucklenuts! It's also worth mentioning that this mod includes voicelines with curse words, so if you can't handle curse words lightly or you don't want your parents to listen on your gaming session with Kakkoi, then this mod isn't for you after all.)

The mod includes:

-Custom model of Kakkoi Elbertson from the hit game Gensokyo Odyssey (duh)

-Custom voicelines and sounds provided by Kronington, Abder Fumo, and VA RagingAngel (As per her request, RagingAngel asked me to put a link to her X [formerly Twitter] account here: 
https://x.com/RagingAngelhaha?t=TNHXgfUwmOONvwZwhlVJvw&s=09
)

-Custom models for the normal, wing, and metal cap (Sorry vanish cap lovers. Will roll out an update that includes a custom model for the vanish cap in the future.)

The full credits to the mod can be found inside the mod folder. It is a text file named "Credits.txt"

Enjoy murdering bowser's goons and 
abusing 
 playing Kakkoi Elbertson in SM64!

Also, here's a roadmap of what I plan to do with this mod in the future:

-Fixing up any broken animations or issues

-Change the color palette of Kakkoi like most other character mods do

-Polish up the model if necessary

-Add a custom health bar

-Give Kakkoi a new moveset relating to her gun and the coins you collect in the game

-Custom animations maybe?

-Release alternate skins for Kakkoi, such as an Inu variant!

If you would like to help with the development of these future updates and you have experience in doing so, let me know in the comments and I'll get back to you when I can!

Thank you and enjoy the mod!

Mods featured in the trailer:

King's Devtools 
by king the memer
 
(It's not actually shown in the trailer, but I used it to get on top of the castle. Still worth mentioning, as it's the perfect mod to test out your own mods or to mess around!)

Day Night Cycle 
by AgentX

Music used in the trailer:

Gensokyo Odyssey OST -49 Bullet You Can't Refuse 
by Kronington

coop-studio.1149.title: Coop Studio
coop-studio.1149.author: Krof
coop-studio.1149.description:
Do you remember Saturn64?

This mod is an attempt at a 
Machinma
 mod for the 
SM64COOPDX

What can you do?

Freeze camera

Enter spectator mode for screenshots

Easy animation testing and manipulation

Change facial expressions

Hide HUDs

Useful commands and guide

|

|

Commands

/fzcam
                 
"Freeze the camera at the last point you were at"

/hud
                     
"Hide the SM64 HUD"

/sshot 
                 
"Enter spectator mode to take a screenshot"

/tips
                     
"Hide and unhide tips when starting the mod"

/expressions
        
"Open the panel to select any expression"

/anims
                 
"Try any animation as Anim-Test"

/commands
         
"Displays the command table that appears when starting the mod"

|

|

Button shortcut

R + Z                      
"Freeze Camera"

L + R                      
"Enter Screenshot mode"

Z + X                      
"Open the expressions panel"

Z + DPAD DOWN  
"Enter animation testing mode"

|

|

SPECIAL THANKS

Krofasty

EmiliEmmy

Wibblus

originally based on Aldex64

milne-the-crystal-fox.194.description: Trailer: You ever wanted to be a silly crystal fox zooming around stages, throwing rocks at enemies and do Russian dances? No? Well here's the mod anyway. ​ Milne just somehow got transported to Mario's world and she decided to help save the princess, I guess. Usage : As a standalone mod: ​ Type /milne on|off to toggle the character.​ Type /milnecolor on|off to toggle recolorability.​ As a CS Character: Two options for a non-recolorable Milne and a recolorable Milne will be in the menu.​ Moveset : Twister Thok: In the air, you can press A to start a Twister Thok. You can use it two times. First time will launch you upwards, second time downwards. Hold a direction, and you will lunge forwards in said direction. Otherwise it'd be your average double jump. If you try to do this move more than once without landing, you'll immediately launch downwards. Melee (Punch, Kick and Dive replacement): Shard Toss: Tap B once, and Milne will throw three crystal shards at once, acting as a projectile that damages enemies and players in PVP. Crystal Lance: Quickly double tap B, and Milne will take out her lance and glide across the air in a short time. If she hits a wall, she'll stick to it, and you can either jump off of it (A) , kick off of it (B) , or drop off of it (Z) . You can only use it once. Grab: Getting near a grabbable object and press B will make Milne effortlessly pick it up. Passive: No Swimming: Milne can't swim, but she will have a slightly tweaked version of her ground moveset: Twister Thok: Milne can now jump up more than once in the air in case she does the move again. Crystal Lance: Milne can now use the move more than once with a 1-second timer if she's off-ground. Weight: Due to being made out of crystals, Milne is denser and heavier, therefore she falls faster than most characters. And when she lands from certain heights, she'll create a shockwave that kills everything in its radius except for players. Her fall damage is also delayed a bit. Kazotsky Kick (Taunt): By pressing X as a Milne player while idling, you will do start dancing. As a non-Milne player, you can go up to a dancing player. When an icon appears above the dancing player, you can press X and join 'em. Each vanilla character can have a unique dance, and you can make your character have a unique dance with this template file below: This file makes Wario be able to only activate the dance while walking instead of idling and gives him Waluigi's dance. With that out of the way, I hope y'all enjoy this mod! ​ Credits : steven3004 : Almost everything in this mod. ganewatch : Projectile code borrowed from Mega-Man X. CrystallineGazer : Milne's Mother. The original SRB2 Milne mod : The other things. Voice Actors Sampled: AJ Michalka (She-Ra and the Princesses of Power) Erica Lindbeck (Helluva Boss, Mortal Kombat 11) Ashly Burch(Mortal Kombat X) Known issues: - Bowser throwing might not sync too well. - Kazotsky Kick icon might bug.

odyssey-marios-moveset-rebirth.125.title: Odyssey Mario's Moveset: Rebirth
odyssey-marios-moveset-rebirth.125.author: PeachyPeach
odyssey-marios-moveset-rebirth.125.description: A faithful recreation of sm64ex-omm for sm64coopdx! Features: Unique moves and gameplay from Odyssey, including Cappy. Custom animations, star dances and death sequences! True Non-Stop mode, designed to be able to collect all stars in one go. Improved Power-ups: Wing Cap: Inspired by Galaxy's Red Star, Mario can move freely in the air without height limitation. Vanish Cap: Mario can walk through almost all thin walls and grids with ease. Metal Cap: Mario becomes truly invincible. You won't sink in quicksand, you cannot die (unless you're already dead) and objects that try to squash Mario are destroyed. A redesigned HUD to resemble Odyssey! Display of each star in the current level, and which ones have and haven't been collected. Radar that can point to the closest red coin/secret. Fully custom camera! Hold R while standing still to enter a new first person that lets you look in all directions. You can toggle between 8 directional mode and 16 directions by tapping R. Custom settings for different play styles. Type /omm in the game chat box to open the menu. OMM Stars display that shows all levels and which stars have been collected per level, as well as unlocked caps and Bowser keys. Type /stars in the game chat box or by hold L when the game is paused to display. Inbuilt support for various popular gamemodes. Credits: Author : PeachyPeach Contributors : Isaac, Prince Frizzy, djoslin0, Altiami, Sharen (SMO animations)

pet-mario-in-real-time-mario-head.505.author: ThaGurlTIlly
pet-mario-in-real-time-mario-head.505.description: Now you can play through Super Mario 64 with the iconic Mario Head by your side! Mario In Real Time was a program developed by SimGraphics for Nintendo in 1991, it set the groundworks for the interactive Mario screens we see in Nintendo stores today! Initially used for live shows like Spaceworld and E3, you may be more familiar with his infamous appearance in the game, Mario Teaches Typing 2. years after the release of this game, the Youtube community got its hands on the FMV animations contained in the game, lovingly naming Mario In Real Time, "Mario Head." and he's been a staple of internet culture ever since. Which brings us here! Mario In Real Time is now in Mario 64 Co-op Deluxe, thanks to the wonderful WiddlePets mod! sporting a brand new from scratch model, designed to fit with the limitations and art style of the original Super Mario 64 that's about it... download? ​

sonic-health.115.title: Sonic health
sonic-health.115.author: wereyoshi
sonic-health.115.description: on hit drop rings equal to the rings counter if you get hit with no rings or shield you die coins no longer heal (since rings normally don't give air) and recovery hearts can now give a shield (can be toggled off using /recoveryheartshield command basically i made recovery hearts act as a shield monitor) has generic super forms no stat changes only invincibility and hurt enemies on touch activated by pressing x (by default can be changed with sonichealthsuperbutton command) and having 50 rings + prereq(default 50 stars) Spoiler: screenshots Spoiler: commands /decreasecoincounter - [on|off] turn decreasecoincounter on or off to choose whether to decrease the coin counter on hit and rings equal 1 coin or have the coin counter not decease on hit and rings only affect ring counter /loseringsonlevelchange - turn loseringsonlevelchange on or off to choose if you want to keep your rings between levels. /maxrecollectablerings - maxrecollectablerings [number] this sets the maximum amount of rings you can get back per hit /maxringloss [number] this sets the max number of rings you can lose at once set it to 0 to always lose all rings. /recoveryheartshield = [on|off] turn recoveryheartshield on or off to choose whether recovery hearts should give an overshield on touch. /ringscrushinstadeath - [on|off] turn ringscrushinstadeath on or off to choose if you want being crushed to be instadeath. /ringui_x - ringui_x [number|dpad|toggleui] this sets the x position of the ring counter should be a value between 0 and 320, ringui_x \\#A02200\\dpad\\#ffffff\\ for moving the ui with dpad,or ringui_x toggleui to toggle the ui /ringui_y - ringui_y [number|dpad|toggleui] this sets the y position of the ring counter should be a value between 0 and -240, ringui_y \\#A02200\\dpad\\#ffffff\\ for moving the ui with dpad,or ringui_y toggleui to toggle the ui /sonicfalldamage - [on|off] turn sonicfalldamage on or off to choose whether you can take fall damage /sonichealthconfig = [save|load|savesuperpreqpref|loadsuperpreqpref|printserver|printlocal] to save the current sonic health settings to a file or load them (loading only works if used by a moderator or the server) /sonichealthsuperbutton - [reset|change] set the button/buttons to turn super, reset sets it back to default(default x) and change allows you to change it /sonicsuper - [on|off|prereq|7coinstar|number] toggle the ability to go super with 50+ rings + requirement, get the requirement by typing prereq ,change prereq by entering number of stars needed or entering 7coinstar to make super require 7 100 coin stars. /disablelavabounce', [on|off] turn disablelavabounce \\#00C7FF\\on \\#ffffff\\or \\#A02200\\off \\#ffffff\\to choose if you want to lava bounce on lava. so you can do /maxringloss 0 and /maxrecollectablerings 20 to lose all rings on hit but only be able to recover 20 of them. this mod also contains an api that other mods can use _G.sonichealth Spoiler: sonichealth api customsupercheck --function to allow another mod to pass its own super prereq check for if a romhack wants to set a specific super requirement supermoveset--function to store super toggles for other mods with the functions having false for off and true for this mod to toggle which allows other mods such as movesets to act differently when super getringcount --this function allows other mods to check ringcount increaseringcount --this function allows other mods to modify ringcount getversion --this function returns the sonic health version addallycheck --expects the function to have parameters customfunc(attacker,victim) param victim mariostate of the player being attacked and param attacker mariostate of the player attacking and the function should return 1 (when the hit player is an ally and you don't want the player to affect their ally),return 2 (when the hit player is an ally and you want the interaction to happen without ring loss), and return 0 otherwise(which causes the hit player to lose rings on hit). get_serversetting -- function that returns the value of a gGlobalSyncTable variable or variables used by sonichealth mod getshield --this function allows other mods to check the player's shield giveshield ----this function allows other mods to give/take away a shield addcustomenemyfunction --this function allows other mods to have custom interactions isplayersuper --this function returns whether a player is super deprecated addsuperenemyfunction--this function allows other mod's objects to have unique interactions with super forms use addcustomenemyfunction instead credits steven3004 - making rings fling out of your position instead of spawning around your position

only-up-64-plugin.962.title: Only Up 64 Plugin
only-up-64-plugin.962.author: DizzyThermal
only-up-64-plugin.962.description: Only Up 64 Plugin (sm64coopdx) ​ This is NOT the Only Up 64 Map Plugin Features ​ ​ Warp System (Disabled by Default) ​ To enable the warp system , the host or moderator must type: /ou64-warps With warps enabled, type: /ou64-practice or use keybind: [X] Toggle Height (Y-Coordinate) on HUD / Player list: ​ /ou64-height - Toggles Character height on HUD and Player List. Click to expand... Ground Pound Twirl (A, Z, A) ​ Rollout after twirl is to not allow consecutive ground pound twirls Ground Pound Jump (A, Z, A on ground) ​ Triple front flip animation instead of jump twirl Ground Pound Dive (A, Z, B) ​ Wallslide ​ Allows wallslide from long jump Instant-Turn ​ Allows for the player to make 180-degree turns when moving slow enough Chat Commands ​ /ou64-height - Toggles Character height on HUD and Player List Click to expand... /ou64-meter - Toggles Height Meter Click to expand... /ou64-moveset - Toggles Only Up 64 Moveset Click to expand... /ou64-checkpoints - Toggles Checkpointing [Mod Only] Click to expand... /ou64-warps - Toggles Warps [Mod Only] Click to expand... /ou64-practice - Shows Warp Menu (Must be Enabled) Click to expand... /ou64-run-timer - Toggles Run Timer Click to expand... /ou64-leaderboard - Toggles Leaderboard Click to expand... ​ Changes ​ Added Leaderboard and Run Timer Added / Refactored Chat Commands Added Checkpoints - modified to work in different areas (thanks djoslin0!) Added exportable server metrics Refactored a lot of the code Added Warp Menu for Practice Added Flood Mod Support Added Area 8 and made the plugin compatible with all versions of Only Up 64 Added Debug Warp system from Only Up 64 Alpha testing to Only Up 64 Plugin (Default Off) Being able to change directions when ground pound diving Using the triple jump action for the ground pound jump (removed original ground pound jump) Sparkles on frame-perfect dive rollouts, wallkicks, and speed kicks. Less jank and higher gravity on the wall slide. Merging changes from the Only Up 64 Alpha Tests Decreased Ground Pound Twirl Y-Boost (42.0 -> 40.0) Decreased Ground Pound Twirl Count (20 -> 10) Allow Wallslide after Long Jump (Like Only Up 64) Known Issues ​ Ground Pound Twirl ends in a ACT_FORWARD_ROLLOUT to make sure you cannot ground pound consecutively. This means Mario does a frontflip before entering free fall. Credits ​ Ground Pound Jump, Ground Pound Dive, and Wallslide are from mods/extended-moveset.lua with some modifications Moveset contributors: @steven3004 Checkpoints: @djoslin0 Recolored player heads: @EmilyEmmi sm64coopdx technical help: @cooliokid956, @andre8739 Testing help: @retrodarkgamerx, @cooliokid956, @colbyrayz.z64

sm64coopdx-manager.510.title: SM64CoopDX Manager
sm64coopdx-manager.510.author: Squishy6094
sm64coopdx-manager.510.description: SM64CoopDX Manager A tool made for managing SM64CoopDX and it's mods How to use: SM64CoopDX Manager attempts to be as user friendly as possible for a console-based manager, but there are some caviates... Getting Dependancies: System - Must be installed on your machine manually in order to use basic Python functionality Python - The language SM64CoopDX Manager is built in pip - Package installer for Python Python Libraries - Must be installed in order to use SM64CoopDX Manager, if pip is installed you can use these commands in your terminal of choice to download them manually. requests - python -m pip install requests chime - python -m pip install chime watchdog - python -m pip install watchdog Starting the program: After installing all of the required dependancies, you should be able to launch the python file in the same way you would an executible file. Once starting, it will attempt to download the Python Libraries above automatically if you haven't already, then you will boot into the Manager Menu! Goals: 1. (Achieved) A User-Friendly console-based mod organizer made to improve Loading / Mod Cache times 2. (Future Update) An Automatic SM64CoopDX Update Notifier and Installer Current Functionality: 1. Mod Organization 2. Mass Mod Loading / Unloading 3. Automatic Mod Backups 4. Improved Mod Caching Times (Dependant on Mods loaded) 5. Booting SM64CoopDX from Launcher 6. Automatic Python Package Instalation Planned Functionality: 1. Automatic SM64CoopDX Update Installation 2. (?) Automatic Mod Update Installation 3. (?) DynOS Organization 4. (?) SM64CoopDX Config Editor/Option Menu

copy-anything.1297.title: Copy Anything
copy-anything.1297.author: SkyCaster09
copy-anything.1297.description: What's inside? That's up to you!​ Copy Anything is a mod that allows you to scan for nearby objects, store them in mystery boxes, and throw them anywhere you want! Features:​ FULL Multiplayer Compatibility 4 Save Slots to Store Objects Copying objects such as Enemies, Obstacles, NPCs, and More! Colorful Mystery Boxes to Lob at Friends or Foes. Controls:​ Hold L to scan a nearby object. Hold L + D-PAD Up, Right, Down, or Left to store an object. Press D-PAD Up, Right, Down, or Left to equip that object. Press Y to get a Mystery Box with the selected object. Extra Commands:​ /kickout : Kicks you out of the current level and to sanctuary if you get stuck. /kickallout : HOST ONLY. Kicks everyone out of the level you are in. NOTICE: Most items can be copied safely, but some items such as ! Boxes are too unstable to copy due to severe lag, softlocks, or crashes, and are unable to be grabbed. The host can allow these objects to be grabbed using the checkbox in the Mod Menu.​ Credits:​ MysterD for their function in the SM64COOPDX Lua documentation on spawning holdable objects and handing them to the player. The SM64COOPDX team for the Lua documentation which provided many useful functions and abilities. Got Feedback?​ Please respond to me on the SM64COOPDX website for feedback, questions, or more. Have Fun ​

Thanks to the new audio stream template by blocky.cmd, riding the Phalanx now plays one of three songs from the game it came from. The current song list is as follows:

Assault (Currently default on Phalanx v1.0)

Moon Side (Currently default on Phalanx TP v1.0)

Bio Cave

To change which song you wanna listen to, open the New!ASEQ.lua file and comment out the current choice, then delete the dashes to uncomment the choice you want. You can also adjust the volume if need be. The PET version of this pack is still in development for its shooting capabilities, however I forgot to add an audio file for it long back so I added its exit.ogg sound.

Sadly I can't do anything further for the pack due to my lack of lua knowledge (It'll be a long while. I learn slow..). Plus, if there was a possibility to change songs on the fly with the mod menu system without having to go into the lua file every time, I'd do it. Plus, when dynos audio becomes a thing, the dynos part of the pack will be updated accordingly with the songs. Now go out and ride on with some fancy tunes.

cs-the-sugar-queen-gang.151.title: [CS] The Sugar Queen Gang
cs-the-sugar-queen-gang.151.author: MtgamesGnM
cs-the-sugar-queen-gang.151.description: 4 original characters have joined SM64CO-OP! They all have unique personalities and vibes and stuff BEA​ The candy thief herself​ Bea is a retired royalty with her goal being 1 thing and that is to obtain and consume the legendary Peach's Cake. Even if she has to take down giant monsters, the cake is worth it all Ms. CLOWN​ Bea's lanky sidekick​ Clown is here to aid Bea on her quest and help her reach some stars she might have more trouble collecting. She stands at an 11 feet tall with her hair brushing against the top of every doorway she walks through DILBO​ Clown's loyal pet​ Formerly a wild animal, Clown picked it up and holds it under her care. However, dilbo tend to wander, so this one found its way in a place it probably shouldn't have. It seems to have taken a liking to the culture of the Mushroom Kingdom and has picked up a few of its popular tunes HORNETTE​ Bea's creepy stalker fan​ A strange entity from an unknown origin, Hornette is obsessed with Bea to the extent that she wants to be just like her. The only issue is that she is so inept at understanding boundaries that Bea simply cannot stand her. However that does not stop her from trying to get her #1 hero's attention. NEW THINGS IN THIS SPECIFIC VERSION:​ Each character now has alternate costumes (Pictured Below) Hornette is now fully-voiced by my friend Pickpen (Artist and character designer for Nessy the NES Robot) All custom animations have been reset to default

updates.title: Triple Baka Deluxe!
updates.changelog: Oh boy, it's been a long while since I updated this mod, and for good reason too! This mod update has been in the works for over 2 months, and I do not say it lightly when I say this mod can very well be considered a new mod considering all the changes and additions given to the mod. It has been almost one year since the first release of [CS] Hatsune Miku , since then, we have grown to include both Kasane Teto and Akita Neru in the pack as well, and the pack has grown a lot of support since then, having over 50k downloads on the Mod Website! I would love to thank you all for your support on the mod, we wouldn't be here today if it wasn't for the people that loved this mod! Lets go over the Changelog shall we? Changelog: Models (Hatsune Miku, Kasane Teto, Akita Neru) Every model has now been redone, giving them a much more needed glowup, some few new details were added on the models, and some were given a much bigger overhaul, like the Mario skins Hatsune Miku Mario Miku Mesmerizer Miku Triple Baka Miku Sonic Miku Magical Cure Love Shot Miku World Is Mine Miku Brazilian Miku Static Miku Kasane Teto Luigi Teto Mesmerizer Teto Triple Baka Teto Shadow Teto SynthV Teto Voicepeak Teto Spoken For Teto Birdbrain Teto Akita Neru Wario Neru Mesmerizer Neru Triple Baka Neru Silver Neru Flop Era Neru Classic Models are also included in the mod (Only the base models) in case you prefer playing around with the original characters Everyone now has their own idles, they also seem to be more joyful running and jumping around (Miku Idle / Jump / Run animations done by Zam Boni, Teto / Neru Idles done by Violet) Options Menu There is now an options menu to customize your playing experience while using the mod Vanilla Animations : Turn ON in order to use the SM64 Animations rather than the new Custom Animations for the Triple Baka Dynamic Eyes : Turn ON to turn on the Dynamic Eyes previously mentioned above Custom End Screen : Turn ON to show the custom end screen at the end of the game rather the vanilla version Custom Cap Music : Turn ON to listen to the lovely custom songs made for the Caps when wearing them, turning it off reverts it back to the vanilla songs Anamanaguchi Miku Ending Music : Turn ON to enjoy the ending music made for the mod (Ending Music by Chalz) Jump Jump Jump UP!!! Ending Music : Turn ON to enjoy the ending music made for the mod (Having both ending music turned on will override it to this one by default, and I heavily recommend this song over the Anamanaguchi Ending) (Ending Music by Chalz) New Additions Akita Neru will now have a low Rin Voicebank instead of the original high pitched Miku Voicebank as her voice. (Voices done by Chalz) Teto now has her own Custom HP Bar! The older Life Icons have been replaced with newer (and much better) Life Icons While using Wing Cap, going into flying mode allows you to ride around on an object based on what character you are using! (Code done by Wibblus) Miku - Leek Teto - Baguette Neru - Cellphone The Base Models for Miku / Teto / Neru all have 5 new palette options for them that you can try out! Of course, you still have the recolorability option if you want to give your own flair to the Triple Baka Vanish Cap now has it's own music (Based on Gocha Gocha Urusee!) star-revenge-8-scepter-of-hope.801.title: Star Revenge 8: Scepter of Hope
star-revenge-8-scepter-of-hope.801.author: SamCardCounter
star-revenge-8-scepter-of-hope.801.description: Star Revenge 8: S c e p t e r o f H o p e ​ About: 121 stars Open world Levels themed around various locations of the Touhou Project series Star Revenge series This is Star Revenge 8, a full-size hack featuring a world of interconnected levels and branching paths, all based on Touhou Project. Collect stars, cap switches, and returning badges from Star Revenge 7 in order to traverse Gensokyo and the realms that connect to it. Story: After the events of Star Revenge 7.5, the Earth was hopelessly pulverized, and the mysterious big star Scriosadh has taken hold of the Scepter of Faith lingering in the planet's remains, shaping the world into it's image: a dark void. Now, Mario, after being brought back from the dead by mistake, must explore the still-intact Gensokyo in search of stars to defeat Scriosadh and recharge the Scepter to reshape the Earth once more; either for better or for worse. Other notes: Navigation map included inside the zip. This port uses v1.4.3 of the romhack. Music sequences, instead, are ported from the v1.0, since the sequences featured in the newest versions utilize custom soundbanks, an impossible task for SM64CoopDx yet. By default, the jingles for both collecting a star and the following hi-score play instead a full, looping music track. You can change this back to a simple, modern jingle by using the comand /newJingle [on/off] . With the command /sr8mode [pointdevice/legacy] or [0/1] you can change between two gamemodes. Pointdevice mode is the default, with infinite lives, 1ups are replaced with full heal items and there is no fall damage. Legacy mode changes it back to traditional lives and fall damage. This romhack, among it's levels, features 2 challenging extra stages. They can only be accessed after inputing a password in a room near of the starting point of the hack. Where is this password? You can find it by either playing Star Revenge 6.9 or defeating the final boss of this hack. This hack will not work properly in versions of SM64CoopDx below v1.3 (preferably the latest, scrolling textures were re-broken until 1.3.1!). There was an attempt at reimplementing jukeboxes back from the More Objects Patch. Star Revenge Lore Order: SR0 ➜ SR1.5 ➜ SR2 TTM ➜ SR2.5 ➜ SR3.5 ➜ SR3.9 ➜ SR4.5 ➜ SR4.9 ➜ SR6.25 ➜ SR6.5 ➜ SR6.9 ➜ SR5 ➜ SR7 ➜ SR7.5 ➜ SR8 ➜ SR5.5 ➜ SRX Star Revenge Classic Lore Order: SR1 / SR1.3 ➜ SR2 NoD ➜ SR3 ➜ SR4 ➜ SR6 ➜ SR6.5 ➜ SR0.5 ➜ SR7 ➜ SR7.5 ➜ SR8 Credits: Brodute (Original hack creator) @SamCardCounter (Porter) @ManIsCat2 (Lots of guidance in order to get started with romhack porting) @flipflop bell , @wereyoshi (Badge and block code) @OneCalledRPG (Custom HUD template) @Blocky (Act select dark mode and audio stream) Coop Central server and Romhack Port Server (Lots of information, and more credits in code files) ElAvionDePapel (Testing) Original

updates.title: v1.1 Changelog
updates.changelog:
Fixes

Corrected SuperBlock and UltraBlock locations in course 7, swapping them back to their intended places.

Added a missing SwitchBlock exception for course 4 and 14, now starting the level with blue pressed instead of red.

Skip intro is permanently toggled on. Peach has already stopped existing alongside the rest of the Earth.

Stay in course when collecting a star is now permanently toggled off, as it is necessary for progression.

Made exclamation boxes that contains metal caps respawnable.

Updated checkpoint flag code to more sophisticated standards seen in the SR2.5 port.

Improved implementation of magma levels in course 4, deviating from it's original implementation.

Lava will now be always rendered regardless of where the camera is. (Thanks Fearl)

Lava will now gradually change height instead of snapping to position. Have fun griefing your friends!

Moved around the home points of the three blarrgs in the deep cavern so that they always work... 

...and yet don't show their ugly head when raising the lava to the highest level. What a pain.

Added

Introduced Legacy mode, for the flawless or traditional plumber.

Accessible through the command 
/sr8mode [pointdevice/legacy] or [0/1]
.

Full power items are replaced back to 1ups, lives are once again limited and fall damage is back.

Default gamemode with infinite lives, full heal items instead of 1ups and no fall damage is now denominated Pointdevice.

Added custom sound effects for collecting full power/1up items. (Thanks to BlockyCmd's audio stream)

I've recieved a few notifications of crashes occurring randomly throught the port, with a few hotspots more frequent than others, like boss courses. If you run into any, feel free to report them, it'd be of great help in pinpointing the reason (most likely a memory leak most frequent when running with many other mods?).

I'm taking it way too easy...

kart-battle-modes.44.description:
Note: The file containing the mod is called "Shine Thief.zip".

It's every battle mode from the Mario Kart series, now playable in sm64coopdx! Featuring many stages, (somewhat janky) Rom hack support, and 
support for all Arena and Tag maps.

Contains the following features:

ITEMS! 
18 unique items, such as Red Shells and Super Stars. You can set these to Frantic or Skilled for more or less powerful items respectively, or turn them off for classic Shine Thief gameplay.

OMM Support!

Various maps from across Super Mario 64

Many variants, such as being on Shells or having a Boost

API that lets you create your own variants and more

Included with this mod is 
Arena Base Stages
, which adds stages from the original Arena mode, and 
Arena DX Stages
, which adds stages featured in sm64coopdx (+ Space Central). Both are compatible with both versions of coop, and credit goes to their original authors, such as AngelicMiracles.

Credits:

Programming: EmilyEmmi (main), EmeraldLockdown (network), NeedleN64 (ceiling climbing speed up), Agent X + others (arena spring code/minor stuff for held items)

Resources: Blocky (Shine model), byNinten501 (Moon model on Models Resource) NeedleN64 (SSL painting), djoslin0 (Shell Rush), Agent X + others (Fire Flower model), viandegras (boomerang model), Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Feather model), Chilly (McDonald's painting), LeoHaha (crown graphic)

SFX: Various from Mario Kart series + Super Mario Odyssey; Super Mario Sunshine sfx provided by NeedleN64

Arena maps: AngelicMiracles + others

Mod icon: HiEpik!

updates.title: v3.7: The Bug Exterminator Update
updates.changelog:
Another small update to fix some bugs with the new Renegade Roundup rules, as well as fix some longstanding bugs such as Showtime starting early sometimes and the Bullet Bill item breaking the camera.

There are 
two
 significant new features this update:

You can now play 2-team Renegade Roundup with the new 3-team rules instead of the classic "Cops and Robbers" rules. This form is referred to as "VS Renegade Roundup" as opposed to "Classic Renegade Roundup".

Added "Custom Item Selection" (shown in screenshot). This allows you to prevent certain items from appearing. You can remove items you don't like, or only enable Blue Shells 
for a miserable experience
. I won't stop you.

Also, Lightning now stuns longer and the Boo steals from the closest player rather than a random one. Full changelog is available with the mod. 
"Shine Thief.zip" is the mod. Base Stages and DX Stages are map packs, and have not been updated since last version.

updates.title: v3.6: The Teams update
updates.changelog:
Medium-sized update; no new maps or items, but there IS a brand new Team Selection option that lets you customize team games! I worked really hard on it, please use it 

Also, you can now play Renegade Roundup with a team count other than 2! Free-for-all/0 teams isn't available, though. This plays a bit different than 2-team Renegade Roundup, so it's basically a new mode!

And as always, more bug fixes and game adjustments than you can shake a Green Shell at.

Check the changelog included inside the mod folder for more info. Also remember that 
Shine Thief.zip is the mod
; Arena - Base Stages and Arena - DX Stages are map packs and have not been updated since last version.

updates.title: v3.5: Long overdue update
updates.changelog:
This game mode has really gotten popular! I've gotten around to fixing some of the most egregious bugs and added many gameplay adjustments, new items, and new features. Since there's a lot of changes, I wrote them down in this 
changelog
 (it's pretty long, so I would just read gameplay adjustments and new content).

(Arena - Base Stages and Arena - DX Stages also received minor updates. Also, make sure you download Shine Thief.zip - that's the actual mod.)

updates.title: Kart Battle Modes update
updates.changelog:
The long awaited update! This update adds FIVE new game modes, along with the original Shine Thief, the blue shell, new variants, new maps, and many other changes. Also sm64coopdx v1.0+ exclusive.

Shine Thief: The original mode, based on Mario Kart Double Dash and Mario Kart 8 Deluxe. Keep the Shine for enough time to win!

Balloon Battle: Classic balloon battle based on entries Super Mario Kart through Mario Kart DS. Eliminate all players to win! You become a Bob-Omb when eliminated. Get revenge on the other players!

Balloon Attack: Balloon Battle with its modern score-attack rules (Mario Kart Wii-Present). Hit players to score points! You lose half of your points when eliminated.

Coin Rush: Based on Coin Runners, which first appeared in Mario Kart Wii. Get as many coins as you can! Hit other players to make them drop coins.

Renegade Roundup: Mode from Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, similar to "Cops and Robbers". Renegades must dodge the Law. Save your teammates by opening the cages!

Moon Runners: Shine Runners from Mario Kart DS. Get as many Moons as you can! The players with the least amount of moons will be eliminated.

character-movesets.191.title: Character Movesets
character-movesets.191.author: steven3004
character-movesets.191.description: One of the older mods of sm64ex-coop is back with a slight bit of overhaul, giving each character fairly unique ways to play. This mod can be toggled by typing /char-mov , in case you prefer your typical vanilla experience. (The moveset is on by default.) Moves list: Mario: Handstand Jump (Crawling + A): Taken some inspiration from DK94 and Mario VS DK, this is basically a triple jump that goes higher, but has less speed. It's ideal for reaching higher spaces that can't be reached with a backflip or a side flip when there is no space to build up a triple jump, or just a fun lil' alternative to any of the aforementioned jumps. Luigi: Passive Stats: Luigi can jump higher and swim faster, but his shoes are rather slippery, therefore affecting his ground traction and speed, and wall kick height. He also has slightly weaker health. Scuttle Jump: By holding A while falling down during some jumps, Luigi will kick his feet to fall slower. Spindrift Backflip: Taken straight from SM64DS, Luigi will do a spinning jump after he falls from a backflip. Spin Pound (Holding Z) : Basically a ground pound, but without the 2 second stop in mid-air and you have more control over it. Toad: Passive Stats: Toad is the fastest character out of the cast. His ground pound goes faster and running can maintain more speed, but his jump height is the worst. His wall kick, however, can be stronger with speed. Ground Pound Jump: Pressing A while landing with a ground pound basically lets Toad do a higher triple jump. Waluigi: Passive Stats: Waluigi moves slightly faster, and jumps slightly lower, while his triple jump is significantly buffed. But due to being built like a stick bug, he loses way more health than any other character. Wall Slide: Instead of light-bonking onto a wall, Waluigi will slide against it, and triples jumps out of one when A is pressed. Elegant Jump: A take one Waluigi's double jump, where upon pressing A during some jumps, Waluigi will twirl in the air with all is Walugrace and be able to instantly switch directions. Air Swim (Dive + B) : Waluigi can defy gravity and swim three times before he falls to a place that's hopefully not his impending doom. Wario: Passive Stats: Wario is a much heavier and stronger guy, so he jumps lower and moves slower. He falls faster with a ground pound and sinks when he's underwater. He can effortlessly lift heavy objects and loses little to virtually no damage, except when he touches lava. Shoulder Bash (Ground Dive) : With this ability, Wario can ram into enemies and objects and send 'em flying. Corkscrew Conk (Bash + A) : A jump that's roughly the height of a double jump Wario can do while shoulder-bashing. He can also do it mid-air, making it a decent recovery move. Wild Swing-Ding: By rotating the stick quickly while running with and object, Wario can spin it like spining Bowser. Note that for now, this is more of a neat visual thing rather than affecting how far you can throw the object. Piledriver: Pressing Z while jumping with an object in hand and Wario will go pummeling down with it. Hope you all enjoy the mod!
