Spin Pound (Holding Z) : Basically a ground pound, but without the 2 second stop in mid-air and you have more control over it. Toad: Passive Stats: Toad is the fastest character out of the cast. His ground pound goes faster and running can maintain more speed, but his jump height is the worst. His wall kick, however, can be stronger with speed. Ground Pound Jump: Pressing A while landing with a ground pound basically lets Toad do a higher triple jump. Waluigi: Passive Stats: Waluigi moves slightly faster, and jumps slightly lower, while his triple jump is significantly buffed. But due to being built like a stick bug, he loses way more health than any other character. Wall Slide: Instead of light-bonking onto a wall, Waluigi will slide against it, and triples jumps out of one when A is pressed. Elegant Jump: A take one Waluigi's double jump, where upon pressing A during some jumps, Waluigi will twirl in the air with all is Walugrace and be able to instantly switch directions. Air Swim (Dive + B) : Waluigi can defy gravity and swim three times before he falls to a place that's hopefully not his impending doom. Wario: Passive Stats: Wario is a much heavier and stronger guy, so he jumps lower and moves slower. He falls faster with a ground pound and sinks when he's underwater. He can effortlessly lift heavy objects and loses little to virtually no damage, except when he touches lava. Shoulder Bash (Ground Dive) : With this ability, Wario can ram into enemies and objects and send 'em flying. Corkscrew Conk (Bash + A) : A jump that's roughly the height of a double jump Wario can do while shoulder-bashing. He can also do it mid-air, making it a decent recovery move. Wild Swing-Ding: By rotating the stick quickly while running with and object, Wario can spin it like spining Bowser. Note that for now, this is more of a neat visual thing rather than affecting how far you can throw the object. Piledriver: Pressing Z while jumping with an object in hand and Wario will go pummeling down with it. Hope you all enjoy the mod!

cs-super-mario-world.776.title: [CS] Super Mario World
cs-super-mario-world.776.author: Wall_E20
cs-super-mario-world.776.description: Ever wanted Super Mario World's Mario playable in Super Mario 64? well, i do, thats why i made: Super Mario World in Super Mario 64! [CS] that's right! Super Mario World! he is not just a simple reskin, he has Moveset! with it A LOT of custom actions! since he is SMW Mario he can't do Mario's Default actions like punching or walljumping (that could be a problem with some parkour challenges... but feel free to switch to normal Mario any times!). About his Moves: A to Jump - Press A to jump, simpler than that! he has only one jump, no double jumps or triple jumps. like in the original game: Hold The Jump Button to Jump Higher or Build up Speed to Jump even more! B to Run - Hold the B Button to Run, He can get fast! maybe you manage to Jump over most of the difficult places like that. Y to Spinjump - Spinjump! one of the most known actions from the SNES the spinjump! you can spinjump on most enemies! some will get defeated and do Poof! others will get no damage so be careful! you can also SpinJump on objects that need Groun Pound to be used, like the big Blue Coins Button! X to Hold Objects - (is possible to use B to grab objects by enabling it in the mod menu) Since it could be done, the X Button is used to grab objects like boxes or bob-ombs, Remember that like the original game you have to Hold Down the X button to keep holding the object and Release it to throw it! It also works with Bosses such as Bowser! Z to Crouch - Press Z to Crouch, Mario will not be abile to move when crouched, but if you move before crouching you will slide on the ground for a bit, allowing you to sneak in small places! Objects and Interactions - Mario is also abile to interact with most objects: Open Doors By walking into them or Grab on Poles by jumping on them and press Up and Down to go Up and Down. Water Movement - When in water, Mario can Swim By pressing A . you can also Grab objects while underwater too! Others - it may happens you get hurt, if you get at 4 Health Points you will get SMALL! right after playng the shrinking animation. But dont worry! Collect Coins To Heal your Health! and you will return BIG again . there are also Winning and Dieing animations, be sure to check them out! While Jumping around the levels, you may notice some Slope Blocks run on them to Climb the Wall and get on top of places! (i placed them for you <3) (Thanks to ManIsCat for the slopes blocks code!) - Stuff you may want to know - Is this mod done? this is a "Demo" Release because i was taking long to make this. in the future Expect some Changes! Like Power ups! from the game! - Is Mario Recolorable? yes, i added an alt Recolorable Costume (is an alt because i couldn't make it Palette Accurate) use that in case you want to use custom palettes! is an ALT COSTUME accessed by pressing right in the cs menu (saying this because apparently people didn't notice) - Does it works online? this works online! i fixed most of the networking bugs, but don't expect to not find them! (report the non-online bugs too!) - Does it have mod support? it should work with most of the mods, don't expect it to work with all mods! THIS MOD ONLY WORKS IF CHARACTER SELECT IS ENABLED! SMW Mario Can be choosen from the CS Menu Be sure you are using the latest version! don't expect this mod to do not have bugs or being accurate to the SNES! This should be all! Thanks for reading and playng my mod! (Thanks again to ManIsCat for the Slopes Blocks code and Altiami and other people from Coop Central Discord server!)

widdlepets.209.description: WiddlePets​ A buddy/pet mod for sm64coopdx, with API for other mods to add their own pets ! Have these lil guys follow you around on your adventure, and give em lil headpats :3 Use DPAD-RIGHT (can be disabled) or the '/wpets' command to open the menu. This version comes with four default pets: Headphone Goomba, Mechakoopa, Fly Guy, and Bob-Omb Buddy ! This mod is made exclusively for coopdx. Ensure that you are using sm64coopdx and do not have ex-coop compatibility turned on.​ ​ If you are interested in mods using the WiddlePets API, check out the GitHub page ! ​

prop-hunt.305.title: Prop Hunt
prop-hunt.305.author: Mr. Bushido
prop-hunt.305.description:
This game mode adds prop hunt to Mario 64. Start the round by pressing L + R + A when at least 2+ players are in the arena. Press left/right on the D-Pad to change map as the host.

This is still in development, as I still have a lot of features (and bug fixes) planned.

Some ideas I have planned are:

"Smart Mode" and "Frantic Mode" for choosing how the props are randomly selected.

Open world mode so that the entire game is the map.

Enemies and NPC's as props.

Please report any bugs or ideas in this thread!

Be extremely subtle, even to the point of formlessness. - Sun Tzu

boyo.96.title: Boyo!
boyo.96.author: Ex Coop Mods Archive
boyo.96.description:
Original Post: February 12, 2023

Author: Karam

Boyo For SM64!

The goofball, pops into the world of [[S u p e r M a r i o]] to strut off his skills!

(Type /boyo on | drips | gat to activate one of the three current versions of Boyo)

Basic Moveset :

Leap! – The replacement for the ‘Long-Jump’, allows you to jump over great distances. Pressing B while performing will cause you to go into a rollout state, slowing down your momentum. (Pressing B while starting will give you a burst of speed!)

Wall Hop! – Bonk, Leap, or Dive onto a wall to scale it! (Diving can be used consecutively.)

Character Swaps – Each version plays similarly to Base-Boyo, just with a few new tricks (more or less), some may be better for specific situations.

Extras :

– Ground-Pounding allows you to transition into Diving and Slide-Kicking depending on if you’re on ground or mid-air

– Slide-Kicking can be done consecutively

– Extra Eye-Poses and Interactions depending on current state

— “10/10 IGN Best Mod” — Best Gamer (Max)

— “Wao-h!” — The Epic

— “thats actually cool” — Crowned Maniac (Intentional Typo)

Thanks to all the little Goobers that helped me find solutions to weird little ‘marmo’ oddities!

mirror-mode.707.title: Mirror mode
mirror-mode.707.author: Pipocalio
mirror-mode.707.description: This mod adds a mirror mode to Super Mario 64, flipping the entire game world horizontally — including levels, objects, and animations. Since it doesn't replace any geometry, so it should work with most custom levels and "romhacks" without issues. Note that this mod only flips the camera controls if you're using the vanilla camera. If you're using a custom one (romhack camera, analog camera, mouse look), you might want to manually enable "Flip X axis" in your camera settings. Also, shoutouts to ManIsCat for helping me fix some rendering issues!

updates.title: Mirror mode 2.0
updates.changelog:
Changes:

Directional dialogs now restore properly when mirroring is disabled in the mod menu, instead of resetting everything.

The end credits are now mirrored.

Several optimizations have made the mod process areas over 
12 times
 faster! These include:

Modified displayLists are now cached, so the mod will not process a display list more than once.

Models with culling disabled are now tracked by the extended model ID instead of the vanilla model ID. This prevents models from potentially being inside out.

Replaced manual camera tracking with 
geo_get_current_camera
.

Removed several redundant hooks.

Note:

This version requires 
sm64 coop deluxe
 
v1.3.2
 

or higher

updates.title: Mirror mode 1.4
updates.changelog:
Changes:

- Fixed "nauseating" (rotating) skyboxes.

    - You can toggle the custom skybox via the mod menu.

- Fixed world not being mirrored after a gameover or level restart.

updates.title: Mirror mode 1.2
updates.changelog:
It's a tiny update, but now the mod works with everything that i tested 

Changes

The mod now can disable culling in optional displaylists (this fixes the area 2 of the overworld in Last Impact being inside out)

Directional dialogs are now restored to the original when mirroring is toggled off in the mod menu.

The 
disable_face_culling
 function now assumes the default RSP geometry mode, provided the geometry mode hasn't been set yet (instead of defaulting to 0). While this doesn't fix anything specific, it's a more appropriate default than 0.

updates.title: Mirror mode 1.1
updates.changelog:
Little update to address some issues you reported:

Changes:

Fixed an issue where the player's model would appear inside-out after changing models

Resolved a bug causing mirror room Mario to render inside out

Fixed models appearing inside-out when objects changed model IDs

Culling is now only disabled when necessary (e.g., during area/level transitions or model changes)

izesavestates-v2-1-5-mod-release-develop.description:
Adds SaveStates to SM64EX-COOP!​

Save up to 4 states at the same time by using the 4 D-Pad buttons

To load states, hold down L and press the corresponding D-Pad button

Each player gets their own 4 local savestate slots (Global SaveStates maybe in the future)

Commands and local settings​

Use /autoload or /al to toggle AutoLoading the latest savestate upon death

Use /autoheal or /ah to toggle AutoHealing after loading savestates

Use /savestates, /savestate, or /ss to get infos about your local settings and slots

Changelog​

SaveStates are now much more accurate and precise

You will now be automatically teleported/warped into the correct level, area and act when loading a SaveState

[HOTFIX-1] Fixed a Softlock-Bug that occurred when entering a level/loading zone under specific circumstances

[HOTFIX-2] The normal coin counter, the amount of already collected red coins and the amount of “collected secrets” are now no longer affected by loading savestates.

Removed the unnecessary color codes in the “mod-name”

Removed Herobrine and added Wario Apparition

cs-madeline.1177.title: [CS] Madeline
cs-madeline.1177.author: VioletSM64
cs-madeline.1177.description: Madeline has climbed so many mountains she reached the Mushroom Kingdom... Help her overcome her own insecurities and defeat Bowser who stole all of her strawberries (and the stars)! Play as Madeline , the young Canadian miss who loves to overcome challenges. Always ready for some most likely deadly platforming. Or... play as Badeline , the dark alter ego of Madeline. She is there to bring pain and torment to... herself? This mod is complete with a brand new moveset based on the videogame Celeste, with all new controls that can change the usual Mario 64 experience! CONTROLS: DASH: Press B to dash in the joystick's direction, you will go slightly up when dashing in midair. Hold A or U-DPAD while dashing for an upward angle. Hold Z or D-DPAD while dashing for a downward angle. Hold no direction to dash straight forward, up, or down. You can jump or kick from a grounded dash. Fly with the wing cap by crouching, then dash jumping. You can jump or kick from a grounded dash, and dive from a midair dash. Dashes will also automatically grab objects CLIMBING: Hold B to grab walls and hold towards it to climb up Climb down by holding away and press A to jump up. TIP: Jumping or climbing up uses more stamina than climbing sideways/down Type /cel_controls if you need to see what the controls are for the Celeste Moveset For advanced techniques, see the Celeste Wiki. Mod also includes custom palettes for Madeline and Badeline based on some of their past adventures! CREDITS: VioletSM64: Pack Creator / Models EmilyEmmi: Celeste Moveset Code MelissaMekrose: Madeline/Badeline VA Crystalika: Strawberry Model

Hold Z or D-DPAD while dashing for a downward angle. Hold no direction to dash straight forward, up, or down. You can jump or kick from a grounded dash. Fly with the wing cap by crouching, then dash jumping. You can jump or kick from a grounded dash, and dive from a midair dash. Dashes will also automatically grab objects CLIMBING: Hold B to grab walls and hold towards it to climb up Climb down by holding away and press A to jump up. TIP: Jumping or climbing up uses more stamina than climbing sideways/down Type /cel_controls if you need to see what the controls are for the Celeste Moveset For advanced techniques, see the Celeste Wiki. Mod also includes custom palettes for Madeline and Badeline based on some of their past adventures! CREDITS: VioletSM64: Pack Creator / Models EmilyEmmi: Celeste Moveset Code MelissaMekrose: Madeline/Badeline VA Crystalika: Strawberry Model

only-up-64-flood-mod.964.description: Only Up 64 Flood Mod (sm64coopdx) ​ Note: This is NOT the Only Up 64 Map , this is Flood Mod for Only Up 64 Areas 1-8 on Hard Mode What is Flood Mod? ​ Flood Mod is a game mode by Agent X - Climb to the top as the area floods! Only Up 64 Flood Mod Trailer ​ coopdx-mods/mods/archived/flood at main · AgentXLP/coopdx-mods Chat Commands ​ /flood start [area] (a1-a8) - Start the round (optional: provide area) Click to expand... /flood speed - Set the speed multiplier manually Click to expand... /flood hardmode - Doubles the speed multiplier for all areas Click to expand... /flood type [type] - Sets the flood type (water, lava, sand, mud, random) Click to expand... /flood reset-all-points - Resets the scoreboard (all points) Click to expand... /flood set-points [player-id] [points] - Sets a specified players points Click to expand... /flood-scoreboard - Toggles the flood scoreboard Click to expand... ​ Changes ​ Free-Cam Spectate -> Auto-Spectate Known Issues ​ Final player spectates nothing on completion New players may not warp to lobby Credits ​ Agent X (Flood Mod v2.4) for original mod and permission to work on Flood for Only Up 64 All the testers helping me fix bugs and find good speeds for all the areas

cs-buckley-tims-poke-pack.189.description: Several Low-Poly Pokemon (Lucario, Zeraora, Cinderace, and Victini) for your Character Select roster. ONLY FOR CS v1.8 OR ABOVE Features Lucario: - full recolor-ability -blue maps to Cap color -yellow maps to Shirt color -black maps to Pants color -white maps to Gloves color -yeah it's the smash ult voicelines lol Zeraora: - full recolor-ability -blue maps to Shirt color -yellow maps to Cap color -grey maps to Pants color -this time I've cribbed Yun's voicelines from Street Fighter IV lol Victini: -orange fur maps to Cap color -yellow fur maps to Pants color -voicelines taken from Tat from Klonoa 2 -sorry in advance if the voicelines are annoying Cinderace: -red fur is cap -white fur is overalls/pants -dark navy blue fur is shirt -yellow fur is shoes -voicelines this time are from Makoto from SFIV -models are original ones made by me, Buckley Tim Enjoy!

updates.title: Cinderace enters the field!
updates.changelog: Been a while since I've updated this pack, hasn't it! I've been trying to add a new character for a while but got distracted by just about everything along the way (to say nothing of the mons I tried to add but weren't satisfied with). But hey, now I'm all ready to add Cinderace to the pack! Some notes about Cinderace: -red fur is cap -white fur is overalls/pants -dark navy blue fur is shirt -yellow fur is shoes -voicelines this time are from Makoto from SFIV, to match how I did Zeraora -voicelines may be changed if I decide I don't like how they play out Model done by me ofc, it was fun making this bunny as always. And of course, thanks for over 7k downloads and 36k views! That's nuts, I'm glad people like this pack as much as I like making it!

updates.title: [v1.2] Victini Added!
updates.changelog:
Have a third Pokemon while I tinker away at other things. Victini will not necessarily bring you victory over that one kaizo romhack, but they provide great morale support!

Fast Facts about Victini:

- full recolor-ability

   -orange fur maps to Cap color

   -yellow fur maps to Pants color

- full voice-acting

  -voicelines taken from Tat from Klonoa 2

  -sorry in advance if the voicelines are annoying

and of course the low-poly victini model was made by me.

Also, I can't thank y'all enough for 2,300 downloads and nearly 10k views! I'm glad y'all enjoy my little pokemon models. Hopefully I can make a few more as long as I still keep up with coopdx modding.

updates.title: [v1.1] Zeraora Added!
updates.changelog:
Well, this mod's going from a standalone Lucario mod to a small pack of Pokemon models (and by small, I mean exactly 2 at the moment). This new update adds Zeraora, the Thunderclap Pokemon, to the mix. In addition, I've given Lucario and Zeraora preferred palettes so you can be their regular colors without effort.

Fast Facts about Zeraora:

- full recolor-ability

    -blue maps to Shirt color

    -yellow maps to Cap color

    -grey maps to Pants color

- full voice-acting

   -this time I've cribbed Yun's voicelines from Street Fighter IV lol

as always, the mario-64-proportioned Zeraora model was done by me.

Hope you enjoy this update that makes everything work with v1 of coopdx!

(also wow, 1k downloads on the first version of this? thanks a lot! glad you enjoy the 'cario.)

super-mario-64-flash-tracks.762.title: Super Mario 64: Flash Tracks
super-mario-64-flash-tracks.762.author: reykappy
super-mario-64-flash-tracks.762.description:
Super Mario 64
: 
Flash Tracks

Game mode inspired by GTA V Online custom races and Fall Guys platforming levels.

The goal is to 
reach the finish line
 as quickly as possible by 
dodging obstacles at top speed and kicking others
 to prevent them from reaching it before you.

	

		

	

If you want to create your own levels for this game mode or modify the existing ones, here you have the 
source code
.

CREDITS:

Creators of the MIDIs used to make the music for this mod: 
Yoshimaster, The Deku Trombonist, SonicFan113, HBreit, DeathBasket, 
and
 AvidGaming.

The rest of the mod has been developed by 
Kappy
.

updates.changelog:
Sections of levels that 
recycled assets
 from other levels have been 
removed
, so that no level feels repetitive.

Instead, the levels have been 
extended
 with 
new sections
 that replace these.

Several sections of the levels have been 
retextured
 to make them feel less monotonous.

Several sections have been adjusted to make the levels 
more accessible
, except for Real Rumble, which is now even more difficult, as it is intended as “the hard level”.

Fixed a lot of bugs.

mario.126.title: MariO
mario.126.author: PeachyPeach
mario.126.description: Portals in Super Mario 64. Inspired by Portal (the game). Controls: D-pad left: Shoot a blue portal. D-pad right: Shoot an orange portal. D-pad down: Close both portals. D-pad up: Enable/disable first person mode. Portal shots open a portal when they collide with a surface, an object or another player. When two portals are open, touch one of them to get teleported to the other one instantly. You can move almost any object from a portal to another, including other players. In first person mode, move the camera with the mouse or the right stick. The first person camera uses the settings of the free cam, so, if you want to change the sensitivity of the camera or invert the axes, pause the game, open the Options and go to Camera. Bind D-pad left/D-pad right to your mouse left button/right button for a better experience. Credits: Authors : PeachyPeach

cmdlib-command-library.604.title: CMDLib (Command Library)
cmdlib-command-library.604.author: kloodi
cmdlib-command-library.604.description:
CMDLib is a command library that helps other mods make commands easier.

There are lots of features including:

Adding Commands

Editing Commands (Not just the description)

Removing Commands

Automatic Argument Parsing

Error Handling

CMDLib commands are prefixed with "!" rather than "/" (For no interfering with sm64coopdx commands)

There are two commands by default that you cannot edit or remove.

!help and !helpcmd, Which give a list of commands and a long description of a specific command respectively.

bowsers-koopalings-character-pack.890.title: Bowser's Koopalings Character Pack
bowsers-koopalings-character-pack.890.author: BassiKun
bowsers-koopalings-character-pack.890.description: With this character pack I bring you the ability to play as a set of characters from Bowser's Koopalings, a Koopalings fan-series on YouTube created by FreezeFlame22! The characters are also all voiced by their voice actors from the show! (Except for one, who instead uses voice clips from the episodes) To install it, simply place the "[CS] Bowser's Koopalings Character Pack" file into your "mods" folder. The Characters all use the Bowser Moveset mod, so make sure to have that installed, as well as the latest version of Character Select. Special thanks to: wibblus and melzinoff for giving me access and permission to use the Koopalings and Bowser Jr. character bases to make these characters. I really couldn't have done this without them! All the voice actors who helped me make this mod a reality. You all rock! My friends over at Discord for encouraging me to learn Blender to make this dream come true. If you guys are reading this, thank you from the bottom of my heart! Cowabunga and FreezeFlame22 himself over on Discord for the sprites used both in the image below and in the character icons found in the mod itself. The people at the Coop Central server for helping me whenever I had doubts with Blender. Thanks to them, I have improved a bit with the program! This mod includes the following characters: Travis Koopa (VA: GengarOfTheOpera): A chill guy with a very laid-back attitude, Travis comes into Super Mario 64 to both save the day while taking it all easy. Lauren Knightley (VA: GlitterGhostz) A nice and friendly, if a bit sarcastic girl. She's an avid gamer and is not afraid of demonstrating her skills! Ally Rook (VA: Carmen) Ally is a very sweet girl who, in spite of her ditziness, does everything in her power to support the ones she loves. Camilla McQueen (VA: Carmen) A vain and selfish girl from the McQueen family. When Camilla wants something, she will do anything in her power to get it. Ember Ford (VA: YuriHaru567) A girl who is as brash and condescending as she is hot-headed. Ember looks down on everyone else and never passes up an opportunity if it means ridiculing others. Jade Garnet (VA: GlitterGhostz) A very mischevious and self-centered girl, Jade finds a lot of amusement in the misfortunes of other people. Eddie Knightley (Voice Clips: Swoldow) Lauren's older brother. He is short-tempred and rather brash, but he is genuinely a good guy underneath that tough exterior. Known Issues: When going into Shell Mode, the shadow size doesn't match the shell. This is something I will try to fix in the future as I eventually figure out how to adjust shadow sizes. Hair often clips through the female characters' shells. This is something I was struggling with due to how little experience in Blender I had. I ultimately decided to leave it as it is, but I may try to fix it in the future.

tag.29.title: Tag
tag.29.author: EmeraldLockdown
tag.29.description:
Tag

This mod is a collection of multiple gamemodes all in one mod! The mod contains 9 gamemodes, modifiers that effect the gameplay of the gamemode, in-depth, easy to understand settings, and statistics!

Gamemodes

Tag contains multiple tag-related gamemodes! All gamemodes involve "tagging" another player. There are as of right now 9 different gamemodes. These gamemodes are Tag, Freeze Tag, Infection, Hot Potato, Juggernaut (meh), Assassins, Sardines, Hunt, and Deathmatch! Each gamemode gives it's own fun to the mod!

Modifiers

There are plenty of modifiers to add variety your game! From simple gravity changes to blasters and fog, modifiers add plenty of enjoyable (or annoying) changes to the base gamemodes!

Romhacks

Romhack support depends on the romhack. Offical romhacks have paintings, and pipes like vanilla levels! Non-official romhacks don't have these benefits, however, the romhack should still work perfectly fine!

Arena Stage

Arena Stages are fully supported, with pipes and all! It is highly recommended to play with arena stages. Downside is you don't get paintings.

Official Tag Stages

Tag Stages include paintings and custom-placed pipes, these are perfect mods to add to your tag experience!

Blacklists

Don't like a gamemode, modifier, or level? Blacklist it! Blacklisting allows you to turn off certain gamemods, modifiers, or levels that you don't like in your game.

Stats

Each player has stats! These stats go from playtime, total tags, and total time as runner, to total runner victories and tagger victories. The best part is each gamemode gets it's own statistics for each of these metrics!

Frequently Asked Questions

sm64ex-coop/sm64coopdx Support:

This mod supports both repos. If you encounter a bug with a specific one, make an issue 
here
 so it can be addressed.

Romhack Compatibility:

Yes, Tag supports romhacks. You can add paintings and more to romhacks by creating what's called an official hack (wow great name!). You can learn how to do that 
here
. The mod also includes a blacklist to remove incompatible levels.

Code Usage:

Generally, you can use code from this mod for your own projects. Credit is not required, but ensure you understand the code and avoid copying large portions without modification.

Custom Versions:

You're welcome to publish custom versions of this mod. However, consider contributing to the main repo first. Ensure your custom version doesn't include code from unreleased versions or other mods without proper credit. Include me in the credits, and I reserve the right to incorporate your code into the base Tag with appropriate credit.

Contributing to the Repo:

Fork the repo 
here
 and contribute by creating pull requests.

Bug Reports and Suggestions:

Report bugs or suggestions 
here
.

Update Notifications:

You can make an account on this site here, and you'll be emailed for when this mod is updated!

Contact Information:

If you need to contact me, visit my profile 
here
.

Arena Map Support:

Yes, Tag supports arena maps and automatically adds pipes based on the CTF flags, and set your spawn to the Flag Tag flag spawn. For additional features like paintings, check out 
this repo
, where well-known arena maps are ported.

afker.1182.title: AFKer
afker.1182.author: codeflex
afker.1182.description:
AFKer 2.0

Category: Administrative/Utility

Description: Ever wanted to take a quick break without getting trolled? How about sitting back and watching the skills of a better player? Or maybe you just want to watch your friend fail that jump over and over?Then AFKer is the mod for you!With a quick press of DPAD LEFT, your character will go into a transparent, intangible, invincible AFK mode! While AFKing, you can press DPAD UP or DPAD DOWN to cycle your camera view between other players in the same level, with independent full camera control!

Press DPAD UP and DOWN while AFK to cycle through other players in that level

Pressing DPAD LEFT while in AFK will cycle between different poses

While AFK, the name of the current romhack is displayed

Text indicator when other players are spectating you

Taking any action disables AFK mode immediately

A 10 second cooldown between activations to prevent abuse

Relevant error, confirmation, and other helpful text shouts

If a player being spectated leaves the level, dies, enters a cannon or engages a cutscene, spectate mode will cycle back to your character

Server wide shouts for players entering or leaving AFK, with a tiny list of AFKing players in the top lefthand corner

AFK mode can only be activated while standing on the ground

Compatibility with 'L for Gangnam Style' mod; press L while AFK to toggle!

2.0 in action: 

	

		

	

Download link: 
AFKer.lua

• Added a soft speed cap to hovering

• water gauge now updates at 500% higher FPS

• Animations blacklisted for Hover, Rocket, and Turbo Nozzles

• Added a buzz sound when trying to hover with no water

===Fixes===

• Fixed taking fall damage when holding "X" with an empty water gauge

• Fixed double water gauge rendering• Fixed hovering on lava

• Fixed camera glitch when hovering out of a water source

• Fixed poll water regeneration• Fixed infinite speed glitch with Hover Nozzle

• Fixed warping to the top of water sources when hovering• Fixed Faulty blink texture for Mario

Commands​
• /fludd renders [true|false] disables or enables the imagery

• /fludd debug [true|false] enables or disables debug mode

hangout-shy-star-village.374.title: Hangout - Shy Star Village
hangout-shy-star-village.374.author: Alestar24
hangout-shy-star-village.374.description:
Apparently all those Shy Guys that came in Peach's Castle recently decided to build their own little harbor town (probably because they were too many so they no longer fit inside), and now they are inviting you to visit this little place called Shy Star Village:

This place is a very simple town (inspired by star road) where you can go after venturing who knows where in order to relax, chat with friends or even roleplay.

This town feature a big main mansion, a little restaurant where you can recharge your energy, a pipe to get back at Peach's castle, a simple parkour to warm up for the next adventure and a lot of little cute houses, all with furniture inside!

I wish you a pleasant stay here at Shy Star Village!

(This is an hangout map, the warps should work with most of the rom hacks. Plus, note that this is my first ever map, i created this as a test ground to learn how maps making works. I had a lot of fun making this, but there could be some bugs around. If u find any, DM me on discord pls. Have fun!)

kaizo-mario-64.829.author: jonathanoflebones
kaizo-mario-64.829.description:
A hack made by OmegaEdge29 and Released in 2009, Kaizo Mario 64 is a romhack of the game that cranks up the difficulty by a 
BRUTAL
 amount.

It fills every level with annoying enemies, deadly fire, and other kinds of dangerous traps. Even though the level geometry is the same, collecting all 120 stars is one HELL of a challenge. 

There was an old port of this hack, but as far as i know that one is very old, dated, and inaccurate. Plus it was never uploaded to this here mod site.

 

This version also improves on that porting it from scratch and fixing all incorrect object positions and bugs that caused the original port to be unbeatable in certain levels. And as far as i know all stars are possible so, good luck.

 Now also the corresponding keyboard buttons/keybinds will work too (Check the settings in the main menu)​

Developed by iZePlayz​

updates.title: AgeVerificationMod v2.2
updates.changelog: This update introduces a dynamic age-verification system in sm64coopdx that tests players' attention spans when joining the game. To pass, players must continuously hold L, R, Z, A, and B while regularly pressing and releasing the D-Pad Left. The duration is randomly set between 60 and 120 seconds. Any movement, releasing a button, or failing to press/release D-Pad Left within 3 seconds will reset the timer and restart the test. Additionally, custom sound effects and music have been added to enhance the experience!​

spotifycoopdx-custom-voicelines.817.title: SpotifyCoopDX & Custom Voicelines
spotifycoopdx-custom-voicelines.817.author: kikwee
spotifycoopdx-custom-voicelines.817.description:
THIS IS A 2 PART MOD READ EVERYTHING TO UNDERSTAND!!!

SpotifyCoopDX:

Bring your spotify playlist to sm64coopdx! add your .mp3 files to the sound folder and add the

file path, song name, artist name, and length of the song in the "add-songs.lua" file. (the limit of of megabytes (MB) of songs is maxed at 35 MB combined (no i cannot change this if u have a problem with it ask the sm64coopdx developers))

Commands:

/pause pause a song

/unpause unpause a song

/restart restart the playing song

/skipto (song ID) skip to a song

/skipmany (number) skip a multiple number of songs

/skip skip song

/playlist shows list of songs in your playlist

/song shows song info

Custom Voicelines:

YOU CAN NOW ADD CUSTOM VOICELINES TO SM64COOPDX IN THE EAISEST WAY POSSIBLE!!! Add your .ogg file in the sound folder and add your .ogg file in the "add-voicelines.ogg" (example: [CHAR_SOUND_OKEY_DOKEY] = 'your voiceline.ogg',).

ITS AS EASY AS IT GETS YOU CAN'T MESS UP (but if you do just message me)

cs-peanut-marshal.1154.title: [CS] Peanut & Marshal
cs-peanut-marshal.1154.author: SideofSquid
cs-peanut-marshal.1154.description: Peanut & Marshal from Animal Crossing as playable characters in Super Mario 64! This is my first custom character mod and the first time I have ever rigged a model successfully. None of this would be possible without Garrulous64's amazing tutorial on how to do this along with the Coop Central discord server. I would've been able to complete this project sooner, however using Toad as the base model proved to be a mistake for these characters as I've had to do some manual adjustments to allow the limbs to be (mostly) normal. After meticulous testing, I am confident there are nearly no issues. These characters are complete with voices, blinking animations, no weird mesh overrides, and color customization! CREDITS: -The character select template by Squishy -The original model from Animal Crossing Pocket Camp Ripped by Centrixe on The Models Resource

bowser-gauntlet.825.title: Bowser Gauntlet
bowser-gauntlet.825.author: EmilyEmmi
bowser-gauntlet.825.description:
Bowser In The Sky is replaced with the Bowser Gauntlet, where you must play all three Bowser stages in a row and then fight the final Bowser. If you've played BAZR, it's pretty similar to that.

You're given both keys by default, and BitDW and BitFS are inaccessible from their normal areas. You can also disable Gauntlet Checkpoints for a tougher experience- if you die at any point in the Gauntlet, you have to try again from the beginning!

Not compatible with rom hacks, but it IS compatible with MarioHunt, as far as I know.

mob-control.527.title: Mob Control
mob-control.527.author: ProfeJavix
mob-control.527.description: This mod allows players to control the different mobs of SM64 and use their (almost) vanilla moves. Just go near them and press X when you see the prompt to take control of them. Then look at the controls on screen, mess with other players and have FUN! Don't forget to check the Mod Menu options to adjust things such as the control distance or some HUD settings. There is also an integration with EmilyEmmi's MarioHunt, so if you use that mod, there will be some changes in order to account the team mechanics (also check the Mod Menu and the MarioHunt specific options). This is the original mod. If you saw it somewhere else before this post, maybe with a different name, please make sure to report it and use this one. Thanks to TheIncredibleHolc for some tips and cool ideas! Also thanks to my pals, the Fantacastasmas , for all the testing! Bounty from Drenchy Watch his video HERE ! Made by: ProfeJavix ​

cs-pet-deep-cut-splatoon-3.820.title: [CS+PET] Deep Cut (Splatoon 3)
cs-pet-deep-cut-splatoon-3.820.author: funkymonkeyjay
cs-pet-deep-cut-splatoon-3.820.description: It's Splatsville 's very own idol group, Deep Cut , here to reap the spoils hidden within the Toadstool Castle walls of the Mushroom Kingdom ~! ​ FEATURES My take on Shiver , Frye , and Big Man , in the style that is somewhat akin to the SM64 model style, all recolorable! A Salmonid Smallfry that follows you around, made possible with the "WiddlePets" mod, with fully recolorable hair as well! A palette of faces for a wide range of expressions! Some new animations! New music for power-ups, star collect, mission selection... and a very special one hidden somewhere in the endgame , which can all be turned on/off using the "/deepcut_mus" chat command! Compatible with "Character Select" v1.14 onwards! DISCLAIMER This mod will only work if you have either one or both of the "Character Select" (If you just want to have the playable characters) or the "WiddlePets" (If you just want to have the Smallfry) mods enabled, which you can obtain through the following links: Character Select [Squishy6094] WiddlePets [wibblus] Special thanks to @SwagSkeleton95 for giving me tips on how to add custom music that can be turned on/off! Credits to sources I've used for this mod + trailer are in the video's description! ​

updates.title: Sneak Peek at a Future Update!
updates.changelog: It's been a while since our beloved Deep Cut made the scene on Peach's Castle , and I must wonder, whatever happened to the other idol groups? Y'know, the Squid Sisters ? Off the Hook ? Where are they? ... Well, they're on their way! Introducing; SplatIdols 64! (... or I could call it the "Now Or Never Seven Pack", either way, it's still a work in progress, I'll decide a new name once I'm done) ​ That's right, I'm making an update to this mod to add Callie , Marie , Pearl , and Marina as playable characters (maybe even the Inklings/Octolings...?) , and not only that, I'm going to be adding a bunch of other new stuff to this already fishy platter; [ ] An extra move for when you press the [L] button, in which each of the idols get to use their signature weapon to help them obtain Power Stars ! [ ] A total rework of the "extra faces" gimmick, giving the characters a TON of unique expressions + bringing back the unused directional eyes! [ ] A rework of the Deep Cut characters, fixing Y-offsets and odd, buggy rigs! (looking at YOU, Big Man...) [ ] Semi-accurate hair physics! (Only for Callie and Marina) [ ] Hairstyles for Smallfry from "Splatoon 3" ! [ ] Costumes (Hypno Callie, OE Pearl, etc.) - Implemented / - Not Yet Implemented / - Semi-Implemented / - To Be Decided I can't define a proper release date yet, but I have been posting updates through my Bluesky , so stay tuned! So, with that being said and done... Stay fresh, and don't get cooked, stay off the hook! ​

cs-paper-partners-64-ttyd.47.description: Please make sure you have Character Select 1.11!! ​ Paper Partners 64 + TTYD is CS pack with 23 characters! It includes EVERY Paper Mario Partner! And includes sounds for every partner, some even voice acted! Also includes features to make it even more special. Characters include: Goombario - Goombella Kooper - Koops Bombette - Madame Flurrie Parakarry - Baby Yoshi Lady Bow - Vivian - Watt - Admiral Bobbery Sushie - Ms Mowz Lakilester But it includes lot more bonus characters: Blooey, Torque, Hayzee, Screamy, Jerry, aka Luigi's partners are in too! All characters have custom caps, sounds and icons. PM64 characters have custom celebration stars, the star spirits! TTYD characters have custom celebration stars, the crystal stars! Thanks wibblus for the overall support on this mod and Squishy for the palette presets!

I also want to take the time to talk about common issues and how to resolve them:

- All sounds are broken: You're probably using an outdated mod called Extra Characters that is built in with coopdx > update Extra Characters!

- Bobbery crashes the game: You're using the directX build of coopdx > use OpenGL if you can, if not, deleted the file in the actors folder called bobbery_geo.bin

the-amazing-emote-pack-for-mario-64.1289.title: The Amazing Emote Pack for Mario 64
the-amazing-emote-pack-for-mario-64.1289.author: BlueBandit226
the-amazing-emote-pack-for-mario-64.1289.description:
Make Mario and his friends bust some amazing moves with this mod!
 

	

		

	

How to use:

Download the mod and drop the "The Amazing Emote Pack for Mario 64" folder in your mods folder

Make sure you enable the mod before hosting the game

Hold D-PAD down (or equivalent) to open the emote wheel

Highlight the emote you want to do by rotating the left stick

Let go of D-PAD down to select the emote

Press the L trigger (or equivalent)

Slay 

Notes:

In online play, emotes can sometimes desync. Reselecting the emote usually fixes this.

The custom animations can sometimes have weird effects on the game. I do not recommend using this mod in any serious gameplay like speedrun.

Song credits can be found in the "song credits.txt" file.

Feel free to share any feedback or suggestions. Or just some funny moments you've had while using the mod!

Special thanks to the maker of the '
L button to gangnam style
' mod for the inspiration to make my own emotes.

And the developers of the 
Fast64
 Blender mod. I used this to make the emotes in Blender.

Have fun!

tether-x.1291.title: TETHER-X
tether-x.1291.author: SkyCaster09
tether-x.1291.description:
Swing Around, Spiderman Style!​
Tether-X is a tether/grapple mod that allows you and your friends to swing around stages using an instant grappling hook!

	

		

	

Features:​

Smooth, custom swing physics to fling across levels.

Two aiming modes to suit your preference.

Customizable hook length, crosshair size, and colors.

FULL multiplayer support.

Controls:​

Press and hold Y to send out the grappling hook.

Hold Z to air brake and slow down while swinging.

Hold A to bounce off the ground while swinging.

Hold D-PAD Up and Down to extend and retract the hook.

If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to reply.

Enjoy! 
​

overlay-fxdx.1259.description:
Overlay FXDX adds a very simple set of visual filters inspired by classic hardware and display styles. Switch between multiple retro and stylized overlays directly in-game, including N64 CRT, VHS noise, glitch effects, low-res and more.

Lightweight HUD system

Multiplayer-safe sync*

Mobile support included* (Will improve over time)

Controls:

L Trigger
 - Cycle overlay modes

Touch / Mobile button (Overlay)
 - Cycle overlays on screen

DEMO
(v1.0

	

		

	

How to install: 

Extract
 the zip

Drag & drop 
the mod folder 
OverlayFxDx-v1.0 
inside your [mods] folder

Remember to 
enable
 the mod by selecting it within the mod menu inside the game. 

Enjoy! Leave a suggestion or two on what other overlays you'd like to see added or adjusted.

 

*Multiplayer has been tested with 
no known
 compatibility issues with other mods, please report any that may occur. I'll do my best to fix them! Thanks!

 Added README.md with instructions as well!

updates.title: v1.1.3 (Bug fixes + Mod menu addition)
updates.changelog:
After a bit of an oversight this update adds a nice patch to OverlayFxDX

- Adds a settings menu via hook_mod_menu with:

"Show Mode Indicator" checkbox to toggle the on-screen HUD overlay bar and mode list

"Enable Keybindings" checkbox to toggle L_TRIG/X/Y button cycling

"Filter Mode" slider for directly selecting an overlay mode (0-14)

Mode reference labels for all 15 filters

General bug fixes and polish 

Thanks to 
@Esscey
 
for contributing the improved OverlayFX rendering logic and helping improve compatibility.

Head 
here
 if you'd like to check out development!

updates.title: v1.1.2
updates.changelog:
Added and expanded multiple visual overlay filters for effects change

Reworked 
BLUR
 into a combined CRT with scanlines, soft blur layers, and a fixed N64-style sun flare in the top-left (WIP)

Rebuilt 
VHS 
with tracking jitter, tape noise, and scanline instability for a more authentic analog distortion look

Reworked 
FILM
 to use true grayscale-style instead of simple dark tinting

Improved 
UNDERWATER
 with a stronger blue tint and subtle particulate drift for clearer visibilty

Enhanced 
HEAT HAZE
 with stronger red/brown color grading and layered distortion for a more intense atmospheric feel

 
FUZZY SIGNAL
 now will use pixel-loss corruption and missing block artifacts instead of noise

Maintained full COOPDX 1.5.1 compatibility with controller and mobile input support

Retained original overlay cycling system and fading UI selector

luigis-mansion-64-marce-version.761.title: Luigi's Mansion 64 (Marce Version)
luigis-mansion-64-marce-version.761.author: jonathanoflebones
luigis-mansion-64-marce-version.761.description: A very strange romhack that also happens to be Titled 'Luigi's Mansion 64' but that's where the relation to Mansions ends, it was created by an user named Hacker Marce. RHDC says the release date is unknown but I can confirm that this hack is incredibly old, maybe around 2008 to 2009-ish. I tried to port it as accurately as I could to preserve this old oddity hack once I remembered it's existence once again. It contains a few weird custom levels as well as various alterations to vanilla levels. The only one I couldn't get working as of now is Lethal Lava Land, as it seems to have been modified in very primitive software and current Romhack Porting Tools can't take account for that. I believe it'll have to be recreated manually, which I may try eventually. There's also a bit of text in spanish, strangely not for the rest of the game though. If you're curious as to what this is, go ahead and download it. See if you can make any sense out of it. There are 7 stars that can be obtained but you can go further than that if we count vanilla levels.

updates.title: Lethal Lava Land Restored
updates.changelog: Changelog: -Restored frauber's Flat Lethal Lava Land Click to expand... After trying for the entirety of today, I successfully restored all of Lethal Lava Land from the original ROM into Co-Op! This level also happens to be an edited version of a Classic level created by frauber, one of the SM64 romhacking pioneers that dates back to 2008. It was an edit of LLL so primitive that modern porting tools like RM2C couldn't extract it, until now. As I have taken the task to recreate it myself manually as accurately as I could solely modifying the original LLL's level files. This level would also later appear in SM64: The Missing Stars with an updated layout. The level can be beaten, the only issue as of now is that some objects don't stay on top of the custom platforms but it doesn't halt progress whatsoever. Enjoy!

sharens-animation-overhaul.262.title: Sharen's Animation Overhaul
sharens-animation-overhaul.262.author: Sharen64
sharens-animation-overhaul.262.description:
Since I'll be out of my home for a few days and be unable to work on anything, I decided to give you all a small sample of what I've been working on.

This mod changes a bunch of Mario's animations to give the game a bit of a different feel, as well as make a couple of extra changes to him
 
(which may or may not end up transforming this into a Sharen's Details DX but I do not promise anything).

So far: 
Idle, First Person, Walking, Running, Halting, Turning around, all 3 basic jumps, Freefall, Sideflip, Backflip, both Long Jumps, Wall Jump
 (with a new firstie animation!), 
all of the respective jumps' Landing animations, Crouching, Uncrouching
 and 
Crawling
 have been re-animated.

Also makes Mario open his hands on a couple of animations, makes him look around when strafing in the air, and makes heavy use of the unused eye states.

All of these can be toggled in the options menu.

piggybacker.1225.title: PIGGYBACKer
piggybacker.1225.author: codeflex
piggybacker.1225.description:
Ever wondered what it'd be like to BE the Yoshi? Or how about a Goomba in a Goomba stack? No?

How about wishing your much, much, much more skilled buddy can carry you across gaps, make those mega wall jumps, and do all the work for you?

Well now you can with PIGGYBACKer - a mod that allows you to ride other players! And to add to the fun, you can stack as many players as you want!

FEATURES:

Stack as many players as you can! Mount up by pressing DPAD DOWN or ground pounding on a fellow player!

Many popular characters have custom offsets, so they can ride/be ridden correctly! Kirby, MMX, even Petey!

Riders can punch and use most special attacks, including MMX arm cannons!

Like Yoshi, abandon your mount mid-jump for that extra boost height! Try chaining this together with many players and see how high you can get!

Options to enable/disable when riders get dismounted automatically! Ground pound dismounting, Side Jump Dismounting, Dismounting when Damaged, and Ledge Grab dismounts

Enable or disbale GOOMBA STACKING if you prefer just a single rider per player!

STACK SIZE WEIGHT EFFECTS increases the strain on the player at the bottom of the stack, moving slower and jumping lower the more players they are carrying!

Stack assist camera helps keep those large stacks in frame!

Disable B button attacks prevents players from using their attacks while riding

Better Riding Pose is an exparimental riding pose that looks a lot better, but still has some issues when it comes to animations and attacks. Proceed with caution

updates.title: 1.1 - SIDEKICKer compatibility update
updates.changelog:
1.1 - Compatibility for SIDEKICKer, MMX and Link

- This update adds full integration for SIDEKICKer, allowing that mod's sidekicks to seamlessly piggyback other sidekicks when players ride each other

- Also added is full compatibility with MMX characters and Link, who previously could not use their projectiles and weapons while riding. Since this required direct modification to how MMX and LINK:HotPS handle things on their end, both mods come with their own compatibility .zips contained within Piggyback, along with the necessary file replacements that need to be made. Note that this is intended for the regular riding pose, not the experimental one (yet - future version will focus on addressing experimental riding pose issues more)

- some minor bug fixes

no-bljs.110.title: No BLJs
no-bljs.110.author: Spring E. Thing
no-bljs.110.description:
Enabling this script as a mod when hosting a server for SM64-CoOp DX will prevent the famous 'Backwards Long Jump' glitch from being possible.

Server hosts have access to the chat command 
/no-blj
. Executing this chat command proving either an argument of 
on
 or 
off
 will 
enable
 or 
disable
 the mod respectively. By default, the mod is 
on
.

This script is an edit of an existing script by community member 'Sunk' who's script was intended to permit the BLJ glitch to be possible regardless of the properties of the surface Mario was performing the glitch upon. The script that I wrote for this addon pretty much just inverts the conditions and removes some unneccessary sections past this decision such that the one condition under which the BLJ glitch is possible in vanilla SM64 no longer exists.

set-checkpoints.569.author: Q10isarobot
set-checkpoints.569.description:
This mod lets you set a checkpoint at any time within a level!!!

While holding the L button, Press up on the D pad to set a checkpoint location.

While holding the L button, Press the Y button to travel to your checkpoint.

If no marker is set you will return to the start of the level

This is useful for very challenging maps such as "only up", level testing, and preventing softlock.

I may change the model for the checkpoint but for now its a ! symbol

I realize someone else made something like this after I already made the mod so this is another option.

you are free to use or reuse the code in my mod in your own mod

cs-doorway-divers-favchars.745.title: [CS] Doorway Divers (FavChars)
cs-doorway-divers-favchars.745.author: Fav
cs-doorway-divers-favchars.745.description: Dummie, Frank, Huggert, and Panella have come to invade Super Mario 64!​ Who said modding in your OCs wasn't fun? ​ Dummie has two extra jumps he can use at (almost) any time! From your base jump, to side flips, to even long jumps! He even has a faster running speed!​ (Fun note: Wall kicks replenish your extra jumps!) As a bonus, if you happen to have your wing cap on or activated the special triple jump, the last jump will change! Pull off some sick tricks with this! As Frank, you can fly around by double jumping for a short amount of time before he gets tired. If you hold jump again while flying, Frank will burst upward, and hover back down until you let go of the button. Use the second jump to thrust yourself based on your directional input!​ Huggert's a lot slower than the rest, but makes up for it with his lower gravity. If you hold jump again after your first jump, Huggert will use the power of the stars to float upward, and slowly descend back down. Great for long falls downward!​ Panella's a lot stronger than the rest, capable of carrying objects easier, no matter the weight. If you ground pound and press A or B at the right time, Panella will either perform a Super Jump, or a Super Kick. Your directional input will influence where she'll go!​ ​ I hope you enjoy this mod as much as I did making it!​ ​ Credits: Garrulous64 - Mario 64 Modding Tutorial Video CoopDX team - Referenced code from the built-in Extra Characters mod to better understand how movesets are structured Dummie - For being a good boy ​

updates.title: V2.1 - Cleanups, Colors, and Content
updates.changelog: Hiya folks! I've been meaning to release this update to the mod for a while, even if its not as big. Oh, and happy new years! Changed the mod's official name from FavChars to "Doorway Divers." Gone are the days of being unoriginal by having your username and then "Chars" afterwards LOL Updated the in-game mod description Updated Panella's main model due to missing certain details Panella's slidekick is now slipperier, making her moveset's ability more useful Added Panella's "Off the Clock" alternate outfit Panella now has her own set of custom caps Fixed Huggert's dropped caps not recoloring properly In-Menu Character Select V1.16 credits support Added a huge load of new palettes for each character! In total, there's roughly around 70 new palettes! Think you can guess what each one references? (Making them is fun, alright?)

updates.title: V2 - FAVCHARS
updates.changelog: After a little while, the gang's all here! ​ This update features 3 newcomers to the pack, along with some tweaks to Dummie! Added Frank​ Added Huggert​ Added Panella​ Added support for Character Select's 1.16 menu update (futureproofed!!)​ Added menu animations​ Added several new premade palettes​ Added character category​ Decreased Dummie's running speed a smidgen​ Polished Dummie's textures a bit​ Reworked Dummie's recolorability to be more accessible​ Gave Dummie a cookie for being a good boy​ ​

cs-fazbear-64.325.title: [CS] Fazbear 64
cs-fazbear-64.325.author: SwagSkeleton95
cs-fazbear-64.325.description: Fazbear 64​ Welcome to Freddy Fazbear's Pizza the Mushroom Kingdom, where fantasy and fun come to life!​ In a special crossover, Freddy Fazbear and his band have been invited to the Mushroom Kingdom to throw a big pizza party! (Oh, and William Afton is there) Unfortunately that dastardly King Koopa, angry that he wasn't invited, has taken all 120 pizza slices and scattered them throughout the painting worlds. Now it's up to Freddy & friends to recover them all before they get cold, and show that big turtle what for! ​ FEATURES: -7 new playable characters!​ -Freddy Fazbear (Comes with golden Freddy alt!)​ -Bonnie the Bunny (Comes with movie palette alt! ) ​ -Chica the Chicken (Comes with...No alts.)​ -Foxy the Pirate (Comes with unwithered alt!)​ -Endoskeleton​ -The puppet​ -Springtrap (Comes with Spring Bonnie alt!)​ -Custom graphics!​ -A custom, Fazbear-themed health meter​ -Custom star models in the form of pizza slices, dead stars and gift boxes (May be overriden by other mods)​ -A custom lives icon based on the unused lives mechanic from FNAF 1​ ​ MORE TO COME: In the future, I'm hoping to add: -A custom story that replaces the dialogue in the game if you're playing as the band (Toggleable)​ -Edited stats for Foxy (And maybe the rest of the band? Toggleable)​ BUGS I'M AWARE OF: -None!​ THE LATEST VERSION OF SQUISHY'S CHARACTER SELECT IS NEEDED TO USE THIS MOD! ​

updates.title: v0.4.5: A couple of fixes
updates.changelog: A couple of model fixes. Springtrap is now recolorable! All transparency issues (that I was aware of) have no been fixed as well.

updates.title: v0.4: The Puppet update!
updates.changelog: The puppet joins the cast of Fazbear 64! For now, this is all the characters I want to add in the mod. The puppet comes with a staggering single custom sound and a custom star model in the form of a gift box! This update also fixes some minor errors, and gives Springtrap his own custom star. Enjoy!

updates.title: v0.3: The Springtrap update!
updates.changelog: Everyone's favorite yellow (formerly) rabbit joins the mod! Freddy and friends aren't quite so thrilled to have him here, but he's here. This update adds Springtrap, who comes with new sounds, a new life icon, and a Spring Bonnie alt. Note that while Spring Bonnie is recolorable, Springtrap isn't (yet). This'll come in a future update, hopefully. This update also fixes some oversights from the previous update, namely a faulty error message, and Foxy's animations being applied universally. Have fun!

updates.title: v0.2: The Foxy update!
updates.changelog: He's a little bit late, but Foxy the Pirate joins the crew! This update adds Foxy (I'm sure you guessed), who comes with an unwithered alt, new custom sounds, and a custom longjump animation based on his FNAF2 jumpscare. But wait! A secret fifth character has joined! There is now also a bare endoskeleton to play as. In other news, the future plans for the mod have expanded a little bit. I'm hoping to give Foxy different stats from the rest in the future (buffed running speed and longjump distance, in particular), and another future update will be adding completely custom dialogue to the game, altering its plot to match the silly little pizza party synopsis from the modpage, exclusively if you're playing as Freddy or any of his friends. Both of these will be toggleable. Have fun!

cs-shy-guy-64.250.description: Rejoice Shy Guy fans, cause they just arrived in sm64coopdx ready for everything! This [CS] pack features a revisited model of the vanilla Shy Guy of sm64, but now he has recolorability, custom icons and sounds. Plus, there are A LOT of alternative styles to fully customize your own Shy Guy and more will arrive in the future (a big thanks to Squishy for helping me in the code for the alt. costumes). So, what are you waiting for? It is Shy Guy time! (P.S. This mod requires the latest Character Select mod version to work)

updates.title: [CS] Shy Guy 64 1.6
updates.changelog: Ladies and gentlemen, after an enormous amount of time, they are officially back, it is Shy Guy time once again! For this time, a lot of new fellow Shy Guys have arrived, lets see them all: 1. They took a pause from the kart world to have fun with us, say hi to the Pit Crew Shy Guy and Shy Gal ! 2. He has done the Cool Cool Mountain slide like 1000 times someone pls stop him, the Slope Styler Shy guy ! 3. Directly from Ninja Hideaway, this guy its a master sushi lover, the Ninja Shy Guy ! 4. He is a member of Bowser elite squad, ready to serve always, Sergeant Guy ! 5. Now you are gonna wonder, why the hell this one is dressed like a chicken , welp that a mystery for the amazing Shy Guy Mystery Hour to solve (go see Saltydkdan's video, you will love it) (and no, its not a chicken jockey reference). 6. The MarioBro Shy Guy has found his pants yay, and apparently he has been joined by another plumber fanatic, the MarioSis Shy Gal ! 7. And for last, the one you all have been waiting for, ready to lead a new army, the great leader from Paper Mario, General Guy!!! And wait, thats not all! There are 2 more festive themed Shy Guys coming in the Festive DLC, the Birthday Shy Guy and The Scuba Shy Guy ! Plus, the entire code of this mod has been updated with the latest CS stuff, so now all the different styles has unique descriptions and the names are displayed correctly, even inside npc's dialogues! Aaaand the voicelines are now a bit more loud, to match other characters voices. And at last, to prevent the overpopulation of Shy Guys in this mod, I decided to split them in 2 different packs, one with all the classic Shy Guys and one with all the bizarre Styles that I made, called FanMadeDLC . By doing so you can just select the packs you like to prevent absurd loading times for online play. So, thats all... Damn that was quite a lot uh? I hope you will enjoy this update and thank you so much to have played with Shy Guy 64. See ya! (The modpack contains 2 different .zip files, so you will need to extract it, then you can just drag and drop the 2 other files in the game). (This mod requires the latest version of Squishy's Character Select mod).

updates.title: [CS] Shy Guy 64 1.5
updates.changelog:
Here we go again with another update, lets see:

1. This is going to be a very colorful update because Preset Palettes are here! The normal Shy Guy, the Spear Guy and the MiniGal got a total of 9 different palettes, representing all the classic Shy Guy Colors while all the others got their own unique ones (maybe I will add more in the future).

2. The Guy from the old wild west has become even more threatening with his new jacket, ready to redeem the next bounty!

3. The best toast chef in the world got his classic tie back!

4. To thank all of you, I made and added a new Shy Guy to honor the wonderful sm64coopdx community, the most swag of all the Shy Guys, the Community Fan Guy!

And thats not even all! Xmas is close and i made a present for all of you:

From now on, together with Shy Guy 64 updates i will release special DLCs containing extra themed costumes for Shy Guys, starting with the Festive DLC that will be released soon!

For the future? I received a lot of suggestions for other costumes, don't worry I didn't forget them, they are still in w.i.p. so stay tuned!

I am also planning to add custom power meters in the future, i just have to figure out how to do it.

And yes, other mods different to Shy Guy 64 are planned too.

So, see you next time my dear Shy Guy Fans and have fun!

(P.S. The latest Character Select mod version from Squishy is required for this mod to work).

updates.title: [CS] Shy Guy 64 1.4
updates.changelog:
The spooky scary days has finally arrived, and even the Shy Guys wants to celebrate, even tho everyone do that in their own ways, it is still going to be a fabulous thriller night! So lets see what is inside the bucket:

1. This guy, directly from Paper Mario, got very inspired by the dias de los muertos, so he decided to take his guitar and celebrate in the streets with his healing solo, the Sombrero Guy!

2. I'm pretty sure he is dead, but wow nice halloween costume! We are going to need a Luigi to stop him scaring people around. I'm talking about the eyeless Ghost Guy!

Thats all for this spooky update, have fun collecting candies and stars with the new Shy Guys, see ya!

updates.title: [CS] Shy Guy 64 1.3
updates.changelog:
Hello there, here we are again with a new update, lets see:

1. A new Shy Guy joins the team, the most famous variation, which even appeared in the film, the Snifit! (I still don't know how I managed to forget about him, sry Snifit)

2. Updated all other costumes code, there were some recolorabilty issues, especially with the Metal Cap, Toady outfit and YEAHTOAST outfit, but now everything is fine! (I hope)

More and more Shy Guys are coming to Peach's Castle and more will arrive in the future.

Plus, feel free to contact me on Discord for any suggestion or problem with these Shy Guys.

Until next time, see ya!

updates.title: [CS] Shy Guy 64 1.2
updates.changelog:
You really thought these Shy Guys had disappeared huh? Well no, they were busy, they were trying to understand what the newcomer was trying to tell them, the only words they understood were like "YEAH TOAST!!!!!!"

Apart from that, here's the new stuff:

1. Added a new style, directly from the SMG4 universe, the weird Shy Guy obsessed with Toasts!

He comes with recolorable butterfly wings and a nice toast for everytime he gets a star.

2. The Toady Shy Guy got a totally new better looking hat, so that shades are not to moot anymore.

3. The Chef and the Party Shy Guy got improved hats, what a style!

4. Some minor modification

So yeah, for now the Shy Guys will just try to understand the Toast Guy (is he happy, scared, hungry? idk), but more Shy Guys will arrive in the future (and I am open to suggestions!).

Until the next time Shy Guy fans 
.

2. Solved some compatibility issues

climb-attack.119.title: Climb Attack!
climb-attack.119.author: eeliottheking
climb-attack.119.description:
In Climb Attack, players race to climb as high as possible on a randomly generated tower by strategically placing blocks. The goal is to outclimb your opponents and reach the highest point before the time runs out. The player who climbs the highest wins the round!

This mod introduces a block-building mechanic inspired by Minecraft, allowing players to construct their way up the tower using a limited number of blocks. Players must carefully manage their block resources and plan their ascent while avoiding obstacles and competing against other climbers.

Key Features:

- Random tower generation: Each round, a new tower is procedurally generated, ensuring a fresh and challenging experience every time.

- Block building: Use the Y button to place blocks and create your path upwards. Punching or kicking blocks will refund your block count.

WARNING
: This mode has a 
LOT 
of objects!  
Do not play with 16 players!
  Do not play with 10 players with max settings for the tower!  You will get 
lag
!  If you experience desynch due to lag, issue
 /round restart 
to try and resolve the issue!

Chat Commands (for server host):

- /round restart: Force the current round to restart and initiate a new cleanup round.

- /set-num-boxes (number): Set the number of boxes to spawn for the tower (default: 100).

- /set-match-duration (number): Set the duration of each match in seconds (default: 90).

tiny-qol-pack.1281.title: Tiny QoL Pack
tiny-qol-pack.1281.author: ExploxionMach64
tiny-qol-pack.1281.description:
This mod adds a few quality-of-life features to make the gameplay a bit more enjoyable.

Here's what it includes:

Coyote Time

(Taken from my Characters Physics (Explosive Flavour) mod.)

Gives you a few extra frames to jump after leaving the ground. It also works with Double Jumps, Triple Jumps, Rollouts, Wing Cap Triple Jumps, and more.

Star Heal

Don't like being forced to leave the level after collecting a Power Star? Me neither! That's why I made this feature. Collecting a Power Star now fully restores your health, even if you've already collected that star before.

Longer Metal/Vanish Caps

Doubles the duration of the Metal Cap and Vanish Cap. They now last 40 seconds instead of 20! I've always wondered why the Wing Cap lasts a full minute while the other two only last 20 seconds.

That's all! I wanted to make something small and simple. You can also toggle each feature individually from the mod menu.

( Pause → Press R → Mod Menu → Tiny QoL Pack )

See ya!

KNOWN BUGS: Uncharged MMX projectiles currently do no damage Some characters, like King Dedede, currently have incompatible abilities NAMCO fights having strange arena boundaries Videos: MarioFIGHTer: Bridge fight

cs-dry-bowser-bowser-moveset-compatible..title: [CS] Dry Bowser (Bowser Moveset Compatible!)
cs-dry-bowser-bowser-moveset-compatible..author: Garrulous64
cs-dry-bowser-bowser-moveset-compatible..description:
EDIT (v2): I've re-started the mod from scratch after getting some assistance from Melzinoff. Dry Bowser now has multiple parts to recolor, opens his mouth when spitting fireballs (but lacks wings as a result), has no more issues with his arms/animations, AND has a new Dead Eye texture.

Mod Includes:

Dry Bowser Skin (NSMB DS Model)

Recolor Support (Hair -> Hair, SKIN -> Stomach, SHIRT -> Shell, GLOVES -> Hands/Feet, EMBLEM -> Eyes, CAP -> Wristbands)

Custom Caps (Bowser's Minions! Paragoomba, Boo, and a Chain Chomp)

Bowser Moveset Support! (Shell Spin + Fireball | Enable Bowser/Bowser Jr. Moveset Mod to use | Credit to Wibblus)

Voice Pack (Bowser's Inside Story - Kennie James Voice)

Dead Eye Texture

updates.title: Fixed all issues & Increased Quality!
updates.changelog:
Thanks to Melzinoff's help and guidance, I've re-done Dry Bowser from scratch and fixed all his issues! He now doesn't have any weird arm problems, opens his mouth when spitting fireballs, removed the script error related to a missing sound file, added in Dead Eye Texture, and made it so each of his parts are now recolorable individually instead of all being in one slot (I genuinely just liked how that looked, but it's better this way for sure).

Still has Bowser Moveset compatibility (Shell Spin, Fireball, Heavy Stomp SFX - Credit to Wibblus)

I've also replaced the Metal Shell with a Chain Chomp instead as it looks much better than the shell model.

permadeath.1134.title: Permadeath
permadeath.1134.author: Dan_SM64
permadeath.1134.description:
For Coopnet Only!

(This doesn't work with Direct Connection.)

If a player dies, that player stays dead for the rest of the session!

If guests reconnect after dying, their death is remembered via their Coopnet ID.

You cannot exit course while midair or in a dying animation.

Reloading the server resets all deaths.

Use /deaths to see the list of dead players and the death count.

CREDITS:

Written by Dan

string_without_hex() function by birdekek

DISCLAIMER: Anyone is allowed to modify and republish this mod as they wish, as long as they credit the original work on this mod. Thanks for playing!

only-up-64.963.title: Only Up 64
only-up-64.963.author: DizzyThermal
only-up-64.963.description: Only Up 64 (sm64coopdx) ​ About ​ Only Up 64 is a romhack created by Kaze and thelegendofzenia This whole mod is one big, tall level that takes around 25 minutes to complete - if you don't fall. Climb the biggest level ever made! (as of today) You can use the GP dive and the GP spin to have an easier time in this game but difficult mode is doing it without them! Mod Description ​ This mod is just the Only Up 64 map and original music. Nothing else is required to feel the pain , but if you want the moveset and more goodies, keep reading. Only Up 64 Plugin ​ The Only Up 64 Plugin (sm64coopdx) provides the following features: Only Up 64 Moveset: Ground Pound Twirl (A, Z, A) Ground Pound Jump (A, Z, A on ground) Ground Pound Dive (A, Z, B) Instant-Turn Wallslide Character Heights on HUD and Playerlist Warp System Leaderboard / Run Timer Exportable Server Metrics (Used for Dizzy's Abyss ) Playerlist Server Start Time Server Heartbeat Please make sure all mods are on the latest version for the best experience! ​ Only Up 64 Flood Mod ​ Flood Mod Support for Only Up 64. Flood Mod is a game mode by Agent X - Climb to the top as the area floods! ​ Chat Commands ​ /ou64-music - Toggles Only Up 64 Original Soundtrack Click to expand... Known Issues​ Warps can rotate camera for non-free camera Only Up 64 Map Blender File ​ This mod wouldn't be possible without Kaze releasing the Blender file for the map. Here is my modified one for sm64coopdx: Only Up 64 Blender File The Blender map was recently optimized by going through each object and removing unused textures. The file size has been reduced from 536.5 MB to 186.4 MB ! Only Up 64 Mario Blender File ​ The Mario model wouldn't be possible without Kaze. Thank you Kaze for permission to use it in this mod: Modified Mario Blender File Thank you SonicTheHedgeHog64 (originally known as ThePerfectMario64) for post-processing the textures to work correctly. Warning Must use Blender 3.2+ with latest Fast64-Gart Edition - NOT mainline fast64 or legacy fast64-coop Changes ​ Added Star Model from original ROM Hack (thanks ColbyRayz, Kaze) Added Mario model from Only Up 64 ROM Hack (thanks SonicTheHedgeHog64) Fixed some bugged textures (e.g., Vaporeon's eyes, Kakuna's eyes, Koopa flag, end Mario) Made end Mario recolor off of sm64coopdx part colors (i.e., cap, glove, etc - thanks SonicTheHedgeHog64 for painfully helping with this) Credits ​ Kaze and thelegendofzenia for creating the original ROM Hack and giving permission to port the ROM hack and use the custom Mario model. Cooliokid956 for helping with map backwarping, various other bits to make this all work, and dealing with my Python tendencies (nil not None!!). SonicTheHedgeHog64 for post-processing the textures to work correctly in the end Mario and helping me with recoloring the end Mario. ColbyRayz for tracking down map issues (without warping!) to help identify bugged textures and for getting permission and providing the Only Up 64 star model. Soundtrack : MusicByAI - Only Up 64 OST: AI-Generated Chill Lofi Vibes . Special thanks to everyone else on the sm64coopdx Discord who helped with testing and debugging this mod to make Only Up 64 possible!
