nuzlocker.1212.title: NUZLOCKer
nuzlocker.1212.author: codeflex
nuzlocker.1212.description: NUZLOCKer is a mod that allows you to run a highly customizable nuzlocke! Starting a nuzlocke will assign players a selected pool size of randomly drafted characters Dying will remove that character from the current pool, and automatically switch you to a new character in your pool 1-ups will award a new character to your pool Dying on your last character will result in a GAME OVER. -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------HOW TO START: Start session > mod menu > NUZLOCKer > choose your settings > START NUZLOCKE ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ FEATURES AND OPTIONS: START NUZLOCKE: Starts a nuzlocke with the current settings END NUZLOCKE: Ends the current nuzlocke for all players - POOL TYPE: GROUP POOLS will draft one pool shared by all players in the session. PERSONAL POOLS will draft individual pools for each player in the session - RANDOM START: When enabled, randomly selects your first character when the nuzlocke starts; disable this to use your currently selected character - ALLOW CHARACTER SELECT: Allows players to utilize Character Select during a nuzlocke - POOL SIZE: Select the amount of characters drafted into the current pools. - GAME OVER RULE: FREEROAM mode allows players who lose their entire pool are allowed to freeroam, but are left in a flickering, intangible state to mark them as out of the current nuzlocke 1-UP mode allows the player to return to the nuzlocke with one more life, allowing them to rebuild their pool with 1-ups - MARIO MOVESETS ONLY: Only assigns characters that have basic Mario-equivalent movesets. (Since this couldn't be reliably auto-detected, more whitelisted characters will be added with updates) - ADD SKINS TO POOL: Treats different skins/costumes as unique characters, and adds them to current pools. ALLOW PLAYER POOL REROLL: When enabled, allows non-Host players to reroll their current personal pools with the mod menu ALLOW PLAYER CHARACTER REROLL: When enabled, allows non-Host players to reroll their currently selected character POOL PANEL: Enables/disables the panel that displays the active pool; disable to play blind. PALETTE RESPAWN: ON allows other palettes to be selected for pool characters OFF only will use base palettes CUSTOM will use the player's custom palette RANDOM will randomize all palettes - CAP 1-UP POOL SIZE: Caps the pool size, preventing 1-ups from awarding more characters passed the POOL SIZE setting - QUIT NUZLOCKE: quits the current nuzlocke for you only - RANDOMIZE CURRENT POOLS: allows the host to force-reroll all active player pools - RANDOMIZE CURRENT CHARACTERS: allows the host to randomize the characters currently being used by players - RANDOMIZE MY POOL: when enabled by the host, allows individual players to reroll their current pool - RANDOMIZE MY CHARACTER: when enabled by the host, allows individual players to reroll their current character - RESET MOD: ends any current nuzlockes, and refreshes NUZLOCKer (use if bugged or glitched) - MANUAL SWITCHING: allows players to swap with another character in their pool on-the-fly by holding L + R & DPAD UP or DOWN -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- KNOWN BUGS: Sometimes, voicebanks get applied wrong, particularly for base SM64COOP characters Rarely, RANDOMIZE CURRENT CHARACTER/MY CHARACTER will add a character to the current pool Sometimes palette settings not behaving correctly, or only showing up on the local device 'Game over' mode is intangible to other enemies and players, but player can still collect coins and stars until I find out how to solve this

updates.title: 1.1.1  The Manual Switch Update bugfix + changes
updates.changelog:
- Characters were not being reliably lost from the current pool on pitfall deaths, or being lost on pause menu level exits. This should be now fixed, and pitfall deaths will now reliably remove a character, while level exits retain the current character in the pool.

- CONTINUE NUZLOCKE should now work more reliably on a per save file basis; however, changing options before selecting CONTINUE may still result in unforeseen consequences

- Based on player feedback, a RESTORE LOST and OFF rule has been added to 1-UP options. OFF results in a pure nuzlocke, with no characters being gained from 1-UPS. RESTORE LOST will only restore characters you've already lost from the current pool, with no new characters being added beyond the pool size. RANDOM still behaves as before, adding a random character to the current pool, and ignoring the pool size cap unless the 1-UP CAP option is on

- To prevent abuse, MANUAL SWITCHING now requires the player to be not moving on solid ground to use. This prevents players from quick swapping to another character right before a death.

- Some text spam has been addressed when it came to blasts in group pools

updates.title: NUZLOCKer 1.1 : The Manual Switching update
updates.changelog:
This small first update to NUZLOCKer looks to address some reported bugs, and adds a couple features:

NEW FEATURES:

- MANUAL SWITCHING:
 When enabled by the host, allows players to hold L + R and pressed DPAD UP or DOWN to switch between different character in your pool on-the-fly. Keep an eye on those player indicators in a Group Pool Panel to see who's switching to whom.

- GAME OVER RULE: BUBBLE
 forces any players that receive a game over into a bubble, with any 1-ups collected by still-living players in group pools re-opening a slot for them to de-bubble into and return to the nuzlocke.

- CONTINUE NUZLOCKE (W.I.P.)
: A first attempt at saving Nuzlocke progress for a later session. Currently has some functionality: saves whenever the filesave does, and you can end the nuzlocke for now by having the host quit the session, or select 'End Nuzlocke'. The next time you select 'Continue Nuzlocke', it should reload your pools where you last left off. <<Warning>> Hitting 'Start Nuzlocke' will write over any currently saved nuzlocke on that file.

- QUICK DRAW CONTINUES
: When getting a GAME OVER and becoming a ghost in a group pool, you can instead wait for a still-living player to collect a 1-up; at that point, the first game over'd player to press B will return to the nuzlocke alive

BUG FIXES

Non-bubble deaths, pitfalls or solo deaths should now properly always remove a character from your current pool

1-UPs should now reliably add a new character to your pool in all circumstances

An accumulating lag resulting from random palettes and multiple player pools has been fixed

More focus on making sure new nuzlockes start with exactly the intended pool size (less +1 or -1 drifting)

KNOWN BUGS

- PALETTE RESPAWN: ON is supposed to choose a random preset palette on respawn, but currently usually selects custom or random instead

RANDOMIZE CURRENT POOLS sometimes not randomizing non-host player's personal pools, or adding +1 to their pool

CONTINUE NUZLOCKE reloading the wrong, or older, saved pool (this is likely due to an issue of when and how saving occurs -- more player feedback is needed)

Sometimes, START NUZLOCKE will start will +1 to the intended pool size

GAME OVER RULE: BUBBLE has had some softlocking issues solved, but suspect some may persist. more player feedback needed

Likewise with GAME OVER RULE: FREEROAM. Currently, the best work around is either select the 1-UP rule, which brings the game over'd player back into the nuzlock with 1 life, or do not engage the game over by pressing L + R, and wait for a living player to collect a 1-up to return to play

Switching nuzlocke options during a live run may work, but may run into unintended side effects. Eventually, option switching during a live run will be blocked/limited

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

COMING SOON:

PvP NUZLOCKE: Personal Pools where killing other players steals their character

TEAM NUZLOCKE: Personal Pools shared by multiple players. Will have PvP option, number of players per pool, and team selection.

STARLOCKE: Starting with 1 life, only stars reward new characters

SHOPLOCKE: Collect more coins, buy new characters, gain bigger pool

GAME OVER RULE - MARIOHUNT:  Game Over'd players can attempt to stop living players from completing the run

PERSONAL RESPAWN PALETTES: Allows individual players to select their own palette respawn rule

ROUND ROBIN DRAFT: Starting a new personal pool nuzlocke will engage a take-turns round robin draft first, with drafted characters unable to be drafted twice.

TOETAGGer ICON SUPPORT: Display your next few characters on the ToeTagger panel

CHARACTER TRADES: On-the-fly trade with another player's current character

updates.title: v1.1 Update: Bowser Fights, Hub Courses, and More
updates.changelog:
COURSES

All 3 Bowser Fights have been added, as well as corresponding bosses from the supported ROM Hacks. Bowser Fights have been adjusted to prevent softlocking (Code snippet borrowed from MarioHunt).

Peach's Castle has been added, as well as the HUB Areas from Star Road and SM74.

Lethal Lava Land has its Wing Cap and Shell boxes removed.

FEATURES

The host can now SKIP courses in full-game mode via D-Pad Right (Solo Records will not be saved if used).

Player Interaction (PvP) is now available as an option via /pvp.

The host can now use /autohost to automatically start rounds and skip courses (Each course is skipped after 10 minutes).

UI / HUD

The course select has its colors redone.

"All Levels" has been renamed to "Full Game"

Full Game mode now displays a total star counter.

The race timer has been adjusted for the host so that it doesn't cover the D-Pad guide.

vanilla-sm64-title-screen.1287.author: SomeRandomDude
vanilla-sm64-title-screen.1287.description: Gamebanana Mod Page Using the Character Select mod might show UI that is supposed to be shown after the title screen and not in the title screen, but it shouldn't cause too much issues. This mod ports the vanilla SM64 title screen into SM64 CoopDX. Includes the title screen on start up and game over screen on game over. It works similar to Render96 v4.0's title screen on SM64 CoopDX. Mario's title screen head is recolorable, but it's actually a built-in function to the game, surprisingly, so I didn't do any code to that part.

learn-to-make-code-mods-resources-and-tu.title: Learn To Make Code mods Resources and Tutorials
learn-to-make-code-mods-resources-and-tu.author: Q10isarobot
learn-to-make-code-mods-resources-and-tu.description:
Do you want to make Code mods and don't know where to start? Start here!!!

This mod contains many useful code resources that are easy for a beginner to understand and use.

I have also made a tutorial (featured below)  and more are planned to come.

this mod contains SEVERAL code mods in one folder, they are meant to be used as starting points for you to make your own mods

RESOURCES:

HoldLtoenterPU.lua = this is the mod that is made in my tutorial video, hold L to multiply players current speed * 2.

this will allow you so much speed that you can clip into 
parallel universes
.

PlayerSizeControl.lua = press dpad up or down to make player bigger or smaller, press Y to return to 0

PressLtoResetinStartMenu = while the game is paused, press L to reset players position to the start of the level. this is a conveniant way to prevent softlock. ROMHACK MAKERS: you can copy this code into the main.lua file in your romhack, this is great for testing maps or just keeping players from getting softlocked.

PressUptoSpawnRandomEnemy.lua = press the up button to spawn a random enemy near the player

Simpletimer.lua = a timer that counts up every second as you play

CyclethroughActions.lua = view all of the actions in the game (minus some that would cause softlock)

Cyclethroughmodels.lua = view all of the 3d Models in the game (minus some that dont show up)

Soundtest.lua = test all sounds from the game (minus some that are silent)

Bigmario Example.lua = an example of mini mario and Mega mario powerups

SpawnanevilSmiley.lua = an simple example of a custom Enemy

TUTORIAL:

	

		

	

	

		

	

LINKS:

Hooks List

Mario State

Constants

More Examples

Player Sounds

PERMISSION

all of the code in this mod is free to use in your mods no credit.

this is a resource to use as a starting point to make your own mods

-example big and small mario powerups

- "can you beat mario if you grow every 30 seconds" example mod added

wanted.127.title: Wanted!
wanted.127.author: PeachyPeach
wanted.127.description: Remember that New Super Mario Bros. / Super Mario 64 DS minigame? This mod includes both a single player and a multiplayer version. The goal is simple: the player has to find one of the four characters (Mario, Luigi, Wario or Toad) amongst a large crowd of the others. You can play with a controller, but also with a mouse: bind your A button to the right click (not left), and you're ready to play! Single player​ The default version. The player starts with 10 seconds and gain 5 seconds and 1 point each time they select the wanted character, but lose 10 seconds if they select any other one. The game ends when the player runs out of time. Multiplayer​ This version is auto-enabled as soon as another player joins the game. Players have 30 seconds to find as many wanted characters as possible. Selecting the wanted character gives 1 point, but selecting any other one removes 1 point. The game ends when the timer reaches 0, and the player who has the most points win. Settings​ Some commands to customize your game: /wanted scores: View your single player high scores. Only the top 5 ones are saved. /wanted settings: View the game settings. Host only: /wanted reset: Reset the game settings to their default value. /wanted : Change a setting before the game starts. Settings are: level_start: Starting level. time_start: Starting time in seconds (single player). time_max: Max time in seconds (single player). time_bonus: Time gained in seconds (single player). time_penalty: Time lost in seconds (single player). time_multi: Duration in seconds of a multiplayer session. Credits: Authors : PeachyPeach

an-ordinary-coop-mod.391.author: Blocky
an-ordinary-coop-mod.391.description:
This was planned to be released on Halloween

its a bit late but whateverThis mod has two seperate "modes",

-Vanilla game

-Dark mode

When the game goes dark you won't be able to collect stars or keys,

you must collect 25 coins (or more depending on the player count) in order to make the game turn back to Vanilla, 

personally managed to get 70 stars with a group of friends so a full playthrough is of course possible

This mod is only compatible with Vanilla, and will be in the "Romhacks" tab when you'll want to select it

There is also an "entity" that will chase you in levels at night (off by default), to enable it do /aocm

coin-requirement-modifier.244.title: Coin Requirement Modifier
coin-requirement-modifier.244.author: Dragonary
coin-requirement-modifier.244.description:
Coin Requirement Modifier

Created by Dragonary

Ever find yourself struggling to find the last red coin, or just too lazy to grab all 100 coins?

This mod allows you to easily change the number of coins needed for the 100 coin and red coin stars with these 3 simple commands:

/coin [number]
 - Change 100 coin star requirement

/redcoin [number]
 - Change red coin star requirement

/resetcoins
 - Reset both coin star requirements

Only the host can run these commands, so you don't need to worry about people messing around with them in a public server.

updates.title: v1.1
updates.changelog:
Each command now sends a chat message after using.

It also checks whether you inputted a valid number that is 1 or higher, and makes sure you can't input a ridiculously high number.

Any bugs or script errors should be fixed now.

arena-hangout-thps-1-warehouse.31.title: Arena (& Hangout) - THPS 1 - Warehouse
arena-hangout-thps-1-warehouse.31.author: BuckleyTim
arena-hangout-thps-1-warehouse.31.description:
The iconic first level from the (n64 version specifically) of the first Tony Hawk's Pro Skater is now available to explore in Super Mario 64 PC Coop, in 2 forms nonetheless!

This mod comes with both a Hangout and an Arena version!

Hangout

 Not too much to say about the hangout version: it's the original stage ported to this game, with a recovery heart and wing cap box to cover any shenanigans that might take place during a hangout.

Ghost-Edit: To get to the hangout, type "/warehouse" in chat. This mod is about as plug-and-play as other hangout maps in that regard.

Arena

  Now this is where things get interesting. I mirrored the map and turned it into a very not-serious arena mode map (that still works with all 7 modes and now has a custom variation of the one song you know very well). Blue side has mirrored textures because I thought it was funny to leave it like that, I swear. There's some jank leftover from trying to brute-force into the arena framework, but hey what's a fun arena game-night without silly maps like this?

Nevertheless, if y'all run into any issues with this let me know and I'll try to make an updated version that fixes whatever arises. Except for the parts where you can get on the top of the level in the middle. That's another "I thought it was too entertaining not to leave it in" decision on my part, lol.

backup-star-warp.32.title: Backup Star Warp
backup-star-warp.32.author: wereyoshi
backup-star-warp.32.description:
when collecting a star or key spawn a star copy that other players can use to follow you. Made for scenarios where you need to collect a star to go to a certain place which would otherwise require you to take turns collecting the star or synchronize your star collection with other players. if everyone wanted to go there.

This mod has an api _G.backupstarwarp which contains

getversion - this function returns the back up star warp version

get_backupstarwarpbehaviorid - this function returns the behavior id of the fake star

addactioncheck - this function is for adding actions that you want backup star warps to have ignore backup stars

addtostaridcheck - this function is for if you want backup star warps to only work for certain stars

hangout-final-fantasy-7-gaia-overworld.6.title: Hangout - Final Fantasy 7 - Gaia Overworld
hangout-final-fantasy-7-gaia-overworld.6.author: BuckleyTim
hangout-final-fantasy-7-gaia-overworld.6.description:
This was supposed to be an April Fools joke entitled "FF7 FULL GAME (REAL)", but bugs and crashing errors got too far in the way for me to meet my self-imposed deadilne. Those are all fixed now, so I might as well upload what I consider to be pushing the limits of coopdx's ability to render exported maps as workable level entries.

This mod contains 3 hangout maps representing the northern, eastern, and western continents of FF7's overworld map. There are a few errors (such as the bridges on the west continent) but given how long it takes to export these maps it's passable I suppose.

Probably for the best if you play this with a mod that increases your movement abilities. Or maybe not, sometimes it's just cool to get lost in the world of another game from Mario's point of view...

Edit:

Access the maps by typing either /ff7-east , /ff7-west , or /ff7-north into the chat.

Also comes with a midislap I did of the overworld/main theme into a combo of the m64 and mario party 2 soundfonts.

This was supposed to be an April Fools joke entitled "FF7 FULL GAME (REAL)", but bugs and crashing errors got too far in the way for me to meet my self-imposed deadilne. Those are all fixed now, so I might as well upload what I consider to be pushing the limits of coopdx's ability to render exported maps as workable level entries.

Probably for the best if you play this with a mod that increases your movement abilities. Or maybe not, sometimes it's just cool to get lost in the world of another game from Mario's point of view...

insta-death.559.description:

This is a simple challenge mod for SM64.

you can still swim normally underwater and regain your health when you resurface, but any other damage in the game will kill you immediately.

compatible with all game modes and rom hacks!

	

		

	

This is just a simple challenge mod, I like seeing videos like "can you beat sm64 if ____" (cant jump, floor is lava, ect) but most of those videos are using classic romhacks and I want to bring some of those challenges to SM64 coop

I may make other similar challenge mods for coop in the future

gore-hard-mode.422.title: Gore/Hard-Mode!
gore-hard-mode.422.author: TheIncredibleHolc
gore-hard-mode.422.description:
Gore/Hard-Mode!​
Category: Romhack

Difficulty: 10/10

Take a dive into the challenging world of 
Gore/Hard-Mode!
 Often called "Real life Mario 64", this mod originally started as a port of Kaze's Unfair Mario 64. It quickly grew into a cursed lovechild between Unfair Mario and 'I Wanna Be The Guy' sporting ridiculous obstacles and gory inspiration from both. Be prepared to die numerous times in unexpected ways!

Features:

120 completely obtainable stars. 
(Some speed-run tactics may be needed!)

20 collectable challenge trophies with a special prize if you unlock them all. 
(Trophy hunt starts after 50 stars collected.)

Player behavior overhaul. Prepare for Splats, crunches, chomps, and many new ways to die!

All existing vanilla enemies now have new and upgraded behaviors.

Some levels have been modified for extra difficulty! 
(Can be disabled by using Romhack Compatibility mode)

Entirely original secret boss fight.

"I Wanna Be The Guy Mode" - Plays identical to the mod, but you start at zero stars. On death, all progress (Stars, keys, flags) are all reset back to 0... Current record is 21 stars!

Togglable options for in the Mod Menu. 
(
Romhack Compatibility, Enable Hell on Game-over, Enable PVP deaths, Enable IWBTG Mode, Enable Dizzyness.
)

Compatible with Rom-hacks, Arena, Flood, and more! 
(Enable Rom-hack Compatibility mode if needed.)

Gore Team

Incredible Holc 
- Project Lead.

  - Major technical contributor that kept this project going and brought the toughest ideas into existence!

@Blocky
  - Major technical work, enemy behavior contributor, lots of other things including the 
secret final boss
!

updates.title: Gore/Hard-Mode! v1.1 Update
updates.changelog:
Same mod, but updated with a number of different bug-fixes and tweaks! You should definitely upgrade to this version!

Fixes:

Pressing Dpad Down no longer gives player 3 stars. (This was a leftover function for testing.)

Players no longer have doubled/tripled speed when flying or sliding with others present.

Fixed camera for Free_cam users in the final boss fight.

Fixed Piranha Plant and Pokey characters from doubling/tripling projectiles.

(HMC) Fixed Dorries Cavern rendering bug when elevator clipping.

(TTM) Fixed script errors when leaving slide.

(TTM) Fixed warp point for when Mario leaves the slide.

Heave-Ho enemies no longer kill all players when launching one player.

Partial fix for certain audio instances playing multiple times.

Shockwaves now travel faster, so be on the lookout for that.

You can now hear other players splat.

As always, please report any bugs to me so I can fix them. Thanks! -IncredibleHolc

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.14

Giga Attacks with screen dimming no longer fully dim the screen, and enemies are no longer positioned above the dimming. This created problems where enemies would in some occasions not have their original position properly restored

Shadow Armor Giga Attack has less start up frames

Fixed an unintended behavior that made air Giga Attacks restore the airdashes and dash states

Fixed an issue with Giga Attacks that prevented pausing while they were active

X/Alia:

Added the aerial Double Shot/Cross Charge Shot animation

Zero:

Increased double jump height, but not by much

Adjusted damage values

While intangible during the first frames of Ryuenjin, it was not possible to collect items. The state has been changed to "invincible" which has the same effect but lets you collect items.

:

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.13
updates.changelog:
Fixed a glaring bug introduced in v1.2.12 that made Goombas register hit effects even during their squishing/knockback animations, which is quite annoying. This had to be fixed, hence this patch.

Water Balloons no longer register hits during their explosion animation.

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.12
updates.changelog: An update that originally meant to address issues reported after v1.2.11 released. I was told that the mod causes softlocks to happen for mods such as Fly Guy pet mod or Yoshi's flutter jump or Peach's float in extra chars, but I could not reproduce any of the mentioned problems despite trying different combinations of mods. Therefore, all I can say regarding this is to have all of your mods and coopdx updated to their latest versions. Assuming no other breaking bugs surface, this will be the last update before v1.3, which will still take a long time. Changes: Added Neutral Armor X. It has no special attributes for the time being. Added sanity checks that caused mods such as Mario '96 to show script errors. Gaea Armor Giga Attack, Shadow Armor Giga Attack, and Rekkoha are now fully intangible. Meaning they no longer get squished and are no longer affected by some of the stronger lingering hitboxes like Bowser or Chain Chomp. However, their charge time has been increased to compensate for this. Fixed a bug where charge effects would appear fixed in space for other players who are outside of the player's field of view. Fixed a bug where online desyncs causes weapons to sometimes not interact with Goombas. Removed some unused Vile voice clips and added some missing ones to the Japanese Vile voice clips. The characters now have their proper idle animations in the CS menu when used with the latest versions of Character Select Each character has their own color in the CS menu, instead of a default blue color for all characters

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.11
updates.changelog:
Added Shadow Armor X and Vile MK-II.

All characters now have a standardized dash punch, which is as important as the ground pound. Vile can dash punch by dashing and using the bomb input.

Vile's dash no longer consumes meter.

Zero has a new move, Rekkoha, which can be executed by pressing the punch button while stationary. Shippuga is now a combo move that can be used by doing a normal ground attack and then pressing the punch input.

Fixed the infamous glitch that makes characters get burnt forever.

Fixed the teleport glitch when opening new doors.

Added interactions with Brutal Bosses and Gore/Hardmode custom enemies. They have more health in general compared to vanilla enemies. The Grand Star from Brutal Bosses is not interactable with the weapons though. I couldn't figure out a proper way to get its behavior.

Added health to Star Road custom objects. Previously, they used to have a locked 1 health.

Added Star Road's chain chomp to the list of interactable objects.

Made the Mad Piano get into attack mode if you attack it first.

Added new dash effects for all characters.

Some animations were changed, including the run animation.

Plenty of character stat changes, including a faster charge shot for X and a few adjusted hitboxes for Zero's saber.

Plenty of other fixes and improvements. This is probably the biggest v1.2.x update in terms of adjustments, so I can't list all of them.

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.10
updates.changelog:
An update because the previous version of the mod is no longer properly compatible with last version of coopdx (v1.3.1).

Changelog:

Black Zero's Z-Saber is now colored purple again, due to the use of the updated gfx functions from coopdx 1.3.1

All weapons are properly lit during night time when using Day/Night DX mod, due to the use of the updated gfx functions from coopdx 1.3.1

Vile's bomb's hitbox has been increased again, after being greatly reduced in 1.2.9

Vile's bombs can now properly get rid of Koopa The Quick again. its removal in 1.2.9 was unintentional

Improved range of Gaea Armor's Giga Attack

Vile bombs and Gaea Giga Attack interact differently with Goombas and Koopas. Now they get deleted instead of stomped.

Adjusted weapons's interactions with Boos

Koopas and Boos no longer receive hits during death animation

Removed typo on Gaea Armor's description when using CS

Updated CS descriptions

Slightly adjusted wall sliding code. Looks visually better when sliding off very small surfaces.

Reworked hitbox interactions' system:

Objects that get deleted from weapon hitboxes now get deleted on the next frame, while being hidden in the current one. This makes the interactions properly appear for other players when playing online

Removed oIntangibleTimer = 0 from all hitboxes and added a custom interactions handler between player. This makes it so that the bob-omb could be juggled again and all other players would be able to see it

Projectiles no longer get deleted when interacting with other players if server interactions are set to Non-Solid

Zero:

Adjusted wait time between hits and hit stop after hits, after discovering that the whole thing wasn't properly implemented. But the new behavior should be roughly the same as the old one

Adjusted some hitboxes

Z-Saber position now moves better depending on Zero's speed

Cancelling the 3-hit Z-Saber combo into Ryuenjin will now set the face angle to the held direction of the stick, rather than the face angle of the slash combo.

Cancelling the landing air slash into Ryuenjin or Dash will now set the face angle to the held direction of the stick, rather than the face angle of the landing slash.

Intangibility timer from moves like Ryuenjin or Raikousen is no longer counting down while in hit stop

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.9.1
updates.changelog:
Fixed Vile bombs causing script errors when hitting NPCSs

Fixed Vile bombs causing script errors when interacting with that wooden box enemy in Star Road

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.9
updates.changelog:
This requires version 1.3 of coopdx, due to use of gfx_parse functions and the extended object fields. Black Zero was possible because of gfx functions that were introduced, that made altering effects much easier than importing and reimporting the models.

You might notice it's not possible to hit blocks or stomp enemies, but this is because coopdx 1.3 does not let custom actions have the default behaviors for hitting above and below. The fix should be added to a future version of coopdx 
Fix INT_HIT_FROM_ABOVE/BELOW check by Sunketchupm · Pull Request #751 · coop-deluxe/sm64coopdx

Gaea Armor X and Black Zero are added. Gaea Armor has unique gimmicks but Black Zero is a reskin with different effect colors. For Gaea Armor:

Gaea Shot

Giga Attack

Wall cling

Less damage from lava boost

Slower Dash

Plenty of other fixes have been added:

All weapons now use a common hitbox system. This makes it easier to make new weapons

Optimized weapons interactions: Instead of looping through all possible interactable objects, the weapons will now only loop through the activated objects in a given level.

Fixed errors that made the mod not compatible with coopdx 1.3

Made all graphical effects not be affected by Day/Night DX light overrides

CS version of the mod now uses the built-in costume manager

Plenty of rebalancing

Rewritten wall sliding

Vile's weapons consume less meter but his bomb radius has been made smaller

And many other more fixes

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.8
updates.changelog:
Obligatory day one patch after a decently big update. This fixes a critical bug involving the buster charge states.

Other changes:

Functions used in the scarf script file are made local. Potentially improving performance.

The scarf is more front facing when performing a dash

Slightly adjusted the scarf vertical rotation calculation

Updated the extra sounds. This one includes JP voice for Alia

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.7
updates.changelog:
This requires coopdx v1.1 or above.

I thought v1.2.6 would be the last one in v1.2, but the release of coopdx compelled me to get a function Command Mission model since I had the model lying around, I just needed to find a way to animated the scarf via lua.

General changes:

The Mega Man X menu has been removed when using the Character Select verison of the mod. Now all character and palette toggling are done with the CS menu

The mod is now categorized as "Moveset" in the mod menu

Removed the "sounds" option in the Mega Man X menu for the non-CS version. This used to only exist due to legacy excoop not supporting custom sounds. This is no longer needed.

New running animation

Exclamation boxes have fixed interaction. They used to be able to be destroyed during an invalid action, potentially duplicating the sounds, effects, and even the loot they drop.

Rendering the correct head state is now done in the "on render" hook. This used to make the models have the wrong heads when combining the mod with something like OMM (throwing cappy forces the wrong head state)

Fixed the models offset when sinking in quick sand

Dash trails lengths are shorter overall

Dash sound properly plays when dashing off ledges immediately

Lowered the volume on some sounds

Fixed the calculations when deciding when to let go of a wall during a wall slide depending on the held stick direction. Yes the calculation was wrong, and now it is much smoother to slide down moving platforms or smaller walls

WF Tower door now is interactable with the weapons

Star Road: Breakable windows, floors, and Wiggler are now interactable with the weapons

Wiggler has more hp for each phase (5 -> 6)

Moneybag has less HP (4 -> 2)

Removed calls for network_send_object when objects have interacted with weapons. This was not doing much and it caused script errors for some romhacks like Star Road

X:

Added Command Mission alt. Functions the same as the default model

Charge time for buster has been reduced, this includes the Armors' charges as well

Spiral Shot no longer interacts with players if the server interactions are set to None. This was an oversight

Full charge shot (not Spiral Shot or Double Shot) damage has been adjusted when using armors (6.5 -> 7), still weaker compared to unarmored X' full charge shot damage

Buster shot can be cancelled into punch and moving punch without visual inconsistencies

Zero:

All hitboxes have been adjusted and are now bigger

Ryuenjin: When hitting bullies, they get knocked back following the face angle of the move

All other moves besides Ryuenjin: When hitting bullies, adjusted the knockback angle to be somewhere in the between the face angle of the move and the position of the bullies relative to the move

Air Slash and Kuuenzan: Visibly bigger sabers to match the new hitboxes

Shippuga: visually adjusted, extra hitbox added

Uses a different voiceline file when he says "I won't lose", making the extra sound pack able to overwrite it

Can no longer grab by doing the normal saber attack

Vile:

Meter gain: 1 -> 1.05 each frame

Dash Attack consumes less meter (3 -> 2.5)

Cannon Shot dmg (5.5 -> 5.8)

Alia:

Fixed a bug where she was able to inherit X' armors properties when using the non-CS version of the mod

She has her own sound file for "wall kick", making some extra sound pack sounds not give her X' voices for wallkicking

She also inherits all unarmored X' changes mentioned above

updates.title: Mega Man X - v1.2.6
updates.changelog:
This update adds a few fixes. This is the last patch for v1.2.x, due to it addressing the few remaining problems.

Character changes:
​

X:

Fixed a bug where swapping characters fast enough while the buster shots are active would cause the wrong remaining buster shot count to be calculated (For reference, 5 regular shots are allowed at a time). This also applies to Alia.

Fixed a bug where the First Armor's pink shot would count as one single hit (instead of 3 hits) when hitting enemies, making it weaker than the regular shot.

Fixed a bug where the Second Armor's second shot would as one single hit (instead of 2 hits) when hitting enemies.

Zero:

Sentsuizan: comes out 1 frame faster.

Raikousen: Lightning damage 2.5 -> 3.5.

Alia:

Changed eye texture, face model, and face normals.

Fixed a bug where there would be a hidden menu option that changes X's armors when she is selected, while playing the non-CS version of the mod.

fix-that-rom-hack-camera-bug.586.author: EmilyEmmi
fix-that-rom-hack-camera-bug.586.description: A bunch of people have been upset about a recent change to camera behavior in custom levels (more specifically, any level that uses the "Rom Hack" camera mode). You can fix this issue without this mod by simply toggling "Invert X" in your "Camera" options (see image). But since not everyone knows this, here's a mod I made in like 10 minutes that does it for you. Given that the Invert X camera option doesn't affect any other camera mode other than Free Camera, I'm of the opinion that this should be changed back to its behavior pre-1.2.0.

mariohunt.8.author: EmilyEmmi
mariohunt.8.description:
In this game mode, players are split into "Runners" and "Hunters". Runners try to complete the game, while Hunters try to stop them. Includes:

Verbose game settings

Support for 7 languages

Robust Rom Hack and OMM Rebirth support

Built-in menu by Blocky

Snow in December

MarioHunt.zip is the standard version. MarioHunt_Lite is a smaller version that removes some minor features, such as the lobby. api_stuff.zip contains mods that use the MarioHunt API, including a compatible name tags version.

Mod by EmilyEmmi, mod icon by MaybeNotJohny. Additional credits available on GitHub.

updates.title: v2.8
updates.changelog:
I say this every time, but... FINALLY! The big v2.8 update has arrived. Featuring several new game options, huge balance and QoL changes, and bug fixes. Lots of them.

The big new feature this update is the new 
Game Area
 option! If you're tired of playing the same stages over and over, now you can choose to play the entire game in Main Floor, Basement, or Upstairs! Cap stages will be moved to new locations so all stars are possible. Or try the hellish Top Floor, containing ONLY TTC, RR, WMotR, and TotWC. Also available for Star Road and Ztar Attack 2.

If you don't like bouncing off of players, you can also turn on Disable Player Collision. I point this out because I prefer to play with this option on.Oh yeah, invisible walls are gone now, too. TTC is playable now?

star-revenge-6-9-luigi-lost-in-time.240.description: Star Revenge 6.9: Luigi Lost in Time ​ About: 27 Stars Repurposed Levels Star Revenge Series This is Star Revenge 6.9, a small side-hack made from levels which were meant for SR8 before it got reworked to feature a lot more Touhou. super-mario-the-galactic-journey.215.title: Super Mario The Galactic Journey
super-mario-the-galactic-journey.215.author: Dragonary
super-mario-the-galactic-journey.215.description: Super Mario The Galactic Journey Romhack created by Fares242 Ported to co-op by Dragonary Story​ There exists a Star of great power placed in its altar in the center of the universe. It is called the "Galactic Star". It balances the spatial activity especially for planets with life on them. Bowser steals the Galactic Star for his desire for an intergalactic empire. A Luma comes and request Mario's help from the Toads and builds a Starship for them that is powered on Silver Stars. Unfortunately, Silver Stars zoom out as a result of the Galactic Star's absence. One of the Toads manages to catch one Silver Star before it zoomed away which was enough to start the journey with the Starship. Silver Stars have spread around from all around space, and Mario's quest is to collect them, power up the engine of the Starship to go as far as it can before Mario would resume his galactic adventure on foot. Features​ 102 Stars across 23 worlds (side levels and hub worlds included) Click to expand... Custom music from various games Click to expand... Fall damage DISABLED Click to expand... No 100 coin stars Click to expand...

super-mario-the-power-star-journey.764.author: jonathanoflebones
super-mario-the-power-star-journey.764.description: The Power Star Journey ​ Released by Fares242 in 2012, this is a 101 star long Major Hack that contains new hub worlds. Lots of custom areas and long, challenging levels. Be wary though, this port is based on version 1.0 of the hack and it really shows it's age, you'll always be taken back to the first overworld after getting a star or dying. Expect a lot of backtracking. This port also comes with OMM Support, courtesy of Jairo The Plumber

updates.title: Port updated to 1.1
updates.changelog: Port has been updated to the unofficial 1.1 Update by LinCrash. Changes Include: -Fixed warps for all courses -No level intro textboxes -Buffed swimming (Just use the faster swimming mod) + Hangable ceiling speed -*Somewhat* improved music (you can still choose to listen to the original awful ost by checking the 'altsound' folder within the mod's files!) -Renamed a few stars to have a clear hint -Added a return warp to Toad Valley via Lava Valley (OW3) -Restored Course 15's Rainbow Textures Course Changes: C1 - Moved one secret in a better spot, added a coin indicator for one stupidly hidden red coin C3 - Moved the spawn down to make the fall quick C5 - Improved the secrets star + added an arrowed coin indicator for the WC entrance (star 1 only) C6 - Moved the secret Chain Chomp warp in a better spot ;) C7 - Made a total new star 6 (read corner sign for hint) + fixed a strange crash during star 6 C8 - Added metal boxes and moved the shell along with for star 3 C10 - Added warp pipes leading to the top floor (stars 4-6 only), added metal boxes as a platform for the Mr I star (star 6 only) C12 - Moved a red coin in a better spot B3 part 1 - collecting the star won't kick you out of the level If you find any bugs/issues let me know!

coopware.993.title: CoopWare
coopware.993.author: EmilyEmmi
coopware.993.description: (Logo by LJ_Retro) (NOTE: I left "WIP" in the title by mistake in v1.2. Please ignore it, or change the title to remove it if you'd like.) WarioWare-styled gameplay in Super Mario 64 Coop DX! React quickly to complete fast-paced microgames and go for the highest score you can! Work together in Coop mode , or go head-to-head in Versus or Team Versus mode . Featuring 17 standard microgames , 4 challenging Boss Microgames , and 64 achievements to earn , there's plenty of variety, from racing, to trivia, to other fun surprises! Inspired by "Mario vs. Wario Ware" by Team Cornersoft. More detailed credits within the mod itself. Also features an API to add your own microgames for those with modding experience- check out "Example New Microgame" for an example implementation.

star-revenge-7-5-kedowsers-return.221.description: Star Revenge 7.5: Kedowser's Return ​ About: 131 Stars ​ Badges ​ Remixed Levels ​ Star Revenge Series ​ This is Star Revenge 7.5, a SMG2 green stars styled hack based on Star Revenge 7. Unlike SR6.5, this hack features all levels from the hack it's based one, fully edited and with some level themes fully changed. It being based on SR7, means the 5 badges are back to unlock Triple Jumps, Walljump, the 2 Blocks and the lava defense increase on full health. This hack is a lot harder than other Star Revenges, specially compared to SR7 itself. Star 6 and 7 in each level are locked behind cap switches as well, leading to a bit more backtracking, depending on how you go about it. Story: After the failed attempt to stop Timerock, Kedowser was brought back and causes a lot of chaos in the Part and it's surroundings. Star Revenge Lore Order: SR0 ➜ SR1.5 ➜ SR2 TTM ➜ SR2.5 ➜ SR3.5 ➜ SR3.9 ➜ SR4.5 ➜ SR4.9 ➜ SR6.25 ➜ SR6.5 ➜ SR6. 9 ➜ SR5 ➜ SR7 ➜ SR7.5 ➜ SR8 ➜ SR5.5 ➜ SRX Credits: Brodute (Hack Creator) BlackJoystick (Porter) @flipflop bell (Badge Code) @wereyoshi (Badge Code) Sunk (Scrolling Textures) OneCalledRPG (Overhauled Custom HUD) Coop Central Server (more credits in code files) Original

escape-sequence.771.title: Escape Sequence
escape-sequence.771.author: Pseudonym929
escape-sequence.771.description: Escape Sequence ​ This is a gameplay mod that adds a timed escape sequence after a player collects a star, similar to how levels work in Wario Land 4 and Pizza Tower. During the escape sequence, the player must return to a portal located at spawn. The time limit is based on the player's proximity to the portal when they collect the star. If the timer runs out, the player will die and the star won't be counted. This mod is somewhat compatible with custom levels, though isn't guaranteed to work for every star. By default the sequence is disabled in levels and areas where the player cannot return to spawn in vanilla, though these settings can be adjusted through chat commands. How the Timer Works: The timer uses multiple variables (italicized below) which can be adjusted by the server owner through chat commands. The formula for determining how much time you are given is as follows: base timer value * (player's distance from spawn on the xz-plane / zero-radius ) ^ xz-exponent + player's distance from the portal on the y-axis / y-units-per-second * 30 ​ Base timer value can be modified with the chat command "/basetime" Zero-radius can be modified with the chat command "/zeroradius" XZ-exponent can be modified with the chat command "/xzpower" Y-units-per-second uses different values for when the player is above the portal versus when they are beneath it. The value for when the player is above can be modified with the chat command "/fallratio", while the value for when the player is beneath can be modified with the chat command "/climbratio" All players can also change the sound that plays after they collect a star with the chat command "/warnsnd"

mario-size.935.title: Mario Size
mario-size.935.author: _rd64_
mario-size.935.description:
Requires sm64coopdx v1.4 or above

Mario Size lets you shrink or grow Mario on the fly, changing how he moves around!

How it works

	

		

	

Shrink Mode:

Controls: Hold Y

Effects: Mario gets smaller and walks faster

Grow Mode:

Controls: Press Y twice, hold on the second press

Effects: Mario gets bigger, walks slower, and makes the ground shake with each step

Reset Size:

Controls: Press X

Effects: Mario instantly goes back to normal size

Perfect for speedruns, challenges, or just messing around!

Enjoy experimenting with different sizes and finding new ways to play!

Changelog v1.0.1

Bug Fixes

- Level Entry Freeze: Added validation to prevent logic execution during cutscenes

Multiplayer Enhancements

Added Bowser footstep sound effects

Optimized camera shake system

Implemented additional jump shake feedback

Increased maximum size limit

Full multiplayer compatibility maintained

This will serve as the stable release for the time being. I don't plan on updating it until I have significant changes to implement. It's functioning correctly now, but this update was essential.

cs-kos-mos.1056.title: [CS] Kos-Mos
cs-kos-mos.1056.author: Asplatim
cs-kos-mos.1056.description:
KOS-MOS is a character from the Xenosaga/Xenoblade series.​
She is an armored android combat weapon with an artificial intelligence. Her design is based on the KOS-MOS's Version 1 model from Xenosaga Episode I: Der Wille zur Macht; both the original and redesign are by Kunihiko Tanaka.
​
Kos-mos is from the very first game Monolith Soft ever developed back in 2002 called Xenosaga. This is the game that established the entire Xeno series for the company and is what made Kos-mos the face of the series and the mascot of Monolith Soft.
​
The purpose of this mod is to help spread awareness of both Xenosaga and Xenoblade by introducing people to Kos-mos and hopefully getting people interested in the Xenoblade series.
​

cs-wario-land-64.1103.title: [CS] Wario Land 64
cs-wario-land-64.1103.author: SwagSkeleton95
cs-wario-land-64.1103.description: Waah! It's been too long since the last brand new Wario Adventure! Maybe I should pick up the old treasure hunting sport again...This bounty for saving Princess Toadstool will do! What? This is supposed to be Mario's game?! Who cares!? Don't I deserve a little glory, too?? I'll just have to butt in and show how much better of a hero I truly am! No need to thank me, wahahaha! Now keep on reading to see what I have to offer!​ Five Differen t Flavors of Wario! ​ I think I'll bring some of my best friends along for this adventure..! That's right, it's Me, and Me, and Me and Me and Me! This adventure lets you play as up to five of my beautiful selves! Play as the me from Land 3, 4, Shake it, Virtual Boy, and from my very first original game! If that isn't an amazing deal, I don't know what is, guhaha! ​ My Abilities! ​ My abilities are different from that lame show-off, Mario's! Enjoy playing as someone actually powerful for once! My shoulder-bash will easily take out any weak enemy that you hit with it, and it won't wait for any doors either! Wahahaha! Cool, huh? And that's not all of my awesome movement options, either! Bash, hold Z, and jump, and I'll do an awesome front flip! Let's see Mario do that!! Guhahaha! How about you find the rest yourself? My moves totally turn Mario's adventure upside down! Some things react differently to my abilities, so try to find every possible way to screw things up! ​ Get Stronger! ​ What, I'm still not tough enough for you!? You should have a little more respect! But your old pal Wario has you covered. Gather those shiny Power Star things to gain new, powerful versions of your abilities! How 'bout that? Take down multiple enemies with the Super Ground Pound! And not even Bowser will stand a chance against my Super Shoulder Bash! ​ Raise Your Rank! ​ Did you think this hero stuff was free!? No way! I deserve a little something too, you know? Those painting worlds are full of my favorite thing in the world: Coins. Help your pal Wario out and grab as many of them as you can! That Princess Toadstool had the right idea; I think I'll buy myself my own fancy castle with the money. I'll keep track of just how many you've found, and give you my personal, Wario-approved score at the end! ​ Find Treasure! ​ You'd better not think that strength is all you need to complete this adventure! Treasure hunting needs brains, too, you know!? And my brain is as smart as it gets. Each level has a valuable hidden gem somewhere in it, but you'll need to really explore to find some of them... I'm counting on you here! Each gem you find will multiply your ending score, so you can't miss out! There's sixteen gems in total, but...I thought there were only fifteen levels!? ​ Interact! ​ Sounds like everybody was expecting Mario! What, aren't they happy to see me instead!? All the friendly characters in the game will react differently to my awe-inspiring presence. Even the signs have re-written themselves to explain my controls instead!? It doesn't stop at talking! I'll try bashing into someone to see if they have any goodies for me! It's a fair trade for saving their fancy princess, don't you think? Wahahaha! ​ What else do you want me to tell you!?​ What are you waiting for, huh!? Aren't you convinced yet!? There's still more to discover in the adventure, but I won't just tell you everything. Go find out for yourself! And a great big thanks to the developers of this mod for bringing my dazzling self into this game! SwagSkeleton95 - Models, textures, HUD, Coding, Dialogue, renders, modpage​ Cheekimelon - Dialogue​ TheBoomerAgainstTheZoomers - Menu descriptions, Sound​ SullyBoy - Graffiti textures​ Morishiko & Baconator2558 - Ending jingles​ Sharen - Contributor​ Jerthepear - Contributor​ Kog64 - Contributor​ And the playtesters! Wobbmin​ Hijacked​ SuperMoi64​ SchmooMaster​ BG​ THIS MOD REQUIRES THE LATEST VERSION OF SQUISHY'S CHARACTER SELECT MOD! Watch the overview and trailer here! ​ Notes: I'm aware of standard camera having some trouble with Wario's swimming. This will be fixed in the next update.

updates.changelog: Waah! It's been too long since the last brand new Wario Adventure! Maybe I should pick up the old treasure hunting sport again...This bounty for saving Princess Toadstool will do! What? This is supposed to be Mario's game?! Who cares!? Don't I deserve a little glory, too?? I'll just have to butt in and show how much better of a hero I truly am! No need to thank me, wahahaha! Now keep on reading to see what I have to offer!​ Five Differen t Flavors of Wario! ​ I think I'll bring some of my best friends along for this adventure..! That's right, it's Me, and Me, and Me and Me and Me! This adventure lets you play as up to five of my beautiful selves! Play as the me from Land 3, 4, Shake it, Virtual Boy, and from my very first original game! If that isn't an amazing deal, I don't know what is, guhaha! ​ My Abilities! ​ My abilities are different from that lame show-off, Mario's! Enjoy playing as someone actually powerful for once! My shoulder-bash will easily take out any weak enemy that you hit with it, and it won't wait for any doors either! Wahahaha! Cool, huh? And that's not all of my awesome movement options, either! Bash, hold Z, and jump, and I'll do an awesome front flip! Let's see Mario do that!! Guhahaha! How about you find the rest yourself? My moves totally turn Mario's adventure upside down! Some things react differently to my abilities, so try to find every possible way to screw things up! ​ Get Stronger! ​ What, I'm still not tough enough for you!? You should have a little more respect! But your old pal Wario has you covered. Gather those shiny Power Star things to gain new, powerful versions of your abilities! How 'bout that? Take down multiple enemies with the Super Ground Pound! And not even Bowser will stand a chance against my Super Shoulder Bash! ​ Raise Your Rank! ​ Did you think this hero stuff was free!? No way! I deserve a little something too, you know? Those painting worlds are full of my favorite thing in the world: Coins. Help your pal Wario out and grab as many of them as you can! That Princess Toadstool had the right idea; I think I'll buy myself my own fancy castle with the money. I'll keep track of just how many you've found, and give you my personal, Wario-approved score at the end! ​ Find Treasure! ​ You'd better not think that strength is all you need to complete this adventure! Treasure hunting needs brains, too, you know!? And my brain is as smart as it gets. Each level has a valuable hidden gem somewhere in it, but you'll need to really explore to find some of them... I'm counting on you here! Each gem you find will multiply your ending score, so you can't miss out! There's sixteen gems in total, but...I thought there were only fifteen levels!? ​ Interact! ​ Sounds like everybody was expecting Mario! What, aren't they happy to see me instead!? All the friendly characters in the game will react differently to my awe-inspiring presence. Even the signs have re-written themselves to explain my controls instead!? It doesn't stop at talking! I'll try bashing into someone to see if they have any goodies for me! It's a fair trade for saving their fancy princess, don't you think? Wahahaha! ​ What else do you want me to tell you!?​ What are you waiting for, huh!? Aren't you convinced yet!? There's still more to discover in the adventure, but I won't just tell you everything. Go find out for yourself! And a great big thanks to the developers of this mod for bringing my dazzling self into this game! sonic-character-rebooted.13.title: Sonic Character: Rebooted
sonic-character-rebooted.13.author: steven3004
sonic-character-rebooted.13.description:
This is a mod that adds Sonic and friends as a playable character in sm64ex-coop.

This mod can be used two ways:

As a Character Select pack: Adds two characters with movesets and palettes to the CS menu.

As a standalone mod: Type /sonic in chat to turn on Sonic characters. Each character overwrites a vanilla character's slot, the list goes:

Mario: Sonic

Luigi: ?

Toad: Amy Rose

Waluigi: ?

Wario: ?

Sonic replaces Mario, and is faster than the vanilla cast, and he also brings some new tricks to the table.

Momentum tweaks: When running or landing Sonic doesn't lose any speed that he has gained. If you let go of the analog stick he'll decelerate instead of stopping immediately.

Air control: While airborne, during some moves, he can turn around in the air and change directions.

No swimming. He instead has a limited version of his ground moveset.

Fall damage is delayed a bit for Sonic.

B button (ground):

Spindash: Hold the B button to charge the spindash, and let go to dash off rollin'. Ya can also spam it and gain some speed, but it's capped.

Sonic Eagle: Hold A and press B and he'll do the Sonic Eagle from Sonic Battle, which is basically a reskinned Jump Kick here.

Windmill Kick: This move replaces Mario's slide kick. By pressng B while crouch-slidin', Sonic will do a spinning kick, attacking most enemies and bouncin' off walls.

B button (air):

Sonic Eagle: Basically the same move, but ya have to let go of the analog stick t' do it.

Dropdash: Hold B in the air with the analog stick and you'll start a dropdash. If ya hold it until you hit the ground, you'll get more speed and start rollin'. If ya release it in the air, you'll instead perform an airdash. If ya hold it until ya hit a wall, you'll climb upwards. The faster you are, the higher you'll jump up.

Bound Jump: Sonic's replacement fer the ground pound. Press Z and you'll bounce on the ground, break stuff, and be immune t' fall damage. Though keep in mind that you'll have less air control.

Grabbing: Just spindash or roll into an object.

Amy goes over Toad, is mostly similar to Sonic in terms of physics, but she has moves of her own that makes for a different play style.

(Her voice clips are mostly unfinished for now.)

Passive abilities:

1. Amy's jump height is much higher than Sonic's and most of the vanilla cast.

2. She can swim, unlike Sonic, but instead of a breaststroke, she only has a flutter kick, and her speed increases the same way it does on land

Giant Steps:

1. This move replaces the Long Jump, in which Amy leaps forward in the held direction, allowing her to gain speed and redirect momentum immediately while on the ground.

2.  Keep in mind that this move doesn't have air mobility and there is a bit of delay for using the move.

    + By pressing B during the move, she will trip over and do what's basically just a reskinned dive.

Hammer Attack: The most basic melee move. You press B on the ground and she'll whack her hammer instead of punching or kicking.

Hammer Twirl: By crouching and holding B, Amy will spin with her hammer and bounce off walls. You're able to change your direction by a bit during this move if yer moving, and it slows you down when you're on the ground.

Hammer Flip:

1. While Amy's in the air, if you press or hold B, she'll spin forwards with her hammer.

2. While the move is being done, she can bounce up walls, retaining some speed and gaining height based on the speed. Note that ya gotta be fully and constantly spinning fer this to be possible. Run into a wall too early and she'll just bonk off of it.

Hammer Jump: When ya press A within a few frames of her hitting her hammer, either from a Hammer Attack or landing with a Hammer Flip, she'll propel upwards. The height you gain depends on how fast you go. This is also how ya fly with the Wing Cap.

Hammer Pound:

1. This is basically just a simple replacement fer the Ground Pound where she spins her hammer downwards.

2. If you press and hold B during the move, she'll thrust forwards a bit and do the Hammer Twirl.

In addition, here's the intended color code fer this model:

Sonic:

Shirt/Cap (Shoes): d91101

Overalls (Quills): 4084d9

Skin: fdc976

Gloves: ffffff

Amy:

Shirt/Cap (Clothes): e41515

Overalls (Secondary Clothes): 00ff86

Hair (Quills): fd90a7

Skin: ffb597

Gloves: ffffff

Coding, Modelling and Animating: 
steven.

Ball model: 
king the memer

Sound Effects: 
SEGA - Sonic Team

Sonic VA and Animation Helper: 
AngelicMiracles

Amy Rose VA: Grimoria Webb

Custom voice system: SMS Alfredo

Coolest playtesters:  Asra, Matheus Lopes, Great Kingdom Official, DemnyxOnyxfur, Zerks

updates.title: They call me Sonic. 'Cause I am faster than sound, I keep on jumping around.
updates.changelog:
Capped Amy's hammer attack backwards speed.

Tweaked the way air controls handles negative speed.

Prevented Sonic from attacking players with his jump.

Fixed animation jank when the air dash action transitions to running.

Tweaked running animation code again.

Tweaked land rolling slope accel.

Fixed the third upwarp bug that's occured with rolling underwater.

Added more deceleration to skidding. Sonic has more deceleration than Amy.

New passive mechanic: Badnik Bounce. This is taken from the classic games where the further you fall, the higher you'll bounce off an enemy. Usually, you'd need to hold A to maintain and gain height from bounces, but some other moves will just automatically gain height upon stomping.

You can't bounce on players for now.

Credits t' 
fbell
 fer the stomp code I used as the foundation fer Badnik Bouncing.

Generalized and tweaked walkin' animations code.

This move replaces the Slide Kick. It's good fer a quick attack and a bit of a headstart, but it's just as useful as the move it replaces.

updates.title: The Rosy Rascal Update.
updates.changelog:
Sonic now has a more efficient bound pound code, so it's less hacky and the move now feels more flowy.

Air Dashes now break breakable surfaces, provided that ya wanna break boxes with this thing in whichever circumstances.

Sonic now has a new lil' animation for exiting paintings with a star collected.

Sonic's water actions can now interact with switches.

Bound Jump now bounces directly off enemies instead of phasing through them.

Removed Sonic's ability t' Long Jump as it's really disruptive t' have in his entire moveset. I'll figure out what t' replace it with later on, but fer now, ya can and will have t' live without yer BLJs.

Added Amy Rose with full movesets.

weather-cycle-dx.272.title: Weather Cycle DX
weather-cycle-dx.272.author: AgentX
weather-cycle-dx.272.description: This mod adds a weather cycle system with cloudy skies, rain, and storms to sm64coopdx. It uses Day Night Cycle DX as a base library, meaning you need to have it enabled in order to use this mod. There is also a toggleable Aurora Borealis that starts after midnight. I've worked on this mod for months now and managed to optimize the storm to run at 200-300 microseconds, which is an impressive number especially compared to the earlier 6000 microseconds. Special thanks to Floralys for the original concept. Special thanks to eros71 for saving the mod!

dynos-allergic-to-mountains-64-official-.title: [DynOS] Allergic To Mountains 64 Official Co-op Model Pack
dynos-allergic-to-mountains-64-official-.author: ThaGurlTIlly
dynos-allergic-to-mountains-64-official-.description: Allergic To Mountains 64 was a project I started for the Mario 64 PC port way back in 2020, it has since been basically cancelled, and as a final farewell, I decided to make one final update to the characters, when Allergic To Mountains began as Super Show 64, it was a coop mod, Mario and Luigi were the first models to be made for the project, and now we've come full circle, Mario 64 Co-op has gotten a lot of changes, those changes have resulted in updates to my models, done by third parties, that took creative liberties in order to add the new features, like custom colors, resulting in the removal of the cel shading i've grown so fond of, these updates done by myself, aswell as FluffaMario, takes no liberties, not only is the cel shading back, but the recoloring is still possible! this pack includes Mario, Luigi, both Wario models, as well as a completely new Toad! Credits as well as official palette colors are in the included .Txt file​

pet-propeller-fly-guy.230.title: [PET] Propeller Fly Guy
pet-propeller-fly-guy.230.author: AgentX
pet-propeller-fly-guy.230.description:
This mod adds a fly guy pet that behaves like the propeller blocks from New Super Mario Bros. Wii.

To use the Propeller Fly Guy, first spawn one through the pets menu, grab him and jump in the air and then press [A]. You will propel upwards and eventually begin to descend. To slow your descent, press [A] in rapid succession. To speed up your descent, hold down [Z].

shotgun-coop.621.title: Shotgun Coop
shotgun-coop.621.author: ProfeJavix
shotgun-coop.621.description:
This mod gives every player a shotgun with a moveset.
​

Moves:

Y: Shoot

Charged Y (hold until the bar is charged): Boost Shoot

Ground Pound + Y: Ground Pound Shoot

Ground Pound + Charged Y: Boost Ground Pound Shoot

X: Toggle First Person

You can use the shotgun either in PvP or with some game objects/enemies, the choice is yours (tip: each move deals different damage, so not all of them will have an effect on some targets). 

Check Mod Menu to set the reload time and the boost charge time. Also, if you load EmilyEmmi's MarioHunt, the host will have the chat command "/sgcoop-mhteam" to select which team will have the shotguns. Allowed values are:
​

"0" or "hunters" ( default)

"1" or "runners"

"2" or "both"

Credits to Agent X's 
Gun Mod
 for the PvP inspiration and Dorrieal's 
Shotgun Mario
 romhack for the original shotgun concept.

This mod was a bounty from Drenchy. Visit his channel!

rd-notification-message.937.title: Rd Notification Message
rd-notification-message.937.author: _rd64_
rd-notification-message.937.description:
RD NOTIFY MESSAGE

Requires sm64coopdx v1.4 or above

What's this mod?

	

		

	

Create custom visual notifications on screen to communicate with your friends during multiplayer. Perfect for announcing events, giving instructions, or just leaving funny messages.

See commands here:

Permanent Alerts: 
/rdt [message] 
(stays on screen)

Timed Alerts: 
/rdt5, /rdt10, /rdt15, /rdt20, /rdt30
 (seconds)

Color Customization: 
/rdc [color]
 (Includes Mario_Red, Luigi_Green, Rainbow, etc.)

Visual Effects: Toggle movement 
(/rdn)
 and glow 
(/rdb)

Logic: Movement ON + Glow O

N = Pulsing text; Movement OFF = Static text

Auto-wrapping for long messages

Host-only permissions for command usage

Open Chat, Type 
/rdt [message] 
to start (
Host only
) or 
/rdt
 to remove message.

 
Changelog 1.0.1

Major Improvements Complete refactor

Performance optimization

Rendering system optimized

and more

You're all set! thanks to Djoslin0 for Lib source

pause-menu-engine.1214.title: Pause Menu Engine
pause-menu-engine.1214.author: Dan_SM64
pause-menu-engine.1214.description: Replaces the Pause Menu with a powerful and flexible User Interface. This same engine is used in both PvP Deathmatch and Hide and Seek DX. Mod Developers are free to use this to leverage their own mods, such as cheat menus or full-fledged game modes. HOW IT WORKS The menu is a data table containing Pages, Buttons, and Sliders. Buttons and Sliders are capable of storing and running functions(), enabling power and versatility to both developers and users. The menu is navigated through user input, and displayed in a manner that supports most resolutions. The data table can be updated in real time, allowing for more advanced stuff such as hidden buttons, and player lists with switchable values. FEATURES Support for multiple pages through page-switching. Scrolling for when there's several entries in a page. Colored Names and Values. Boolean and Integer based Sliders, with the ability to give indexes aliases. Sliders can also be adjusted with multiplied increments. Pressing X enables Fast Scroll. Co-op Menu can still be accessed via the R button. Adjustable Variables used with the engine can be saved and loaded into storage and are remembered between sessions. CREDITS Written by Dan Tiny bit of pause handling code by EmilyEmmi string_without_hex() function by birdekek Special Thanks to wereyoshi for a bit of troubleshooting

cs-kuribo-challenge-64.285.title: [CS] Kuribo Challenge 64!
cs-kuribo-challenge-64.285.author: PakPecik
cs-kuribo-challenge-64.285.description: Give yourself a little challenge and collect as many stars as you can by hopping around as a Goomba in his Iconic Green Shoe from Super Mario Bros 3!​ HOP into the action by literally HOP into the action! (Walking is no longer possible)​ The shoe's flat surface prevents you from drowning into the quicksand (Just try not to move more often)​ Higher triple jump, but lower normal jump​ Trouble when flying? there's a new way to do it: While performing Super Dropkick with the wing "cap", quickly press the A button to activate the wings on your back. You can also do this over and over again in the air as long as you got the wing cap​ Speaking of cap, you won't find some anytime soon, we're replaced them with TOTALLY NOT DEAD Goombas....​ You're immune to spinies now. Cause why not?​ Requires character select to play​ You may or may not drown faster with the use of the shoe in water​ Key of the moveset (GROUND POUND!):​ A new way to triple jump: When landing from a ground pound, press the A button to perform the higher triple jump Super Dropkick: When ground pounding in the air, press the B button to perform a dropkick with a very HORIZONTAL directions, you can also do it when landing from a ground pound Super Jump Kick: When ground pounding in the air, press the A button to perform a jump kick with a more higher range. Useful if you need a little boost upwards If you think the distance of your dropkick is a little too far, just stop it with a ground pound. You can also ground pound in situations like jumping from a top of the pole or a little rising surfaces Download the mod and receive yourself the Iconic Replica of the Green Shoe and a TOTALLY REPLICA of the TOTALLY NOT DEAD Goomba with wings! ....Please?​ A CONTROLLER IS REQUIRED FOR MUCH SMOOTHER GAMEPLAY OF CHARACTER!​ THIS MOD REQUIRES CHARACTER SELECT MOD V1.11.2 AND ABOVE Special Thanks to Melzinoff for the Goomba voicelines and the rest of SM64COOPDX Modding Community for helping me with Coding Materials! ​ ​ All jokes aside, this is the first mod that i ever made and i'm looking forward to hear your opinions about the mod, how can i upgrade it, the problems you encountered, and etc. ​ ​ Therefore, feel free to contact me on the SM64COOPDX discord if you had any of these thoughts above ​ ​ Last but not least, thank you for downloading my mod and Have Fun! ​ - PakPecik

sharens-improved-swimming.241.title: Sharen's Improved Swimming
sharens-improved-swimming.241.author: Ex Coop Mods Archive
sharens-improved-swimming.241.description:
Sharen's Improved Swimming

List of changes:

- Instead of rotating Mario to the desired direction and pressing A at a specific rhythm, you now simply pull the stick to where you wanna go and Mario will simply go there, with no need to mash A as he'll stroke on his own, if you wish to go up or down, just hold A or Z.

- Entering water no longer puts you in a state where you have to wait for Mario to stop moving downwards, instead, you get to control him right away! In addition, if you enter water while already having considerable speed (most commonly via dives or long jumps) you'll get to keep extra speed you'd normally never reach!

- Shells are no longer a stupid joke, their duration was buffed from 8 seconds (yeah I didn't believe it either) to 30, alongside making you swim significantly faster as well as letting you halt to a complete stop faster! super-mario-64-2.1117.title: Super Mario 64(2)
super-mario-64-2.1117.author: jonathanoflebones
super-mario-64-2.1117.description: Super Mario 64(2) is a hack created by FeYoshiParty that was made in Toad's Tool 64 back in 2007, making it one of the first and oldest hacks ever created. This hack was claimed to be lost for a very long time with footage seen only in youtube videos from the creator's channel, then a working build of the hack was uploaded to the Internet Archive in 2023. Which I later reuploaded to Romhacking.com with a patch fixing a few game breaking bugs made by myself, and now the hack has been ported to coop using that same patch. The hack has 121 stars total. (122 if you can get the second star in Dire Dire Docks), it features retextured levels, edited object layouts, and this port also overrides the 5 Main Character palettes, changing them into a Fire Flower outfit seen in the original hack (thanks birdekek , for the help) Have fun playing through a piece of romhacking history!

The original version was not uploaded here because I thought it would be irrelevant by now, but um... guess not. This new version fixes a crash when shooting an egg as Birdo in Extra Characters.

Let's see how long this mod is actually relevant!

EDIT: Okay, if you use this with Tag, pipes will not work properly. This is, as far as I am aware, completely unfixable. Sorry.

character-select-randomizer.775.title: Character Select Randomizer
character-select-randomizer.775.author: wereyoshi
character-select-randomizer.775.description:
This is a character select randomizer mod that randomizes your character on hit, coin collection ,or level change. Each of said randomization methods can be toggled off.

using Character Select v1.15.1 and up will allow the mod to randomize costumes.

It also features an api _G.charselectrandomizerapi -which has options like 

othermodhandlecharacter - for having another mod handle characters

customcharacterrerollfunction - for other mods providing their own character reroll function

forcereroll - for another mod to force a reroll

get_version - for getting the current version of the mod.

sm64-chaos-edition.490.title: SM64 Chaos Edition
sm64-chaos-edition.490.author: ManIsCat2
sm64-chaos-edition.490.description:
Super Mario 64, but random codes are injected into the game at random intervals, resulting in an experience that can only be described as chaotic.

Epilepsy Warning:

This mod contains flashing lights or patterns that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised.

Original Mod Author: Kaze Emanuar

Coop Mod Author: ManIsCat2

Not all the codes (effects) could be ported for coop because of limitations so some are missing. I am deeply sorry!

This mod has a mod menu, the host can modify the Chaoticness and the Chaos Timer, here's what they do:

    - Chaoticness: Max amount of codes (effects) that can be active at once.

    - Chaos Timer: The time between code activation (seconds).

Some info about the mod:

    - Do not report any Bugs to Mods or the actual game while playing this Mod!!!

    - Also remember that this mod can cause lag!!!

    - in this mod, the object effects only sync if the player that has activated the effect and you, are in the same level.

    - If you experience Script Errors, ping me in Coop Central or DM me in Discord. (username is maniscat2)

cs-squishy.672.title: [CS] Squishy
cs-squishy.672.author: Squishy6094
cs-squishy.672.description: The first public release of [CS] Squishy, A Character Select Pack meant to set a defining quality standard for modern Character Select Packs. This pack aims to deliver a fun and unique momentum-based moveset inspired by mods such as OMM, Pasta Castle, King the Memer, and More while utilizing all the Character Select API has to offer! Put simple, uhmmm silly lady go zoom with codee!!! >.< This release is made purely in celebration of my birthday!! Which of course means that this is not yet a finished product! I ask that you report ANY issues you encounter with the mod in the Github Issues for the mod as well as give feedback for what you think I can improve on! And also stay up to date by following progress in the Squishy Discord Server !!! This release features: Squishy (x1) A full Moveset making use of Character Select's Moveset Hooks A Low skill floor, retaining base SM64 movement, Yet a High Skill Ceiling, Allowing for Practice-Perfect Gameplay Near-Full OMM Support Custom Host command for Manual Balancing /squishy-speed An entirely custom camera, Doodell Cam! Built and catered specifically for the Speed of Squishy Inspired by OMM, Kero Quest, and Grace Fully customizable via SM64CoopDX's Camera Settings

warp-node-randomizer.767.title: Warp Node Randomizer
warp-node-randomizer.767.author: EmilyEmmi
warp-node-randomizer.767.description:
Are you tired of Super Mario 64 being sensible to navigate? This mod offers a new experience every time you play (sort of)! Now paintings could go anywhere, and warps can send you to other levels completely! But don't worry, use /warps to see a record of where everything leads. Also check the mod menu (Pause, and then press R, and you should see it) for options on which warps get randomized. Some ways to play this:

Get all 120 stars (It should be possible with coop, but let me know if you find an impossible seed),

Race with your friends to see who can find a given level first,

Do random seed speedruns (Now it's like Minecraft speedrunning! Better increase those Piglin Trade odds...),

See who can make the most warp discoveries,

Romhack support is available, but it's a bit buggy. Also credit to Blocky for some of the RNG-related code.
