ball-moveset.867.title: Ball Moveset
ball-moveset.867.author: EmilyEmmi
ball-moveset.867.description: My second ever moveset has arrived! This baller moveset takes inspiration from the Mario Party minigame Bumper Balls, as well as everyone's favorite(?) Super Mario Galaxy feature. I took the time to really make it feel like you're balancing on a slippery, barely controllable ball. It bounces really high, so I'm sure that makes up for the drawbacks. Right? Features: ball Built-in infinite lives toggle (you will want this on, trust me) 100% has been proven possible, even in single player. However, it's probably going to be frustrating playing this alone. You have been warned.

updates.title: vBall.1
updates.changelog:
Don't expect consistent updates. This version exists to fix some bugs and make certain things more fair.

Added 
Boost!
 Hold B while standing still to charge, and release to launch yourself forward. The host may toggle this ability off.

Added a toggle for the moveset. It's host only, because everyone would just turn it off if they had the choice, and that's boring.

Wooden posts (such as those in Bob-Omb Battlefield) now drop their coins when fully pounded.

Bowser's tail hitbox was made significantly more generous.

Bowser now has a cap on how far he can be launched.

Wall Jumps with the ball (which I have dubbed "Ball Kicks") now travel higher based on speed. Note that regular jumps are unaffected by speed, as usual.

If Mario is moves under a ceiling with the ball, he is now ejected from the ball. This makes the Eyerok fight and "Express Elevator--Hurry Up!" in Wet-Dry World a bit easier.

Mario now uses the ball during the credits sequence.

Balls are now properly affected by time stop.

Fixed an issue where turning quickly before hitting Bowser's tail would cause Bowser to be thrown in unintended directions.

Fixed an issue where the Bowser 3 platforms wouldn't fall if Bowser was attacked quickly enough.

Fixed Mario's hitbox radius being bigger, even when not in ball form.

Added a small API.

hangout-romhack-marios-house-tomatobird8.author: jonathanoflebones
hangout-romhack-marios-house-tomatobird8.description: This is an old level model created a long while ago by Tomatobird8 of what's meant to be Mario's House. There are a lot of old hacks like this one that are just a single level with no objects, and I feel like they could work well as hangout maps. The Map has 2 Houses and 2 connected pools, and a few item boxes in the hangout version. use /house-tb8 command to warp to the house. You can hang out in here and make machinimas in 60fps or something like that. I'm also uploading the original romhack version of the level, for archival purposes.

narrator-mod-template.247.title: Narrator Mod Template
narrator-mod-template.247.author: Toonitor
narrator-mod-template.247.description: This Mod is a template for other modders for a Narrator that talks over every action you do in game. For now, you have a basic narrator and a few audio files for certain actions. But you can add more to it. =D Here is how you can do it: Duplicate and change the following code's name and filename Duplicate the following code and change the on_narrator#_action by changing the number up by 1. Then for every if then else that helps randomize the audio, add an end for the amount of audio you have. (EXAMPLE: Code: end end end end --- 3 randomized audio files = 3 end marks end --- ends the end codes ) Repeat the process with different m.action == actions. =) No credit is needed to use the mods code and any questions can be asked in the comments. Enjoy this mod. =D

titeuf.580.title: Titeuf
titeuf.580.author: Aso-Designer
titeuf.580.description:
Titeuf, (also known as Tootuff in certain countries)  the disruptive school boy created by Swiss comic artist Zep, made his way in Mario 64! 

Ready to imagine beating Bowser with a laser! 

Or just making sure to defeat him? Maybe? At least he won't get bad grades by saving a princess! 

Assets are from Titeuf Mega Party and Mario 64. Voice clips are from the many medias done for the character, including streaming, motion comics, tv show etc, performed by voice actor Donald Reignoux. 

Note: The Character doesn't blink, but does have a "death head"  

Minor issue: Script error for some reason, but it doesn't affect the game at all.

cs-wolf-odonnell.1184.title: [CS] Wolf o'donnell
cs-wolf-odonnell.1184.author: Aureon
cs-wolf-odonnell.1184.description: When i started playing sm64coopDX, way before i made an account on the site, i was hoping someone would make a mod for Wolf, but as far as i know, that never happened, so i hit the good ol' "fine, i'll do it myself" This mod was originally private, as i only used it to play with my friend, but then i thought it would be nice to release it, it's also my first mod! way before i made Tigy. I also made a moveset for him with the Easy Custom Movesets mod, so if you have this mod installed and want the complete experience, add this to initial-characterstats-table on the mod folder. "{ name = 'Wolf', walking_speed = 185, in_air_speed = 135, back_flip_strength = 110, jump_strength = 100, knockback_resistance = 1, wall_slide_on = true, in_air_jump = 1, in_air_jump_strength = 55, saultube_single_jump_animation = true, saultube_double_jump_animation = true }," Credits to the sounds resource website for Wolfie's voice. Also special thanks to Pengy Plush and Garrulous64, for helping me make my first mod with these awesome tutorials!

smart-spheres-0.70.title: Smart Spheres 0
smart-spheres-0.70.author: Ex Coop Mods Archive
smart-spheres-0.70.description:
Original Post: April 20, 2023

Author: Sunk

Original hack (Stupid Ballz 2) created by Morningstorm SM64.

Retexture (this hack) done by Dolphino and ShiN3.

Difficulty rating (from romhacking.com): 9.5/10

This romhack is one of Morningstorm’s first romhacks. It contains 182 stars and is very difficult.

v1.1 update

Smart Spheres 0
 update

Fixed C5 (and every other) exposed ceiling

Fixed incorrect warp nodes for bowser 1 and bowser 2 fights

Both issues found by @Asra
